<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.18.1</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="transmit-lease-accounting-entries">Transmit lease accounting entries </h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Global Lease Team</td>
<td>GFS Global Lease Team</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>The intent of this step is to capture all the data required to carry out IFRS 16 compliant accounting within the CoStar system</p>
<p>This process starts from <strong>Task# 8.3.3.17: 4.7.1 Process lease accounting entries.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Reversing Journal Entry Status (Un-export &amp; Un-approve)</strong></p>
<p>When the journal entry for a lease has been approved and exported within CoStar, the JE Status column in the accounting schedule will change from Scheduled to Approved to Exported.</p>
<p>Once the status is marked as ‘Exported’, the lease will no longer appear in the Journal Entry to Approve or Journal Entry to Export, or AstraZeneca/Alexion JE Export reports to prevent re-processing of the journal entry. In the event if the user needs to modify an accounting schedule after journal entries have been exported, they will need to go through the following steps to revert the JE Status back to ‘Scheduled’. The user can make modifications for a period when it’s in ‘Scheduled’ status, then will go through the Journal Entries to Approve and Journal Entries to Export steps again for this lease.</p>
<p>1) Navigate to the lease record by using the quick search or list pages in the Portfolio module.</p>
<p>2) Navigate to the Accounting page.</p>
<p>3) On the accounting schedule, locate the JE Status for the period that needs to be reversed. Click ‘Exported’.</p>
<p>4) In the pop up, review the journal entry that has been exported. Select ‘unexport’.</p>
<p>5) After the system has unexported the journal, select unapprove.</p>
<p>6) The pop up should now display Preview Journal Entry. Select ‘Close’.</p>
<p>7) Ensure the JE Status for the period is now marked as Scheduled before making any changes to the lease record.</p>
<p>Changes can be made to expenses, allocations or other information that should have been updated before processing the journal entry. Navigate to Journal Entries to Approve,Journal Entries to Export, or AstraZeneca/Alexion JE Export reports to reprocess the journal entry for the period. If more than one lease should be reversed, follow the steps for Offline Reversal for Journal Entry.</p>
<p><strong>Offline Reversals for Journal Entries</strong></p>
<p>Journal entry reversal occurs via an offline report located in the Reports module. The report is called Offline Reverse Journal Entry. Journal entries follow a 2-step process of approval and export, and both the unexport and unapprove can be accommodated in the Offline Reverse Journal Entry report.</p>
<p>1) Navigate to the Reports module.</p>
<p>2) Search for ‘Offline reverse’.</p>
<p>3) Select Offline Reverse Journal Entry report.</p>
<p>4) Complete the criteria listed below as needed to filter the file for the appropriate journal entries that need to be reversed.</p>
<p>• Hierarchy</p>
<p>• Period From</p>
<p>• Period To</p>
<p>• Classification Type</p>
<p>• Amortization Profile</p>
<p>• Journal Entry Profile</p>
<p>• Journal Entry Status*</p>
<p>• Currency</p>
<p>• Workflow Status</p>
<p>• Country</p>
<p>• System Export Batch ID</p>
<p>• Client Batch Number</p>
<p>*Note - The filter for Journal Entry Status has the biggest impact on the content of the report. One must select either Approved or Exported as the status.</p>
<p>5) Based the selection of filters, the system will generate an Excel file to complete.</p>
<p>6) Open the Excel file and find the Actions column. Available Actions in the report for each journal entry will vary as follows:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>• If Journal Entry Status was Approved – Actions: unapprove, Skip</p>
<p>• If Journal Entry Status was Exported – Actions: unexport, unexport &amp; unapprove, Skip</p>
</blockquote>
<p>7) Review each row and make an update to the Action column, indicating what action to take for each lease.</p>
<p>8) Save the Excel file.</p>
<p>9) Navigate to the Reports module.</p>
<p>10) Upload the Excel file by clicking the Upload Offline Template and following the prompts. It may take up to 15 minutes to complete the processing once the file has been uploaded.</p>
<p>Note: In the event unexport/unapproved action is performed in CoStar, a reversal journal should be manually prepared to post in Blackline. This process should undergo the normal journal posting in Blackline as per Blackline policy.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="4">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.18.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="build-lease-accounting-journals">Build lease accounting journals</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Business Administrator</td>
<td>GFS Business Administrator</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once the sFTP file is transmitted to the lease accounting journal, it will send to the Blackline tool via global scape for producing of the JE template.</p>
<p>After it has been sent to the Blackline tool, the Lease accounting journal is prepared in the BL template and Blackline admin will process the automated journal entry on WD-1, It leads to follow two processes as per scenarios.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>If all fields in the template are correctly validated in Blackline and there are no errors, the posting has been successfully completed. Follow <strong>task 8.3.2.24. Process Automated Journal Entries</strong> where the impact will be documented in the SAP lease accounting books.</p></li>
<li><p>If any errors are encountered (E.g. Cost Centre is blocked, Internal Order does not exist etc., the workflow will automatically be assigned to a member of the Global Lease team for manual remediation. Once updated detail is received and updated in the BL template the manual JE can be processed with the impact shown in the Lease account in SAP books.</p></li>
</ul>
<ol type="a">
<li><p>Status will remain as Not Prepared</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:6.56169in;height:0.93588in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="a">
<li><p>Entry will be required to be updated to resolve the errors and select Validate and Certify.</p></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><p>Once the month end lease entry is posted in SAP, this process is completed.</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>

# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for the process relating to the Intangible Asset:

- Addition

- Disposal or Retirement

- Amortisation

- Impairment

- Interco Transfer

- Maintain Master Data

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Business, Embedded Finance, GFS Middle Office, and GFS Back Office R2R and GDO Back Office DMT.

# SCOPE

The table indicates the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Business Process | Description |
| Intangible Asset based on AZ Group Accounting manual excluding Intangible Software | Intangible Software is not within the scope of this SOP. |

<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>GFS Back office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Business, Embedded Finance or GFS Middle Office prepare Intangible Asset External Capitalisation Template and fill out all mandatory fields in the “Asset Creation Template” tab.</p>
<p><strong><u>Prepare Intangible Asset External Capitalisation Template</u></strong></p>
<p>Business, Embedded Finance or GFS Middle Office to fill in all details for the asset based on instruction guidance listed at “Instruction Tab” and to identify whether the asset type is for;</p>
<ol type="a">
<li><p>New Intangible</p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:6.02706in;height:1.25556in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:6.1196in;height:1.12547in" /></p>
<p>New asset number field will be completed by GDO Back Office DMT team.</p>
</blockquote>
<ol start="2" type="a">
<li><p>Addition Milestone Payment</p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p><img src="media/image6.png" style="width:6.00915in;height:1.27415in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:6.02664in;height:1.13395in" /></p>
<p>New asset number field will be completed by Business, Embedded Finance or GFS Middle Office by referring back to previous email request on identifying the existing number created or contact Back Office R2R Fixed Asset team to provide Intangible Asset listing<mark>.</mark></p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong><u>Provide supporting documents</u></strong></p>
<p>Attached AIN &amp; invoice supporting for supporting the capitalisation.</p>
<p><img src="media/image8.png" style="width:5.96423in;height:2.38873in" /></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="4">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.21.4</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="initiate-master-data-creation">Initiate master data creation</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GDO Back Office DMT</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>After ensuring all details are correct, Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office requests GDO Back Office DMT for creation of asset shell with the updated templates.</p>
<p><strong><u>Send a request for asset shell creation</u></strong></p>
<p>Once the Intangible Asset External Capitalisation Template is complete, send the completed template for approval based on approval matrix. Sample as per below;</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:6.61035in;height:0.76474in" /></p>
<p>Once approved, send an email request for a fixed asset creation to GDO Back Office DMT to process the request. A sample email request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image10.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:1.97059in" /></p></td>
</tr>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.21.5</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="create-asset-master-data-and-notify-r2r">Create asset master data and notify R2R</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GDO Back Office DMT</td>
<td>GDO Back Office DMT</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office/ GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office has submitted the request to create a new asset number, GDO Back Office DMT will create the asset shell in ERP system.</p>
<p>GDO Back Office DMT to verify that there is email approval attached by the respective approver, as per Approval Matrix. Sample as per below;</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:6.61035in;height:0.76474in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image10.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:1.97059in" /></p>
<p>Open the Intangible Asset External Capitalisation Template from the attachment in the email request. Make sure the requester has filled out all mandatory fields (with asterisk ‘*’, highlighted in red) are complete in the “Asset Creation Template” tab.</p>
<p>Identify whether the Asset Creation Type is either;</p>
<ol type="a">
<li><p>New Intangible – refer to new asset creation.</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:5.66471in;height:1.18007in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:5.75678in;height:1.05874in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="a">
<li><p>Addition Milestone Payment – refer to new sub-asset creation.</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image6.png" style="width:5.69238in;height:1.20698in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:5.7338in;height:1.07885in" /></p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>New asset creation</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To create asset log in using the T-code AS01 and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:1.63621in;height:0.47917in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the company code and asset numbers as per the request template (the fields “Asset Class” and “Company Code” in “Asset Creation Template” tab. “Number of similar assets” is “1” by default for a single asset creation).</p>
<p>The screen will appear as below while entering the above-mentioned details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:3.30079in;height:2.04505in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the information on the SAP screen as given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:5.82376in;height:3.73897in" /></p>
<p>In case “Description” is too long refer to screenshot below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:5.65765in;height:5.67083in" /></p>
<p>Insert full description and click<img src="media/image15.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.27083in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:3.9068in;height:1.61481in" /></p>
<p>Once clicked <img src="media/image15.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.27083in" />, click Yes before exiting the text.</p>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:3.5in;height:1.34375in" /></p>
<p>A notification appears at the bottom of the page stating, “Text was saved”, per below screenshot:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.07292in;height:4.98958in" /></p>
<p>Continue to “Time-dependent” tab in SAP, fill-in the details as per the template:</p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:5.90564in;height:3.46147in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Deprec. Areas” tab. Depreciation areas show the depreciation information of a fixed asset for the accounting and tax purposes. Complete the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>‘Dkey’: As per template “Depreciation key” field</p></li>
<li><p>‘UseLife’: As per template “Life (In months)” field</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The below screen appears on entering these details:</p>
<p>4. Click Save</p>
<p>After filling out all the information, click <img src="media/image22.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.26042in" /> in above screen to generate asset number in the system. SAP will reflect the Asset number of the asset so generated.</p>
<p><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:6.01181in;height:3.44194in" /></p>
<p>Fill Asset Number into the “Asset Number” field in the “Asset Creation Template” tab AZ External Intangible Asset Creation for recording purposes.</p>
<p><strong><u>Notify the requester and Back Office Fixed Asset team on asset shell completion</u></strong></p>
<p>Attach Intangible Asset External Capitalisation Template into an email to inform the requester, once the asset creation is complete. A sample email confirmation is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.72778in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>New sub- asset creation</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To create asset log in using the T-code AS11 and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image25.png" style="width:2.31441in;height:0.64733in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the following information as per “Asset Creation Template”;</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset Number</p></li>
<li><p>Company Code</p></li>
<li><p>Requested subnumbers</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The screen will appear as below while entering the above-mentioned details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:2.53127in;height:1.39839in" /></p>
<p>The system would auto-prompt information based on stated asset numbers. Check and edit information based on “Asset Creation Template”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:4.52621in;height:3.35189in" /></p>
<p>After validate all the information, click <img src="media/image22.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.26042in" /> in above screen to generate asset number in the system. SAP will reflect the Asset number of the asset so generated.</p>
<p><strong><u>Notify the requester and Back Office R2R Fixed Asset team on asset shell completion</u></strong></p>
<p>Attach Intangible Asset External Capitalisation Template into an email to inform the requester, once the asset creation is complete. A sample email confirmation is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.72778in" /></p></td>
</tr>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.21.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="perform-intangible-asset-addition">Perform intangible asset addition </h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS R2R Back Office</td>
<td>GFS R2R Back Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once asset shell creation done, GFS R2R Back office capitalise the costs to Assets. Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:6.30072in;height:4.262in" /></p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive and validate request to capitalise asset.</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code AS03 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:1.25017in;height:0.44798in" /></p>
<p>Enter the asset number (field “Asset Number”) and the company code (field “Company Code”) as in the “Asset Creation Template” tab to check its details. Press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image30.png" style="width:3.78547in;height:1.7643in" /></p>
<p>Check the asset details is as per form.</p>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.36319in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.20347in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image31.png" style="width:4.87529in;height:2.68366in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image32.png" style="width:4.88206in;height:1.78693in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image33.png" style="width:5.47791in;height:2.31255in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check transactional foreign currency rate used for capitalisation. Sample as below:</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Asset 800041 value needs to be reported in USD &amp; SEK Currency.</p>
<p>Check Local currency value (SEK) if converted using correct rate from <a href="https://azcollaboration.sharepoint.com/sites/TSC235/Pages/CurrencyRates.aspx?OR=Teams-HL&amp;CT=1659519416434&amp;clickparams=eyJBcHBOYW1lIjoiVGVhbXMtRGVza3RvcCIsIkFwcFZlcnNpb24iOiIyNy8yMjA3MDMwMDgxNCIsIkhhc0ZlZGVyYXRlZFVzZXIiOmZhbHNlfQ%3D%3D">AZ FX Rate website</a>.</p>
<ol type="i">
<li><p>If current month rate provided in form – No action required.</p></li>
<li><p>If prior/ different month rate provided in form – Processor need to check with business.</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image34.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:2.40486in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Capitalise value to asset shell</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>D i) Asset class 8200 &amp; 8000 with local currency</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Enter T-code AB01 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image35.png" style="width:5.02292in;height:1.39925in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Key in below details based on the form</u></strong></p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Company Code : IE30</p></li>
<li><p>Asset : 800009</p></li>
<li><p>Subnumber : 0</p></li>
<li><p>Document Date : Actual Day</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Date : Actual Day</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Period : Reporting Month</p></li>
<li><p>Transaction Type : 100</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image36.png" style="width:4.58384in;height:2.46339in" /></p>
<p>Click enter.</p>
<p>Fill in below details based on form:-</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Amount posted: As per form “Value of the Asset in local currency” field</p></li>
<li><p>Offsetting acct: As per form “GL -where the final Credit impact of this” field</p></li>
<li><p>Text: As per form “Name of the Asset” field</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image37.png" style="width:4.83765in;height:2.86213in" /></p>
<p>Click on line items to have overview of Posted Areas</p>
<p><img src="media/image38.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.16042in" /></p>
<p>Click on <img src="media/image39.png" style="width:0.24841in;height:0.23599in" /></p>
<p>Ensure cost center for credit GL follow as per form</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.975in" /></p>
<p>Saved (Ctrl+S) to save the transaction.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>D ii) Asset class 8200 &amp; 8000 with foreign currency</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong><u>Key in below details based on the form</u></strong></p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Company Code : IE30</p></li>
<li><p>Asset : 800009</p></li>
<li><p>Subnumber : 0</p></li>
<li><p>Document Date : Actual Day</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Date : Actual Day</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Period : Reporting Month</p></li>
<li><p>Transaction Type : 100</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image41.png" style="width:4.13913in;height:1.84796in" /></p>
<p>Fill in below details based on form:-</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Amount posted: As per form “Value of the Asset in local currency” field</p></li>
<li><p>Offsetting acct: <mark>F1100200</mark></p></li>
<li><p>Text: As per form “Name of the Asset” field</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image42.png" style="width:4.30527in;height:2.52477in" /></p>
<p>Click on line items to have overview of Posted Areas</p>
<p><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:5.1249in;height:2.72425in" /></p>
<p>Click on <img src="media/image39.png" style="width:0.24841in;height:0.23599in" /></p>
<p>Ensure cost center for credit GL follow as per form</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.png" style="width:5.21291in;height:3.16658in" /></p>
<p>Saved (Ctrl+S) to save the transaction.</p>
<p><strong><u>Post manual entry through Blackline journal</u></strong></p>
<p>This step is required when there is foreign currency for asset capitalisation.</p>
<p>Fill in below in Blackline template Header Section.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Reason code:</p></li>
<li><p>Approved exception: Depends on the threshold of the journal</p></li>
<li><p>Company code: IE30</p></li>
<li><p>Document Date: Actual Day</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Date: Actual Day</p></li>
<li><p>Period: Closing period</p></li>
<li><p>Document currency: Based on foreign currency in capitalisation form</p></li>
<li><p>Doc Header Reference: “Asset name – FA intangible”</p></li>
<li><p>Doc Header Text: “ Asset Name”</p></li>
<li><p>Calculate Tax Automatically: Yes</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image44.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:0.45069in" /></p>
<p>Fill in below in Blackline template Line Section</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Fill in below in Blackline template Line Section</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Key &amp; Account: 40-F1100200; 50-Credit GL provided in form</p></li>
<li><p>Amount in Document currency: Foreign currency amount provided in form</p></li>
<li><p>Amount in Local currency: Document currency amount converted based on rate provided in form</p></li>
<li><p>Item Text: Project XXX – FA intangible posting – MMM’YY</p></li>
<li><p>Cost center &amp; Profit center: Based on asset cost center provided in form</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image45.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:0.77222in" /></p>
<p>Upload to Blackline</p>
<p><em>Note: Attached all supporting documents (for example – Journal template, AIN, approval of intangible form, Intangible form etc)</em></p>
<p><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:1.43889in" /></p>
<p>Certify journal for approval</p>
<p>Document number will be showing in Blackline as below after journal approved.</p>
<p><img src="media/image47.png" style="width:6.07485in;height:2.09449in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>D iii) Asset class 8260 with foreign &amp; local currency</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Enter T-code ABZON</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:1.47611in;height:0.62702in" /></p>
<p>Fill in below details: -</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Company code:</p></li>
<li><p>Existing Asset: As per form asset shell provided</p></li>
<li><p>Document date, Posting Date, Asset Value</p></li>
<li><p>Amount Posted: Local currency amount based on rate provided</p></li>
<li><p>Text: EXTERNAL CAP – PROJECT XXX – Date received</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image49.png" style="width:5.86147in;height:3.19528in" /></p>
<p>Click: Additional Details</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Posting Period: Reporting Month</p></li>
<li><p>Document Type: AA (Asset Accounting)</p></li>
<li><p>Offsetting acct no: 60400980 (<em>Required: Global Books Only)</em></p></li>
<li><p>Transaction Type: Z50</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:3.74931in" /></p>
<p>Click on Stimulation <img src="media/image51.png" style="width:0.2462in;height:0.19855in" /> to generate accounting entries.</p>
<p>Click: Save <img src="media/image52.png" style="width:0.20257in;height:0.19604in" /></p>
<p>Fill in below in Blackline template Header Section</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Record Type</p></li>
<li><p>Reason Code: Fixed Asset Accounting</p></li>
<li><p>Approved Exception: No</p></li>
<li><p>Company Code: SE10</p></li>
<li><p>Document date, Posting date</p></li>
<li><p>Period: Current reporting month</p></li>
<li><p>Document currency: Foreign currency</p></li>
<li><p>Doc Header Reference: Project XXX – FA intangible capitalization</p></li>
<li><p>Doc Header Text: Project XXX</p></li>
<li><p>Calculate Tax: Yes</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image53.png" style="width:7.52961in;height:0.53749in" /></p>
<p>Fill in below in Blackline template Line Section</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Posting Key &amp; Account: 40-61100400; 50-Credit GL provided in form</p></li>
<li><p>Amount in Document currency: Foreign currency amount provided in form</p></li>
<li><p>Amount in Local currency: Document currency amount converted based on rate provided in form</p></li>
<li><p>Item Text: Project XXX – FA intangible posting – MMM’YY</p></li>
<li><p>Cost center &amp; Profit center: Based on asset cost center provided in form</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image54.png" style="width:7.31525in;height:0.68234in" /></p>
<p>Upload to Blackline</p>
<p><em>Note: Attached all supporting documents (for example – Journal template, AIN, approval of intangible form, Intangible form etc)</em></p>
<p><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:1.43889in" /></p>
<p>Certify journal for approval.</p>
<p>Document number will be showing in Blackline as below after journal approved.</p>
<p><img src="media/image47.png" style="width:5.90435in;height:1.54345in" /></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="4">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.21.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="review-document-posted">Review document posted </h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office /R2R Back Office</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office / R2R Back Office checks and reviews the posting done in SAP.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Document posted</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code FB03</p>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:5.14815in;height:2.24381in" /></p>
<p>Input document number posted through AB01 transaction.</p>
<p><img src="media/image56.png" style="width:4.23939in;height:2.06143in" /></p>
<p>Check and review the posting: -</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Credit GL as per form</p></li>
<li><p>Cost center &amp; profit center as per form</p></li>
<li><p>Amount &amp; transaction currency as per form</p></li>
<li><p>Period posted as per form</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image57.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.12222in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Asset value posted in depreciation area</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code AW01N</p>
<p><img src="media/image58.png" style="width:4.32296in;height:2.04243in" /></p>
<p>Key in company code and asset number based on capitalisation form.</p>
<p>Check amount posted in respective depreciation area based on capitalisation form.</p>
<p><u>Local book (01)</u></p>
<p><img src="media/image59.png" style="width:4.62397in;height:2.28651in" /></p>
<p><u>Group Book (20)</u></p>
<p><img src="media/image60.png" style="width:4.88596in;height:2.98716in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.21.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="periodic-asset-postings">Periodic Asset Postings</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS R2R Back Office</td>
<td>GFS R2R Back Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>This step is only required for entities that have SAP reporting setting for two different accounting standards requirements ie;</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Group Book – International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)</p></li>
<li><p>Local Book – Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Currently, only certain companies code in EUSAP and APAC region have the setting.</p>
<p>After ensuring all details are correct, GFS R2R Back Office need to run asset periodic posting to post the posting from local book to Group book. These steps need to be done once posting done AND before FA sub-ledger closed to ensure posting reflected in Group book financial statement.</p>
<p>Enter T-code ASKB</p>
<p><img src="media/image61.png" style="width:3.09411in;height:1.33285in" /></p>
<p>Enter below parameter: -</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Company code: IE30</p></li>
<li><p>Tick List assets &amp; List Direct Items</p></li>
<li><p>Tick Test Run</p></li>
<li><p>Tick Standard posting run</p></li>
<li><p>Execute <img src="media/image62.png" style="width:0.18752in;height:0.19889in" /> (F8)</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:6.21176in;height:2.68132in" /></p>
<p>Ensure there is no error during test run</p>
<p>If there is no error during test run, proceed to Actual run</p>
<p>Enter below parameter: -</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Company code: IE30</p></li>
<li><p>Tick List assets &amp; List Direct Items</p></li>
<li><p>Untick Test Run</p></li>
<li><p>Tick Standard posting run</p></li>
<li><p>Select Program – Execute in Background</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image64.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.84028in" /></p>
<p>Once execute in Background, check if the periodic posting run completed successfully without error.</p>
<p>Enter T-code AFBP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image65.png" style="width:4.70027in;height:2.1359in" /></p>
<p>Enter below parameter: -</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Company code: IE30</p></li>
<li><p>Fiscal Year: Closing year</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Period: Closing period</p></li>
<li><p>Tick SchedMan Monitor &amp; Lists Assets</p></li>
<li><p>Execute <img src="media/image66.png" style="width:0.1865in;height:0.14454in" /> (F8)</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image67.png" style="width:5.41857in;height:2.80043in" /></p>
<p>Check on Periodic Asset Postings under Enteries found</p>
<p>Ensure Updated show in screen and status completed as “ Processing completed without errors”</p>
<p>Document number will generate as below screenshot.</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.42292in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Check posting to Group book</u></strong></p>
<p>Enter T-code FB03</p>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:4.47186in;height:1.94905in" /></p>
<p>Enter document number and company code in parameter</p>
<p><img src="media/image69.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.42292in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image70.png" style="width:5.68054in;height:2.18951in" /></p>
<p>Click Enter</p>
<p>Ensure posting posted to Group book GL (Non-Alphanumeric GL)</p>
<p><img src="media/image71.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.52708in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<col style="width: 25%" />

<thead>
<tr>

<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.21.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="informed-business-for-completing-activities">Informed business for completing activities</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS R2R Back Office</td>
<td>GFS R2R Back Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once GFS R2R Back Office completed capitalisation, GFS R2R Back Office informed requestor the posting done with screenshot and evidence supporting in capitalisation form.</p>
<p>A sample resolved email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image72.png" style="width:6.02003in;height:3.49779in" /></p></td>
</tr>

### Disposal or Retirement

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<img src="media/image73.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:4.70694in" />

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 26%" />
<col style="width: 23%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.23.1</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="request-intangible-asset-disposal-or-retirement">Request Intangible Asset disposal or retirement</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>The process for Intangible retirement begins when there is a need to decommission / sell / transfer / retire an Intangible Asset. The Business sends a request via email for asset retirement or transfer and attaches relevant supporting documents required to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office. The request should include the following information:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed Asset Number</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Sample email request for asset retirement:</p>
<p><img src="media/image74.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.86875in" /></p>
<p>Upon receiving the request Embedded Finance or GFS Middle Office requires to identify whether the Entity is maintaining Intangible Asset via subledger. If the entity do not have Subledger setting, Business, Embedded Finance or GFS Middle Office require to raised manual journal and follow <a href="https://azcollaboration.sharepoint.com/:w:/r/sites/AZ150/_layouts/15/Doc.aspx?sourcedoc=%7BE2E8E087-6194-4537-9502-EB24561BEAC0%7D&amp;file=AZ%20Global%20General%20Ledger%20Journal%20Entry%20Standard.docx&amp;action=default&amp;mobileredirect=true">AZ Global Manual Journal Entry.</a></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 15%" />
<col style="width: 27%" />
<col style="width: 18%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.23.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="complete-asset-retirement-template">Complete Asset Retirement Template</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once the Business has requested an asset retirement, the Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office needs to complete the Assets Retirement Request Template with supporting documents, including following information of the retiring asset;</p>
<ul>
<li><p>the Net Book Value (NBV)</p></li>
<li><p>Type of Retirement</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Retirement Effective Date</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Centre to be used</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image75.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.92153in" /></p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check the NBV of assets</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The SAP report can be generated by executing T-code “AS03” to open single asset balance and T-code “S_ALR_87011963” to review multiple open asset balances information.</p>
<p><strong>B.1) <u>To check Single Asset Balance</u></strong></p>
<p>Login to SAP following the instructions as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image76.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Enter SAP T-code AS03.<img src="media/image77.png" style="width:5.27945in;height:1.84406in" /></p>
<p>Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template, press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image78.png" style="width:5.02125in;height:1.67777in" /></p>
<p>The below screen appears displaying the Asset Master Data. Verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Asset number</p></li>
<li><p>Asset description</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Capitalization Date</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image79.png" style="width:0.21909in;height:0.1043in" /><img src="media/image80.png" style="width:4.65674in;height:3.71944in" /></p>
<p>Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the asset’s NBV.</p>
<p><img src="media/image81.png" style="width:4.42426in;height:1.7742in" /></p>
<p>Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both the values are same.</p>
<p><img src="media/image83.png" style="width:6.24721in;height:3.65365in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>B.2) <u>To check balance for Multiple Assets</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Enter SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image84.png" style="width:4.26978in;height:1.66296in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the parameters as mentioned below:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code - As per the request</p></li>
<li><p>Input asset numbers by selecting <img src="media/image85.png" style="width:0.24238in;height:0.18765in" /> and input asset number as per template</p></li>
<li><p>Report date – input the last month end date of the last depreciation run.</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation area – input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation</p></li>
<li><p>Sort variant - 0001</p></li>
<li><p>Select List assets</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click on the “Execute” button <img src="media/image86.png" style="width:0.23958in;height:0.20833in" /> or press “F8” to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.73542in;height:0.10417in" /><img src="media/image79.png" style="width:0.24306in;height:0.11528in" /><img src="media/image90.png" /><img src="media/image92.png" style="width:5.86111in;height:3.55139in" /></p>
<p>Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”</p>
<p><img src="media/image93.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.31806in" /></p>
<p>Using the information above, verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Asset number</p></li>
<li><p>Asset description</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Capitalization Date</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Acquisition Value</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all evidence is gathered, the template needs to be authorized by the delegated DOA. Assets Retirement approver must have 2003 DOA Authority (Capital Expenditure and Asset Disposal). Please check DOA Portal through this <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_afrWindowMode=0&amp;_afrLoop=263310020079381&amp;_adf.ctrl-state=y2d8rrhst_4">link</a>.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.23.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="obtain-approvals-as-per-doa">Obtain approvals as per DOA</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Business / GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Before an asset retirement can take place, the requester must submit the template with supporting documents to the appropriate approver according to DOA. Please check DOA Portal through this <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_afrWindowMode=0&amp;_afrLoop=263310020079381&amp;_adf.ctrl-state=y2d8rrhst_4">link</a>.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Request for approval for asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office requests the review and approval as per Delegations Standard Limits from Global DOA framework. A sample email approval request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image98.jpeg" /></p>
<p>If approved, an email approval will be sent by the respective approver, as per DOA 2003, as illustrated below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.jpeg" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Raise Service Now ticket request for an asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once the approval is obtained raise Service Now for the asset retirement to GFS Back Office R2R FA team via this <a href="https://azprod.service-now.com/askaz?id=askaz_sc_category&amp;bf=Finance&amp;sys_id=02d9c6531b3d74d005a0a821ec4bcb01">link</a>.</p>
<p>A sample request for an asset retirement as per the screenshot below:</p>
<p>Click “Request to R2R Back Office Team”</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:5.16111in;height:3.57353in" /></p>
<p>Tick “Raise for Myself’ if raising for self. If not, search the requestor’s name from the dropdown list. Complete the mandotory fiels (in *asterisks).</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:5.16656in;height:2.94399in" /></p>
<p>Select *Tower as “CAPEX” and *Task as “Asset Disposal”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image104.png" style="width:5.1904in;height:2.2088in" /></p>
<p>Once all fields updated and add “Assets Retirement Global Template” at the attachment, click “Submit”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:2.19547in;height:1.85771in" /></p>
<p>System generates a Finance Request number for reported query and assigns ticket to GFS Back Office R2R FA team for further action.</p>
<p><img src="media/image106.png" style="width:4.73069in;height:2.34601in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 0%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="5">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.23.5</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h4 id="execute-transactions-to-retire-asset">Execute transactions to retire asset</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If the transfer is between legal entities, GFS Back Office R2R will execute the transaction to retire the asset in the transferring entity.</p>
<p>Please ensure that you perform control CPX008 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retrieve template from Service Now request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The GFS Back Office R2R FA team will access the Assets Retirement Request Template from the Service Now via <a href="https://azprod.service-now.com/nav_to.do?uri=%2Faz_home.do">link</a>:</p>
<p><img src="media/image107.png" style="width:6.30585in;height:1.07006in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image108.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.225in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Open Assets Retirement Request Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Open the Assets Retirement Request Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the request (marked with “*”, and red font colour as per “Instructions” tab in the request Template) are complete.</p>
<p>The Assets Retirement Request Template is pictured below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image109.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.90139in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify approver against Global DOA</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Verify that there is email approval by the respective approver, as per DOA 2003, for the retirement of asset as illustrated below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image110.png" style="width:4.89771in;height:3.14819in" /></p>
<p>Ensure that the retirement is approved by the appropriate DOA. Please access Global DOA by using this <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4">link</a>.</p>
<p>Click on the “Country” drop-down in the Search bar for the relevant requester’s country. Next, select the activity code “2003 – CAPITAL EXPENDITURE &amp; DISPOSAL” and click on “Search”.</p>
<p>A list of approvers will then appear as the screenshot below. From the list, verify the name of the expected approver against the above approver’s email screenshot. In addition, also verify that the Asset’s amount is with the approver’s authority.</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:6.18194in;height:4.31319in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D36AB0.3CA5BF00" /></p>
<p>If the approval is not given by the appropriate approver / invalid approval, query back to the requester. A sample email query is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image112.png" style="width:3.51042in;height:4.39583in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Validate information in the Assets Retirement Request Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Log into SAP system to verify that data in the Assets Retirement Request Template is complete and accurate.</p>
<p><img src="media/image113.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Use SAP T-code “AS03” to display Asset master data for single Asset and T-code “S_ALR_87011963” for displaying master data for multiple assets.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>D.1) <u>Display Single Asset Master Data</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>To display the asset master data, execute SAP T-code AS03 and press “Enter”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image77.png" style="width:6.27204in;height:2.13103in" /></p>
<p>Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance, press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image78.png" style="width:5.02125in;height:1.67777in" /></p>
<p>The below screen appears displaying the Asset details: -</p>
<p><img src="media/image80.png" style="width:4.65744in;height:3.72in" /></p>
<p>Under the tab “General” and in the “Capitalized on” field, the Capitalized Date can be found.</p>
<p>Ensure that asset has not already been retired by making sure that the “Deactivated on” field has been left blank.</p>
<p><img src="media/image80.png" style="width:4.65744in;height:3.72in" /></p>
<p>Verify the asset cost centre by clicking on the “Time-dependent” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image114.png" style="width:6.23958in;height:5.38542in" /></p>
<p>Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the Asset’s NBV:</p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:6.21254in;height:3.14882in" /></p>
<p>Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both values are the same:</p>
<p><img src="media/image116.png" style="width:0.92454in" /><img src="media/image118.jpg" style="width:6.22255in;height:3.63093in" /></p>
<p><strong>D.2) <u>Display Master Data for Multiple Assets</u></strong></p>
<p>Enter SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image119.png" style="width:5.32137in;height:2.03478in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D54302.89351290" /></p>
<p>Fill in the parameters including:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Input asset numbers by selecting <img src="media/image85.png" style="width:0.24238in;height:0.18765in" /> and input asset number as per template</p></li>
<li><p>Report date – input the last month end date of the last depreciation run</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation area – input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation</p></li>
<li><p>Sort variant - 0001</p></li>
<li><p>Select List assets</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click on the “Execute” button or press “F8” to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image120.png" style="width:4.83119in;height:3.68164in" /></p>
<p>Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”</p>
<p><img src="media/image93.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.31806in" /></p>
<p>Click on the requisite asset / assets to view the asset details. Choose the asset and double click on the Asset number to view details.</p>
<p>Next, verify that the Asset Class and Asset’s Description match the details in the template.</p>
<p>In case of any discrepancy, send a query to the requester. Sample email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image121.png" style="width:5.125in;height:2.96875in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retire asset in system</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all the necessary information has been verified, proceed to retire the asset via SAP T-code ABAVN:</p>
<p><img src="media/image122.png" style="width:4.6208in;height:1.62835in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.1) <u>Enter company code in system</u></strong></p>
<p>SAP automatically populates the Company Code. If it is incorrect, click on the “Change company code” button <img src="media/image123.png" style="width:1.56528in;height:0.2in" /> to change it in the pop-up window.</p>
<p><img src="media/image124.png" style="width:6.21736in;height:3.95625in" /></p>
<p>It is important to ensure that the Company Code is correct as the system allows the same asset number to be created under different company codes.</p>
<p><strong>F.2) <u>Key in Asset number</u></strong></p>
<p>For single asset retirement, key in the Asset number into the “Asset” field:</p>
<p><img src="media/image125.png" style="width:6.17361in;height:2.63472in" /></p>
<p>For multiple asset retirements, click on “Multiple Assets”. Note: This step is to be performed only in case of multiple asset retirements and below screenshot details does not match with template given above. If there are no multiple asset retirements, please move on to <strong>F.3) Key in details relating to Asset Date</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="media/image126.png" style="width:6.19097in;height:1.59097in" /></p>
<p>There will be a place under the “List of Assets” section for the user to fill in the list of assets to be retired. After keying in the list of assets, press Enter. The assets’ descriptions will automatically populate into the table.</p>
<p><img src="media/image127.png" style="width:6.20329in;height:4.65in" /></p>
<p>Only six assets can be keyed in at a time. After the first six assets’ descriptions have been auto-populated (by pressing Enter), scroll down to key in the next six asset numbers, if any.</p>
<p><strong>F.3) <u>Key in details relating to Asset Date</u></strong></p>
<p>In the “Transaction Data” tab, key in the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Document Date” – input the date when the item is processed</p></li>
<li><p>“Posting Date” – input the date when the item is processed</p></li>
<li><p>“Asset Value Date” – input the Asset Retirement Effective Date as per the workitem</p></li>
<li><p>“Text” – input “Asset Retirement”.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image128.png" style="width:6.17727in;height:2.78in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.4) <u>Fill in additional details</u></strong></p>
<p>In the “Additional Details” tab, key in the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Posting Period” – input the month, in numeric value, e.g. “5”</p></li>
<li><p>“Document Type” – input the type “AA”</p></li>
<li><p>“Reference” – input “company code and the date of the request”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image129.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:5.52083in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.5) <u>Simulate the posting</u></strong></p>
<p>Next, click on the Simulate button <img src="media/image130.png" style="width:0.15625in;height:0.15625in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image131.png" style="width:6.16589in;height:2.42in" /></p>
<p>After clicking on Simulate, a list of double entries will appear. Review the GL account and the amount to ensure that the simulated posting is correct:</p>
<p><img src="media/image132.png" style="width:6.30778in;height:3.77918in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.6) <u>Successful posting of the asset retirement</u></strong></p>
<p>Once posted, a notification will be shown at the bottom of the screen, e.g. “Asset transaction posted with document no. CN20 0100007120”. This indicates that the asset has been successfully retired.</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:6.50811in;height:4.94in" /></p>
<ol start="6" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify that asset retirement is being posted</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check if the asset is posted successfully in the system by going back to SAP T-code AS03 to display the asset master data. If successful, the asset will be updated with a Deactivation Date:</p>
<p><img src="media/image134.png" style="width:4.82293in;height:3.84751in" /></p>
<p>As for Asset Values, the NBV will now be blank to show that the asset no longer has any value. There will also be a new transaction below showing the retirement.</p>
<p><img src="media/image135.png" style="width:6.03396in;height:3in" /></p>
<p>To display the document details, access the SAP with the T-code FB03. Then key in the following fields and press “Enter”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Document Number – input the posting document number</p></li>
<li><p>Company Code – input the relevant company code</p></li>
<li><p>Fiscal Year – input the current year</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image136.png" style="width:6.0861in;height:2.21025in" /></p>
<p>If the retirement posting exists, the data entry view for that particular document will open as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image137.png" style="width:6.0023in;height:2.09in" /></p>
<ol start="7" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Notify the requester on request completion</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To inform the requester about the successful asset retirement transaction by using Resolution Template for “FA Disposal”, example as per below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image138.png" style="width:4.34698in;height:2.56378in" /></p>
<p>Click Resolved.</p>
<p><img src="media/image139.png" style="width:5.02603in;height:1.90377in" /></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td colspan="4"><h4 id="receive-confirmation-that-asset-has-been-retired">Receive confirmation that asset has been retired</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>

<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once the request is complete, notify Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office that the asset master data amendment by GDO Back Office DMT or the retirement of the asset by GFS Back Office R2R is complete.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive asset retirement notification</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>An email confirmation of the asset retirement will be sent to the requester once GDO Back Office DMT or GFS Back Office R2R close the request.</p>
<p><img src="media/image140.png" style="width:5.5878in;height:4.84797in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check of asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check in SAP to see if the retirement is complete. To display the asset master data log into SAP and execute SAP T-code “AS03”. Next, fill in the ‘Asset’ number, the “Subnumber” (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective “Company Code”.</p>
<p>Then, click on “Asset values”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image141.png" style="width:0.42969in;height:0.19359in" /><img src="media/image142.png" style="width:1.29523in;height:0.17089in" /><img src="media/image143.png" style="width:5.01042in;height:3.09375in" /></p>
<p>The following screen will appear. An asset retirement will be indicated there.</p>
<p><img src="media/image141.png" style="width:0.16643in" /><img src="media/image144.png" style="width:6.48109in;height:3.06in" /></p></td>
</tr>

### Amortisation

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<img src="media/image145.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:3.42361in" />

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 12%" />

<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="initiate-amortisation">Initiate Amortisation</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>

<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>All fixed asset posting requests needs to be sent to GFS Back Office R2R as part of the pre-closing activities. Prior to month end close, an initial depreciation test run is conducted at mid-month to help identify if there are any issues / errors to ensure resolution is in place.</p>
<p><strong>Obtain all asset postings:</strong> Business to request asset transactions on or before the deadline as per the Global Close Calendar Standard. All postings received by the request deadline will need to be processed by the GFS Back Office, prior to the asset posting deadline as per GCC. This covers requests for intangible asset acquisition, retirement, disposal and impairment.</p>
<p>Execute the amortisation by referring to <strong>SOPs 8.3.3.6 Calculate and Record Depreciation Expense - Global.</strong></p></td>
</tr>

### Impairment

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<img src="media/image146.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:4.68472in" />

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 1%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
<col style="width: 2%" />
<col style="width: 23%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="6">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.25.1</strong></td>
<td colspan="6"><h4 id="initiate-impairment">Initiate Impairment</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Responsible</td>
<td colspan="2">Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Business</td>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="7"><p>Business initiates the request for creation of a new impairment to Embedded Finance or GFS Middle Office by providing the signed document of Legal Contract or AIN.</p>
<p>AIN document is only applicable to deal value more than USD10 million.</p>
<p>Sample email as per below;</p>
<p><img src="media/image147.png" style="width:6.62767in;height:2.88765in" /></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="6">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.25.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="6"><h4 id="obtain-approvals-as-per-doa-1">Obtain approvals as per DOA</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td colspan="2">Accountable</td>
<td colspan="2">Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td colspan="2">N/A</td>
<td>Business / GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="7"><p>Before an asset impairment can take place, the requester must submit the template with supporting documents to the appropriate approver according to DOA. Please check DOA Portal through this <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_afrWindowMode=0&amp;_afrLoop=263310020079381&amp;_adf.ctrl-state=y2d8rrhst_4">link</a>.</p>
<p><strong><u>Request for approval for asset impairment</u></strong></p>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office requests the review and approval as per Delegations Standard Limits from Global DOA framework. A sample email approval request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image148.png" style="width:5.74231in;height:5.02538in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image149.png" style="width:5.77778in;height:3.16041in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Raise Service Now ticket request for an asset impairment</u></strong></p>
<p>Once the approval is obtained raise Service Now for the asset impairment to GFS Back Office R2R FA team via this <a href="https://azprod.service-now.com/askaz?id=askaz_sc_category&amp;bf=Finance&amp;sys_id=02d9c6531b3d74d005a0a821ec4bcb01">link</a>.</p>
<p>A sample request for an asset impairmentt as per the screenshot below:</p>
<p>Click “Request to R2R Back Office Team”</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:5.16111in;height:3.57353in" /></p>
<p>Tick “Raise for Myself’ if raising for self. If not, search the requestor’s name from the dropdown list. Complete the mandotory fiels (in *asterisks).</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:5.16656in;height:2.94399in" /></p>
<p>Select *Tower as “CAPEX” and *Task as “Asset Impairment”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image150.png" style="width:5.16342in;height:2.24155in" /></p>
<p>Once all fields updated and add “Assets Impairment Global Template” at the attachment, click “Submit”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:2.19547in;height:1.85771in" /></p>
<p>System generates a Finance Request number for reported query and assigns ticket to GFS Back Office R2R FA team for further action.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.25.5</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h4 id="impair-asset-using-unplanned-depreciation">Impair Asset using unplanned depreciation</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office has submitted the request, GFS Back Office R2R will impair the asset in ERP system.</p>
<p>The GFS Back Office R2R FA team access the Assets Impairment Request Template from the Service Now via <a href="https://azprod.service-now.com/nav_to.do?uri=%2Faz_home.do">link</a>. Open the ticket and assign to yourself</p>
<p><img src="media/image151.png" style="width:6.6324in;height:1.42458in" />.</p>
<p><strong><u>Open Assets Impairment Request Template</u></strong></p>
<p>Open the Assets Impairment Request Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the request (marked with “*”, and red font colour as per “Instructions” tab in the request Template) are complete.</p>
<p>The Assets Impairment Request Template is pictured below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image152.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.14792in" /></p>
<p>GFS Back Office R2R needs to check the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>The information in the template matches the supporting documents provided,</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For value related impairment, the calculation provided in the supporting document tab should match the impairment value.</p></li>
<li><p>The screenshot of the depreciation schedule provided should match the depreciation used in the calculation provided in the supporting document tab.</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>The total impairment value (in case of value related impairment) or financial impact (in case of time related impairment) is less than or equal to the NBV of the asset at the impairment posting date (as provided in the impairment request form).</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><u>Verify approver against Global DOA</u></strong></p>
<p>Verify that there is email approval by the respective approver, as per DOA 2003, for the impairment of asset as illustrated below:</p>
<p>Ensure that the impairment t is approved by the appropriate DOA. Please access Global DOA by using this <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4">link</a>.</p>
<p>Click on the “Country” drop-down in the Search bar for the relevant requester’s country. Next, select the activity code “2003 – CAPITAL EXPENDITURE &amp; DISPOSAL” and click on “Search”.</p>
<p>A list of approvers will then appear as the screenshot below. From the list, verify the name of the expected approver against the above approver’s email screenshot. In addition, also verify that the Asset’s amount is with the approver’s authority.</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:6.18194in;height:4.31319in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D36AB0.3CA5BF00" /></p>
<p>If the approval is not given by the appropriate approver / invalid approval, query back to the requester.</p>
<p><strong><u>Validate information in the Assets Impairment Request Template</u></strong></p>
<p>Log into SAP system to verify that data in the Assets Impairment Request Template is complete and accurate.</p>
<p><img src="media/image113.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Display Single Asset Master Data</u></strong></p>
<p>To display the asset master data, execute SAP T-code AS03 and press “Enter”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image77.png" style="width:6.27204in;height:2.13103in" /></p>
<p>Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance, press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image78.png" style="width:5.02125in;height:1.67777in" /></p>
<p>The below screen appears displaying the Asset details: -</p>
<p><img src="media/image80.png" style="width:4.65744in;height:3.72in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Impair asset using unplanned Depreciation</u></strong></p>
<p>Open SAP, input T-code ABAA and click enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image153.png" style="width:3.25787in;height:1.12934in" /></p>
<p>Create asset transactions by entering the following as per the template:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code</p></li>
<li><p>Asset number</p></li>
<li><p>Asset subnumber (if required)</p></li>
<li><p>Document date (Impairment posting date)</p></li>
<li><p>Posting date (Impairment posting date)</p></li>
<li><p>Posting period (Period as per impairment posting date)</p></li>
<li><p>Transaction Type: Select transaction type according to acquisition year</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>640</strong> Unplanned depreciation on prior-year acquisition</p>
<p><strong>650</strong> Unplanned depreciation on current-year acquisition.</p>
<p>Update the details from the template to SAP sreen will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image154.png" style="width:6.77013in;height:1.67151in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image155.png" style="width:3.77172in;height:2.3244in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image156.png" style="width:3.79685in;height:3.42816in" /></p>
<p>Click on green tick <img src="media/image157.png" style="width:0.1929in;height:0.18085in" /> or press Enter.</p>
<p><strong><u>Successful posting of the asset impairment</u></strong></p>
<p>Once posted, a notification will be shown at the bottom of the screen. e.g. “Asset transaction posted with document no. UK10 0100007120”. This indicates that the asset has been successfully impaired.</p>
<p><img src="media/image158.png" style="width:6.71564in;height:6.83499in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Notify the requester on request completion</u></strong></p>
<p>To inform the requester about the successful asset impairment transaction by using Resolution Template for “FA Impairment”, example as per below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image159.png" style="width:5.86166in;height:2.65024in" /></p>
<p>Click Resolved.</p>
<p><img src="media/image139.png" style="width:5.02603in;height:1.90377in" /></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>

<td colspan="5"></td>
<td></td>
</tr>

<td colspan="4"><h4 id="receive-confirmation-that-asset-has-been-impaired">Receive confirmation that asset has been impaired</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td colspan="5"><p>Once the request is complete, notify Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office that the asset master data amendment by GDO Back Office DMT or the impairment of the asset by GFS Back Office R2R is complete.</p>
<p><strong><u>Receive asset impairment notification</u></strong></p>

### Interco Transfer

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<img src="media/image160.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:4.70069in" />

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 26%" />
<col style="width: 23%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.22.1</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h4 id="request-intangible-asset-transfer-between-entities">Request intangible asset transfer between entities</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Business initiates the request for creation of Intangible Asset Interco Transfer to Embedded Finance or GFS Middle Office by providing the Legal Contract or AIN document.</p>
<p>AIN document is only applicable to deal value more than USD10 million.</p>
<p>Sample email which is from Project Moon on November 2022 is given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image161.png" style="width:5.91143in;height:3.2124in" /></p>
<p>Business is required to provide some guidance from AIN or Legal document to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office on information required for Transferor (Selling Entity) and Transferee (Buying Entity).</p>
<p><strong><u>Transferor (Selling Entity)</u></strong></p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Asset to be transferred is relating to which existing Intangible Asset (IP License)</p></li>
<li><p>The amount of the deal that reflect as gross to be transferred (ie Cost and Accumulated Depreciation)</p></li>
<li><p>Expected exchange currency to be used if the local entity currency is not in USD</p></li>
<li><p>Date of disposal or retirement of the assets</p></li>
<li><p>The remaining useful life</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Centre to be used</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong><u>Transferee (Buying Entity)</u></strong></p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Whether this is a new project or addition milestone</p></li>
<li><p>The gross amount to be received and as capitalised as Cost with Accumulated Depreciation</p></li>
<li><p>Expected exchange currency to be used if the local entity currency is not in USD</p></li>
<li><p>Date of acquisition</p></li>
<li><p>If the asset required amortisation. If yes, how long would be the expected useful life.</p></li>
<li><p>The date of the project would end whether this requires a revised.</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Centre to be used</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Sample of the AIN is as per below;</p>
<p><img src="media/image162.png" style="width:5.92791in;height:7.04265in" /></p></td>

<td><strong>8.3.3.22.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h4 id="raise-intercompany-request">Raise InterCompany Request</h4></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R, GFR Consolidation Team, GFR Technical team.</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R, GFR Consolidation Team, GFR Technical team.</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Upon receiving request from Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office is required to work together with Business, GFR Consolidation Team and GFR Technical team on understanding the content of the AIN/Legal document and any GAAP requirement. Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will execute to transfer asset between legal entities in AZ, and need to follow as per <strong>AZ Global Intercompany Standard</strong> documented in Finance Library.</p>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office to prepare the expected Journal Entries and obtain an agreement with GFR Consolidation team or GFR Technical team.</p>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office to issue NTI (Non-Trade Intercompany Transactions) from Transferor (Selling Entity) to Transferee (Buying Entity) in NINTEX (Refer process <strong>8.3.2.47 Intercompany Recharges</strong> for details).</p>
<p>From <strong>selling entity</strong> perspective, two steps are needed:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Retire the assets retirement by referring to <strong>4.7.2 Intangible Asset Disposal or Retirement.</strong> Please refer to this process on detailed steps inclusive of what template to be used, who is the approver and how to check and obtain information from SAP. The asset of selling party will be retired from the FA register to gain / loss account.</p></li>
<li><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office needs to instruct GFS Back Office to reclass the amount from gain/loss account to the <strong>Retained Account GL</strong>, <strong>Interco Netting GL or Manual Intangible Asset GL</strong>, based on agreement with GFR Consolidation team or GFR Technical team. GFS Back Office Fixed Asset team needs to take note of this transaction to be able to report this under “F306 F306 - IC transfers in / (out)” in ERH MOT12 following ERH reporting timeline.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>From <strong>receiving entity</strong> perspective, two steps are needed:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Capitalise the assets via <strong>4.7.1</strong> <strong>Process and Record Intangible Asset Additions.</strong> Please refer to this process on detailed steps inclusive of what template to be used, who is the approver and how to check or obtain information from SAP.</p></li>
<li><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office needs to inform GFS Back Office on which <strong>Credit GL</strong> to be used for the asset (eg. <strong>Retained Account GL</strong>, <strong>Interco Netting GL or Manual Intangible Asset GL</strong>), based on agreement GFR Consolidation team or GFR Technical team. GFS Back Office Fixed Asset team needs to take note of this transaction to be able to report this under “F306 F306 - IC transfers in / (out)” in ERH MOT12 following ERH reporting timeline.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>There are a few reports from SAP that can facilitate on checking the overall Financial Position or Asset position in SAP. Please refer to <strong>8.3.3.9 Provide Fixed Asset Data to Support Statutory Reporting</strong> for detailed steps.</p>

<td colspan="5"><p>Business initiates the request by sending email to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office for change of Master Data for either one of these scenarios.</p>
<ol type="a">
<li><p>Change of Cost Centre – Request for Intangible Asset transfer within a legal entity.</p></li>
<li><p>Change of Useful Life (UEL) – Request for an Intangible Asset that start amortisation on launch of the product. This applies when UEL for the Intangible Asset was set as not yet amortised during asset creation.</p></li>

# RESPONSIBILITIES

## Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Role / Team | Description |
| Business / Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office | Refer to requestor for submitting intangible template/form & request, interco transfer journals and obtaining DOA approvals. |
| GDO Back Office DMT | Refers to the GDO Back Office DMT team that would perform asset shell creation and master data change. |
| GFS R2R Back Office | Refers to the GFS Back Office R2R Fixed Assets team that would perform capitalisation, retirement, impairment, amortisation. |
| GFR Consolidation Team | Refers to the Consolidation team that would advise on overall ERH Consolidation requirement. |
| GFR Technical team | Refers to the GFS Technical team that would advise what be the correct entries to be used subject to IFRS requirement |

- Upon receiving request from Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office is required to work together with Business, GFR Consolidation Team and GFR Technical team on understanding the content of the AIN/Legal document and any GAAP requirement. Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will execute to transfer asset between legal entities in AZ, and need to follow as per AZ Global Intercompany Standard documented in Finance Library.
- Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office to issue NTI (Non-Trade Intercompany Transactions) from Transferor (Selling Entity) to Transferee (Buying Entity) in NINTEX (Refer process 8.3.2.47 Intercompany Recharges for details).
- From selling entity perspective, two steps are needed:
- Retire the assets retirement by referring to 4.7.2 Intangible Asset Disposal or Retirement. Please refer to this process on detailed steps inclusive of what template to be used, who is the approver and how to check and obtain information from SAP. The asset of selling party will be retired from the FA register to gain / loss account.
- Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office needs to instruct GFS Back Office to reclass the amount from gain/loss account to the Retained Account GL, Interco Netting GL or Manual Intangible Asset GL, based on agreement with GFR Consolidation team or GFR Technical team. GFS Back Office Fixed Asset team needs to take note of this transaction to be able to report this under “F306 F306 - IC transfers in / (out)” in ERH MOT12 following ERH reporting timeline.
- From receiving entity perspective, two steps are needed:
- Capitalise the assets via 4.7.1 Process and Record Intangible Asset Additions. Please refer to this process on detailed steps inclusive of what template to be used, who is the approver and how to check or obtain information from SAP.
- Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office needs to inform GFS Back Office on which Credit GL to be used for the asset (eg. Retained Account GL, Interco Netting GL or Manual Intangible Asset GL), based on agreement GFR Consolidation team or GFR Technical team. GFS Back Office Fixed Asset team needs to take note of this transaction to be able to report this under “F306 F306 - IC transfers in / (out)” in ERH MOT12 following ERH reporting timeline.
- There are a few reports from SAP that can facilitate on checking the overall Financial Position or Asset position in SAP. Please refer to 8.3.3.9 Provide Fixed Asset Data to Support Statutory Reporting for detailed steps.

### Visual process map transcription

- Owner bands: Business Area; Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office
- Start: Intangible asset intercompany transfer required
- 8.3.3.22.1 Business Area requests an asset transfer between entities by email.
- 8.3.3.22.2 Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office finalises intercompany journal entries using email and Excel.
- 8.3.3.22.3 Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office prepares and approves non-rules journals through BlackLine.
- Parallel handoffs:
  - Buying entity -> Process and Record Intangible Asset Addition
  - Selling entity -> Process and Record Intangible Asset Disposal / Retirement
