# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities to calculate and record Depreciation expenses. This process covers the depreciation activities for the month, as well as the steps required when any errors or variances are identified while performing the depreciation run. The process for this activity also includes a mid-month test run for depreciation, to reduce the likelihood of error during the month end calculation.

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Embedded Finance, GFS Middle Office, GFS Back Office R2R and IT.

# SCOPE

The table below contains a summary of the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Geography / System / Business Area | Description |
| Global | This process is applicable to all AZ entities |

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<td colspan="4"><h3 id="execute-initial-depreciation-mid-month-test-run">Execute Initial Depreciation mid-month (Test Run)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Prior to month end close, an initial depreciation test run is conducted at mid-month to help identify if there are any issues / errors to ensure resolution is in place. Mid-month test run is followed in all regions except NAM as NAM does not have mid-month schedule job run.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Run Depreciation Test Run</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Login to SAP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:5.93166in;height:3.39131in" /></p>
<p>Input SAP T-code AFAB and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image3.png" style="width:4.35468in;height:1.66673in" /></p>
<p>Please update the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company Code</p></li>
<li><p>Fiscal Year: Current year</p></li>
<li><p>Posting Period: Current posting period</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Tick “List assets”. Make sure that “Test Run” has also been ticked. Click on execute icon <img src="media/image4.png" style="width:0.23958in;height:0.1875in" />to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Run Depreciation in Foreground and Background</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Select between Option 1 or Option 2 to run depreciation:</p>
<p><u>Option 1</u>: Running depreciation in Foreground if the number of fixed assets is low.<br />
For Option 1, <strong>refer to sub-step B.1) Run Depreciation in Foreground and update working file.</strong></p>
<p><u>Option 2</u>: Running depreciation in Background if the number of fixed assets is high. This option requires another T- code to view the result.<br />
For Option 2, <strong>refer to sub-step B.2) Run Depreciation in Background.</strong></p>
<p><strong>B.1) <u>Option 1: Run Depreciation in Foreground and update working file</u></strong></p>
<p>At the top left of the page, go to “Program”, then select “Execute” (or press F8 which performs the same function).</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:5.39582in;height:1.01239in" /></p>
<p>A pop up “Limitation online” will appear, warning that executing the Depreciation Run is limited to approximately 1000 assets. Click “Yes” to Proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image10.png" style="width:2.55208in;height:1.46707in" /></p>
<p>If the Depreciation Test Run is successful with no errors, there will be a statement highlighting “TESTRUN completed successfully” at the end of the page. If there are any errors, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.2: 8.3.3.6.2 Investigate errors</strong>. The errors could be due to Cost Centres or Internal Orders being blocked.</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:6.23958in;height:3.125in" /></p>
<p>Export the file to excel: Click on the Export to local file button <img src="media/image12.png" style="width:0.18946in;height:0.22181in" /> (Or press F9).</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.01806in" /></p>
<p>Select the spreadsheet option and click on the green tick highlighted below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:1.80113in;height:1.90625in" /></p>
<p>Select the file path where you want to export and name the file, then click Generate. The report will be exported to excel.</p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:5.32292in;height:1.44792in" /></p>
<h3 id="section-1"></h3>
<p>Obtain the prior month’s working file of FA Movement and Analysis Template from the shared location. Please refer to <strong>Section 9</strong> for the template to be used for FA Movement and analysis.</p>
<p>Save the previous month’s working file as the current month working file.</p>
<p>In the AFAB tab in the Depreciation Analysis file, copy and replace the data from columns A to P in ‘AFAB last mth’ tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.48056in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.69792in" /></p>
<p>Then, go back to ‘AFAB’ tab and clear all data from columns B to P.</p>
<p><img src="media/image18.png" style="width:6.49375in;height:0.74444in" /></p>
<p>Next, open the depreciation posting run report which was previously generated and saved. Finally, copy the data into the cleared table in AFAB tab in the Depreciation Analysis File. Copy only into Column B to Column P (Grey Headers).</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.64766in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.40139in" /></p>
<p>The columns with yellow headers either contain a formula or are for the report preparer’s remarks. The formula in Column A is a concatenation of Column B and Column C.</p>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:5.97421in;height:3.87249in" /></p>
<p><strong>B.2) <u>Option 2: Run Depreciation in Background </u></strong></p>
<p>Go to the top left of the page, go to “Program”, then select “Execute in Background” (or press F9).</p>
<p><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:5.27083in;height:1.25774in" /></p>
<p>A pop up “Background Print Parameters” will appear. Enter the Output Device as “local_en”. Click on the green tick to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:5.40816in;height:3.28488in" /></p>
<p>Another pop up will appear for the user’s information. Click on the green tick to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:4.44278in;height:1.46794in" /></p>
<p>The next pop up is to indicate when the job should run. In this instance, click on “Immediate” for immediate run, then click on Save <img src="media/image25.png" style="width:0.19792in;height:0.19792in" /> (or Ctrl+S).</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:5.97538in;height:5.41651in" /></p>
<p>At the bottom of the page, the message “Background job was scheduled for program RAPOST20000” will appear.</p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:6.14329in;height:1.68914in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>View depreciation job in SAP</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To view the depreciation job, from any page in SAP Click on “System” &gt; then select “Own Jobs”</p>
<p><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:6.22847in;height:2.5in" /></p>
<p>On clicking on own jobs, the screen below will appear:</p>
<p>This is a Finished Job. It will be highlighted in green.</p>
<p>Make sure the Job has the green status: “Finished”. If it is not yet finished, the status will state “Active”<img src="media/image30.png" style="width:0.94306in;height:0.14167in" />. In that case simply keep refreshing the page periodically by clicking on the Refresh button<img src="media/image31.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.25in" /> (or “F8”).</p>
<p>If the job is finished, proceed to select the job, then click the Spool button<img src="media/image32.png" style="width:0.57292in;height:0.20833in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:5.37607in;height:1.67305in" alt="cid:image001.png@01CFE702.8B4305D0" /></p>
<p>Select the button<img src="media/image33.png" style="width:0.21667in;height:0.20139in" />, which will show the Spooled Depreciation Test Run result.</p>
<p><img src="media/image34.png" style="width:5.29091in;height:1.47963in" alt="cid:image002.png@01CFE702.8B4305D0" /></p>
<p>If the Depreciation Test Run is successful with no errors, the following screen will show:</p>
<p><img src="media/image35.png" style="width:5.89275in;height:2.66715in" /></p>
<p>Note: The report will only show the first 10 pages.</p>
<p><img src="media/image36.png" style="width:2.53463in;height:0.45895in" /></p>
<p>If the depreciation test run was unsuccessful, the following screen will be displayed.</p>
<p>Click on log box icon (<img src="media/image37.png" style="width:0.15474in;height:0.16819in" />) to view error message and reason of the failed test run.</p>
<p>Generally – there are two reasons for failed test runs:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Posting to prior month which has already been posted, as shown in the screen below:</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image38.png" style="width:5.26042in;height:3.67763in" /></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Posting to the subsequent month before the current period is posted, as shown in the screen below:</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image39.png" style="width:5.0414in;height:2.78624in" /></p>
<p>To view the full report, click on Settings as highlighted below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.59792in" /></p>
<p>In the pop up, change the Display area to show “From page” 1 to a sufficiently large number of pages to cover the whole report.</p>
<p><img src="media/image41.png" style="width:3.00398in;height:2.57292in" /></p>
<p>The warning below will pop-up as shown. Click on the green tick <img src="media/image42.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.1875in" />or press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:3.825in;height:1.23958in" /></p>
<p>Export the report and save it to a local file by clicking on <img src="media/image44.png" style="width:0.25in;height:0.21875in" />.</p>
<p>Export the report</p>
<p>Select Text with Tabs and click on the green tick <img src="media/image46.png" style="width:0.23958in;height:0.20833in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image47.png" style="width:2.03736in;height:2.23478in" alt="cid:image004.png@01D38A06.226F1B20" /></p>
<p>Select where the file is to be exported to and name the file, then click Generate.<br />
The report will be exported.</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:5.47216in;height:1.56273in" /></p>
<p>Open the Excel File, which will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image49.png" style="width:5.84169in;height:2.17971in" /></p>
<p>Select all the rows. Then go to <strong>Data</strong> --&gt; <strong>Text to Columns</strong> as highlighted below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:6.01432in;height:0.89368in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image51.png" style="width:6.06383in;height:2.13403in" /></p>
<p>In the pop up, select “Fixed width” and click “Next”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image52.png" style="width:4.70805in;height:3.60853in" /></p>
<p>In the next screen, adjust the field widths according to the columns required in the Depreciation Analysis file by using the lines with arrows as shown below. After that, click “Finish”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image53.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.50486in" /></p>
<p>The data is now split as required. The data is now ready to be pasted into the AFAB Tab in the Depreciation Analysis file.</p>
<p><img src="media/image54.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.78472in" /></p>
<p>Copy the raw data into the AFAB tab in the Depreciation Analysis File. The data to be transferred should only be entered Column B to Column P. The formula in Column A is a concatenation of Column B and Column C. Make sure the formula is copied to cover all the asset lines.</p>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:6.46592in;height:1.68458in" /></p>
<p>Using Column A, the formula in Column Q will use VLOOKUP to “AFAB last month” tab’s Column A and Column N to get last month’s depreciation posted for the same asset.</p>
<p>The formula in Column R is the difference between Column N (amount to be posted) and Column Q (amount posted in previous month).</p>
<p><img src="media/image56.png" style="width:6.54599in;height:4.198in" /></p>
<p>Go to column “H” in tab “Dep Analysis_RU10” and look at the variances.</p>
<p><img src="media/image57.png" style="width:5.9341in;height:3.80619in" /></p>
<p>Note: If the variance is more than USD 1m by account determination in “AFAB” tab or more than 5% in “Dep Analysis” tab column G, the processer needs to explain the reason of movement (i.e. sales of asset, etc.) in column S in “AFAB” tab.</p></td>
</tr>

<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.2</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="investigate-error">Investigate error</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>GFS Back Office R2R needs to investigate errors in the depreciation run and liaise with the relevant teams, depending on the error's nature.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Identify nature of error</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>While running the depreciation through the system, the user may encounter errors due to:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Technical Issues encountered in SAP</p></li>
<li><p>Other common issues (e.g. cost centre closed, insufficient master data entered)</p></li>
</ul>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Escalate error</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p>Once the root cause is determined, reach out to relevant parties who can assist with error resolution:</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office for other common issues <strong>(Proceed to Step 4.7.3: 8.3.3.6.3 Assist with Issue resolution)</strong></p></li>
<li><p>IT for technical issues <strong>(Proceed to Step 4.7.7: 8.3.3.6.7 Contact IT Help Desk and Raise Ticket)</strong></p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.3</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="assist-with-error-resolution">Assist with Error Resolution</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><blockquote>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will need to assist to resolve the issue. Generally, errors are due to Cost Centres or Internal Orders that were closed and need to be reopened for depreciation.</p>
</blockquote>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Assist with error resolution</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>For common errors relating to blocked Cost Centres, check if the cost centre should be unblocked, or whether the asset should be transferred to a different cost centre. In both cases, contact GFS Back Office DMT which performs cost centre updates.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Confirm if mid-month was run, and respond to GFS Back Office R2R</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once the error is resolved, revert to GFS Back Office R2R accordingly, who will proceed with options below (Please note this is not applicable for NAM as NAM does not follow mid-month schedule job run):</p>
<p>If mid-month test was conducted, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.6.6 Execute depreciation at month end (Test run).</strong></p>
<p>If mid-month test was not yet conducted, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.4: 8.3.3.6.4 All Asset Postings received (pre-month-end).</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.4</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="all-asset-postings-received-pre-month-end">All Asset Postings received (Pre-month-end)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>All fixed asset posting requests needs to be sent to GFS Back Office R2R as part of the pre-closing activities.</p>
<p><strong>Obtain all asset postings:</strong> Markets to request asset transactions on or before the deadline as per the Global Close Calendar Standard. All postings received by the request deadline will need to be processed by the Back Office, prior to the asset posting deadline as per GCC. This covers requests for asset acquisition, scrapping, retirement, sale, impairment etc.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.5</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="complete-all-asset-postings">Complete all asset postings</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p><strong><u>Perform all Fixed Asset Postings</u></strong></p>
<p>All postings received by the requested deadline will need to be processed by the Back Office, prior to the asset posting deadline as per GCC.</p>
<p>This ensures that:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>There are no pending requests to change Fixed Asset Cost Centres</p></li>
<li><p>All assets to be retired in that month and with the depreciation policy not to depreciate in the month of disposal have been processed before the Depreciation run</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.6</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="execute-depreciation-at-month-end-test-run">Execute Depreciation at month end (test run)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>There will be another test run during month-end after all asset postings have been completed. The test run functionality of ERP is utilised. Any issues or errors encountered will have to be resolved before the depreciation run can be completed in production mode.</p>
<p>Note: Month end depreciation test run for NAM Hubs is performed with an automated background scheduled job on WD-4 (US time 22:00) on monthly basis.</p>
<p>To check the test run result from the scheduled background job, use T-code AFBP to check the posting log of schedule run.</p>
<p><img src="media/image58.png" style="width:4.09081in;height:2.76429in" /></p>
<p>At parameter in the below SAP screen, input Company Code, Fiscal Year and Posting Period. Tick on “SchedMan Monitor” – Schedule Manager: Monitor then click on execute <img src="media/image59.png" style="width:0.1875in;height:0.16875in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image60.png" style="width:6.03125in;height:2.89583in" /></p>
<p>Following screen displays all historical job logs. Double click on “ Depreciation posting run” entry and the status will change to “green” status which means posting run is completed without error.</p>
<p><img src="media/image61.png" style="width:5.93929in;height:1.78626in" /></p>
<p>The next panel will appear as below. Click on “Additional Info”, to confirm the company code, and posting period. Click on back icon <img src="media/image62.png" style="width:0.1677in;height:0.14504in" /> to download the list of posting log.</p>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:5.89583in;height:3.48958in" /></p>
<p>On the next page, uncheck “SchedMan Monitor” and check on “List assets” . Click on execute icon <img src="media/image59.png" style="width:0.1875in;height:0.16875in" /> to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image64.png" style="width:4.42708in;height:2.41667in" /></p>
<p>The result of total depreciation posting will be displayed at the bottom of the report at column “Amount to be posted”. Take a copy of screenshot of the posting run result with time stamp as CPX011 control supporting. This screenshot is used to match the current month’s totals in the Dep Analysis tab in Depreciation variance analysis template. Refer sub-step <strong>8.3.3.6.9</strong> <strong>Perform Analysis on Depreciation.</strong></p>
<p><img src="media/image65.png" style="width:6.15625in;height:3.69792in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Execute Depreciation Test Run</u></strong></p>
<p>Execute Depreciation Test run as per month end closing schedule (WD – 2). Test run steps are similar to the mid-month depreciation test performed.</p>
<p>For detailed steps, please <strong>refer to Step 4.7.1: 8.3.3.6.1 Execute initial depreciation at mid-month.</strong></p>
<p>If there are errors encountered while executing the test-run, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.2: 8.3.3.6.2 Investigate error,</strong> to follow similar error resolution process as performed during mid-month test run.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />

<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.7</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="contact-it-help-desk-raise-ticket">Contact IT Help Desk &amp; Raise Ticket</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>IT</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><blockquote>
<p>If a technical issue is encountered during the run, GFS Back Office R2R will contact the IT help desk and raise a ticket for the case.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong><u>Raise Ticket to IT Help Desk</u></strong></p>
<p>Go to web link: <a href="https://azprod.service-now.com/navpage.do">https://azprod.service-now.com/navpage.do</a></p>
<p>Raise a ticket according to technical issue faced, along with the relevant descriptions and supporting screenshots.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.8</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="resolve-error">Resolve Error</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">IT</td>
<td>IT</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><blockquote>
<p>IT supports the case until the technical error is resolved.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong><u>Resolve and respond to technical error raised</u></strong></p>
<p>Support and close technical issue raised.</p>
<p>Once error has been resolved, respond to GFS Back Office R2R through email, who will then confirm if mid-month test run was conducted.</p>
<p>If mid-month test run was not yet conducted, GFS Back Office R2R to proceed with <strong>Step 4.7.4: 8.3.3.6.4 All asset postings received (pre-month-end).</strong></p>
<p>If mid-month test run was conducted, GFS Back Office R2R to proceed with <strong>Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.6.6 Execute depreciation at month end (Test run).</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.9</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="perform-variance-analysis-against-prior-month-depreciation">Perform variance analysis against prior month depreciation</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If there are no errors in the depreciation test run, GFS Back Office R2R will perform the analysis of the depreciation test run figures, comparing them with prior month depreciation figures. A review is performed of depreciation expenditure to ensure that the monthly cost is recorded accurately. Ensure you perform control CPX011 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<p><strong><u>Perform Analysis on Depreciation</u></strong></p>
<p>In the “Dep Analysis” Tab of the FA Movement and Analysis Template, both month’s data (previous month and current month) will be derived from formulas in the table below, which represents the FA Sub ledger.</p>
<p>Last month (Col D): = SUMIF(‘AFAB last month!D:D,’Dep Analysis_RU10’!C110,’AFAB last month’!N:N).</p>
<p><img src="media/image66.png" style="width:4.97346in;height:3.31353in" /> <img src="media/image67.png" style="width:0.39844in" /></p>
<p>This month (Col E) =SUMIF('AFAB_Current month'!D:D,'Dep Analysis_RU10'!C117,'AFAB_Current month'!N:N)</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:4.7584in;height:2.80667in" /></p>
<p>Column F is the Variance Value, and this is the difference between current month (Col E) and previous month (Col D).</p>
<p><img src="media/image69.png" style="width:4.75614in;height:3.46048in" /></p>
<p>Column G is the variance value in USD.</p>
<p>To determine the USD value of the variance in local currency, go to this <a href="http://azure.emea.astrazeneca.net/AZURELite/currency/RateViewByRateType.jsp">link</a> of Azure Lite website and scroll down to identify the budgeted rate for the currency of the market. For e.g. in the above report, the currency RUB is to be converted to USD currency.</p>
<p>Screen will appear as below after selecting below parameters in drop down:</p>
<p><strong>Rate Type:</strong> Budget and Forecast rates</p>
<p><strong>Year:</strong> Current year</p>
<p><strong>Period:</strong> Current month</p>
<p><img src="media/image70.png" style="width:5.75305in;height:2.72908in" /></p>
<p>The Base rate is mentioned in G1 and use the formula in Column G = F110/$G$2:</p>
<p><img src="media/image71.png" style="width:4.96145in;height:3.26348in" /></p>
<p>Column H is the variance value in percentage, dividing Variance Value (Col F) by previous month’s value (Col D).</p>
<p><img src="media/image72.png" style="width:5.72277in;height:3.79878in" /></p>
<p>A screenshot of the successful Depreciation test run (either run in foreground or run in background) will need to be pasted into Depreciation analysis’s “Dep Print Screen” Tab.</p>
<p>Successful depreciation page (Option 1: Running in foreground) is shown below. The numbers here will tie back to the total of column E in ‘Dep Analysis’ tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image73.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.82639in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image74.png" style="width:6.21778in;height:2.40548in" /></p>
<p>Successful depreciation page (Option 2: Running in background) is shown below.</p>
<p>This is a Finished Job. It will be highlighted in green.</p>
<p><img src="media/image75.png" style="width:5.54167in;height:1.19792in" /></p>
<p>If variance for any fixed asset is above threshold (+/- Threshold) as per AZ Capital and Fixed Assets standard, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.10: 8.3.3.6.10 Investigate Variance.</strong></p>
<p>If variance does not exceed threshold (+/- Threshold), <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.14: 8.3.3.6.14: Execute depreciation (production).</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.10</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="investigate-variance">Investigate Variance</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>On a review of the current month depreciation against the previous month's depreciation, if variance is above threshold (+/- Threshold) as per the Capital and Fixed Asset Standard (Please refer to the link in <strong>Section 9 Appendices</strong>), the variance must be further investigated and assessed for reasonableness.</p>
<p>Further reports can be run to double check the results and review for reasonableness (e.g. Asset Report by Class, Addition Report and Disposal / Retirement Report).</p>
<p>If the identified variance does not pass the reasonableness test, proceed to <strong>Step 4.7.11: 8.3.3.6.11 Provide assistance with variance explanation</strong>.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Investigate and explain any variances</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The percentage in Column I will turn red if the variance exceeds the threshold. The data in “AFAB” and “AFAB last mth” tabs will be used to find out which assets are causing the variances, and from there the reason for the variance can be identified.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Summarise the cause for depreciation variance</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>In the “Dep Analysis” Tab, there is a summary of the cause of variance which was encountered (illustrative purposes only).</p>
<p><img src="media/image76.png" style="width:4.79167in;height:0.80208in" /></p>
<p>Depreciation variances can be caused by many factors. Below is a list of common causes of depreciation variances:</p>
<p><u>Common causes of decreased depreciation:</u></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset Retirements in the last month / current month</p></li>
<li><p>Assets fully depreciated in the last month</p></li>
<li><p>There was an unusually large depreciation amount for the last month (e.g. accelerated depreciation following an impairment review), so compared to the current month’s depreciation, it would appear to be low</p></li>
</ul>
<p><u>Common causes of increased depreciation:</u></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset Acquisitions / AUC Capitalisations in last month / current month</p></li>
<li><p>Assets with depreciation start dates brought forward / moved to an earlier date (resulting in an increased depreciation in the following months to normalise total depreciation value)</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The table below indicates how to check for common causes of depreciation variances:</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>B.1) <u>Increased Depreciation</u></strong><u>:</u></p>
</blockquote>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 40%" />
<col style="width: 34%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>Common Causes</strong></th>
<th><strong>How to Check for it</strong></th>
<th><strong>Action Step</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>New Asset Capitalised during the month</td>
<td>Go to SAP T-code AS03, and go to the General Tab. Check the field “Capitalised on date”</td>
<td>No further action required</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Depreciation start date brought forward</td>
<td>Go to SAP T-code AS03, and view depreciation start date</td>
<td>Verify with market if it was intended to bring forward the date</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>B.2) <u>Decreased Depreciation</u></strong><u>:</u></p>
</blockquote>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 22%" />
<col style="width: 42%" />
<col style="width: 34%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>Common Causes</strong></th>
<th><strong>How to Check for it</strong></th>
<th><strong>Action Step</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Net book value is zero</td>
<td>This can be checked by checking asset NBV in SAP T-code AW01N.</td>
<td>No further action required</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Unusually large depreciation in last month (special cases)</td>
<td><ul>
<li><p>Check if last month’s increase was due to changes in the asset’s depreciation start date (using SAP T-code AW01N) through Tab “Posted Value”</p></li>
<li><p>Check if the large depreciation value was due to change in useful life (Using SAP T-code AS03 through tab “Deprec. Area)</p></li>
<li><p>Check if last month’s increase was due to changes in the asset’s depreciation start date, caused by backdated depreciation (Using SAP T- code AW01N) through Tab “Parameters” check Ord.dep.start date and make comparison through tab “Comparison”</p></li>
</ul></td>
<td><ul>
<li><p>If there was a change in depreciation start date, the legitimacy of the change would have been verified in the previous month; hence no further action required</p></li>
<li><p>If there was a change in useful life, verify with the market whether this was intended</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Determine reasonableness (+/- Threshold)</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>For variance which exceeds threshold as identified in the Depreciation Analysis file, double check and review other reports for reasonableness, such as:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset Report by class</p></li>
<li><p>Addition Report</p></li>
<li><p>Disposal / Retirement Report</p></li>
</ul>
<p>If asset passes the reasonableness test, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.14: 8.3.3.6.14 Execute depreciation (production).</strong></p>
<p>If asset does not pass reasonableness test, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.11: 8.3.3.6.11 Provide assistance with variance explanation.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 23%" />
<col style="width: 26%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.11</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="provide-assistance-with-variance-explanation">Provide assistance with Variance Explanation</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office supports GFS Back Office R2R in their analysis of the variance, in case the reasonableness test is not passed. Asset movements at the sites can be reviewed to support any significant differences in the depreciation figures.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive and analyse depreciation analysis file</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once depreciation file has been received, review initial variance analysis performed by GFS Back Office R2R.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Provide assistance on variance explanation</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Determine if variance (which gets communicated back to GFS Back Office R2R) was due to Fixed Asset Master Data.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>If yes, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.12: 8.3.3.6.12 Coordinate to update Fixed Assets Master Data.</strong></p></li>
<li><p>If no, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.13: 8.3.3.6.13 Include variance analysis in Month End Reconciliation.</strong></p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.12</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="coordinate-to-update-fixed-assets-master-data">Coordinate to update Fixed Assets Master Data</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><blockquote>
<p>GFS Back Office R2R Team will inform Business / Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office through email about the master data errors, so that they can the request for changes to GFS Back Office DMT Team.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>Reach out to GFS Back Office DMT team on the changes / updates required on the Master Data</strong></p>
<p>The local team (Business / Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office) will need to send in the request via Email to maintain the corrections to the asset master data.</p>
<p>For changes to Master Data, the GFS Back Office DMT team will check that the form is filled correctly and accurately with all necessary information. They will then make the necessary changes in the asset’s Master Data in SAP and communicate back via email.</p>
<p>Once resolved, <strong>proceed again with Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.6.6 Execute Depreciation at month-end (test run),</strong> to ensure that all updates to Fixed Assets Master Data have been reflected accordingly.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />

<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.13</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="include-variance-analysis-in-month-end-reconciliation">Include variance analysis in month-end reconciliation</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Include the depreciation analysis with comments and explanations into the formal reconciliation prepared each month, which compares fixed asset balances from SAP FI to the Fixed Asset register.</p>
<p><strong><u>Include analysis into reconciliation document</u></strong></p>
<p>Include summary of depreciation run and other supporting findings found in <strong>Step 4.7.10: 8.3.3.6.10: Investigate Variance.</strong></p>
<p><img src="media/image77.png" style="width:6.45833in;height:3.73958in" /></p>
<p>Include the applicable variance explanation (illustrative example only).</p>
<p>Example of variance explanation</p>
<p>Once analysis has been included, proceed to <strong>Step 4.7.14: 8.3.3.6.14 Execute depreciation (production).</strong></p></td>
</tr>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 24%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>8.3.3.6.14</td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="execute-depreciation-production">Execute Depreciation (Production)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Depreciation is allocated by cost centre defined in the Asset Master Record. The processer will run depreciation for all active fixed assets on a monthly basis, as per the Global Close Calendar. The depreciation key defines the method that will be used to calculate depreciation for the asset.</p>
<p>Depreciation areas are set up to calculate depreciation for different purposes such as Group book, Local GAAP or Tax depreciation.</p>
<p>The output of the depreciation process will be the depreciation postings in each of the relevant depreciation areas, by the amount calculated as defined by the depreciation key. This will result in an adjustment of the Net Book Value of the Fixed Assets. Note that Group book and Local GAAP depreciation are posted to the General Ledger (GL) at the same time upon running AFAB whilst Tax depreciation is displayed in the AA module for reporting purposes.</p>
<p>Note: Month end depreciation final run for NAM Hubs is performed with an automated background scheduled job on WD-3 (US time 22:00) on monthly basis. In case of any error in schedule job run then follow the steps in section <strong>A) Perform depreciation final run and B) View depreciation job in SAP.</strong></p>
<p><strong><u>Check status of scheduled test run for NAM</u></strong></p>
<p>Use T-code AFBP to check the posting log of schedule run.</p>
<p><img src="media/image58.png" style="width:4.09081in;height:2.76429in" /></p>
<p>At parameter in the below SAP screen, input Company Code, Fiscal Year and Posting Period. Tick on “SchedMan Monitor” Schedule Manager and click on execute icon <img src="media/image59.png" style="width:0.1875in;height:0.16875in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image79.png" style="width:5.76413in;height:2.783in" /></p>
<p>The following page displays all historical job logs. Double click on “Depreciation posting run” to update the status. The “green” status means posting run is complete without any error.</p>
<p><img src="media/image80.png" style="width:5.88679in;height:1.51949in" /></p>
<p>The next panel will appear as below. Click on “Additional Info”, to confirm the company code, and posting period. Click on back icon <img src="media/image62.png" style="width:0.1677in;height:0.14504in" /> to download the list of posting log.</p>
<p><img src="media/image81.png" style="width:6.16667in;height:3.20833in" /></p>
<p>On the next page, uncheck “SchedMan Monitor”, check on “List assets” then execute <img src="media/image59.png" style="width:0.1875in;height:0.16875in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image82.png" style="width:6.0809in;height:2.55208in" /></p>
<p>The result of total depreciation posting will be displayed at the bottom of the report at column “Amount to be posted”. Take a copy of screenshot of the posting run result with time stamp as CPX011 control supporting.</p>
<p><img src="media/image83.png" style="width:6.11458in;height:3.07292in" /></p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Perform Final Depreciation Run</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The below steps for Depreciation run are performed for all region except NAM. In case NAM scheduled job fails, then this step will need to be performed for NAM as well.</p>
<p>Access SAP and enter T-code AFAB. Press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image3.png" style="width:4.44898in;height:1.88405in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the Company Code, Fiscal Year and current Posting Period. Make sure that “Test Run” has been unticked. Click on execute icon <img src="media/image84.png" style="width:0.33333in;height:0.29167in" /> to proceed:</p>
<p>Do <strong><u>NOT</u></strong> tick Test Run!</p>
<p>At the top left of the page, go to “Program”, then select “Execute in Background” (or F9).</p>
<p><img src="media/image86.png" style="width:4.26636in;height:1.05749in" /></p>
<p>A pop up “Background Print Parameters” will appear. Enter the Output Device as “local_en”.</p>
<p>Click on the green tick <img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.28125in;height:0.28125in" />to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:5.40816in;height:3.28488in" /></p>
<p>Another pop up will appear for the user’s information only. Click on the green tick<img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.28125in;height:0.28125in" /> to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:4.4375in;height:1.39583in" /></p>
<p>Input when the final depreciation should be run. In this instance, final depreciation will be run immediately. So, click on “Immediate”, then click on Save <img src="media/image88.png" style="width:0.21875in;height:0.20833in" /> (or Ctrl+S).</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:5.72478in;height:5.17109in" /></p>
<p>At the bottom of the page, a message will appear which says, “Background job was scheduled for program RAPOST20000”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:6.21944in;height:1.72936in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong>View depreciation job in SAP</strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The below steps to view Depreciation job are performed for all region except NAM. In case NAM scheduled job fails, then this step will need to be performed for NAM as well.</p>
<p>From any page in SAP &gt; click on “System” &gt; then select “Own Jobs”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:6.22847in;height:3.06752in" /></p>
<p>Make sure the Job has the green status: “Finished”. If it is not finished yet, the status will state “Active”. In that case simply keep refreshing the page by clicking on the Refresh button (or “F8”).</p>
<p>This is a Finished Job. It will be highlighted in green.</p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Include Depreciation summary into analysis file</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>If the job has finished, this means that the Depreciation has been posted.<br />
<br />
Proceed to select the job, then click Spool button<img src="media/image32.png" style="width:0.47917in;height:0.17424in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:5.37607in;height:1.67305in" alt="cid:image001.png@01CFE702.8B4305D0" /></p>
<p>Select the button<img src="media/image33.png" style="width:0.21667in;height:0.20139in" />, which will show the Spooled Final Depreciation Run.</p>
<p><img src="media/image34.png" style="width:5.29091in;height:1.47963in" alt="cid:image002.png@01CFE702.8B4305D0" /></p>
<p>Take a print screen of the spooled Final Depreciation Run, making sure to capture the heading of the spooled report as well as the depreciation totals at the bottom of the report.</p>
<p>Paste this into the Depreciation Analysis file in the “Dep Print Screen” Tab below the screenshot of the Depreciation Test Run done earlier.</p>
<p>Depreciation totals at bottom of report</p>
<p>Title of spooled report</p>
<p>The final depreciation run figures should be the same as the depreciation test run, but if for some reason there is a difference, the current month’s posted depreciation report can be extracted using the T-code AFAB as shown in <strong>Step 4.7.1: 8.6.6.3.1 Execute initial depreciation mid-month</strong> (test run) , and then input into the AFAB Tab (which is for the current month’s depreciation data).</p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Extract YTD depreciation amount from FA Sub-ledger</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The YTD depreciation amount (by asset class) from the Fixed Assets subledger is taken from AR02 report. Go to T-code AR02.</p>
<p><img src="media/image90.png" style="width:4.27083in;height:1.44792in" /></p>
<p>Key in the company code and indicate report date as the last day of the month.<br />
Change Sort Variant to “0007” and tick “… or group totals only”.<br />
Click the Execute button<img src="media/image91.png" style="width:0.25in;height:0.21875in" /> (Or press F8).</p>
<p><img src="media/image92.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:5.79583in" /></p>
<p>Click Select Layout button <img src="media/image93.png" style="width:0.23958in;height:0.1875in" />, to change the Layout to “/CPX007_MEO”. Click on green tick <img src="media/image94.png" style="width:0.15643in;height:0.16478in" />to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image95.png" style="width:5.97231in;height:3.16626in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image96.png" style="width:3.75in;height:3.61168in" /></p>
<p>Click on “List”, then choose “Export” then click on “Spreadsheet” to export the AR02 report.</p>
<p><img src="media/image97.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.69514in" /></p>
<p>Below Screen will appear, click on green tick <img src="media/image98.png" style="width:0.17972in;height:0.16228in" /> as highlighted below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image99.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.51597in" /></p>
<p>Name the file and click Save.</p>
<p><img src="media/image100.png" style="width:4.13542in;height:3.27357in" /></p>
<p><strong><br />
</strong></p>
<p>Open the FA Movement Analysis Template (refer to <strong>Section 9: Appendices</strong> for location of file).</p>
<p>Copy the entire exported report into the FA Movement Analysis Template’s “AR02” Tab.</p>
<p>Take screenshots of the AR02 report in SAP and paste it into the “AR02” Tab under the AR02 table.</p>
<p><img src="media/image101.png" style="width:5.37468in;height:3.26428in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Perform</u></strong> <strong><u>final depreciation reconciliation with Financial Statement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>In the Dep Analysis Tab Column J (YTD Depreciation), ensure correct SUMIF formula to calculate the asset class’ YTD depreciation amount from AR02 Column L.</p>
<p>Column J Formula: =SUMIF(AR02_RU10!C:C,'Dep Analysis_RU10'!A14,AR02_RU10!L:L)</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:5.83479in;height:3.90658in" /></p>
<p>Next, reconcile current month’s depreciation in Asset Register (purple table) with that in<br />
P&amp;L (green table).</p>
<p>Pull the Financial Statement using T-code: F.01.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:6.18233in;height:1.50026in" /></p>
<p>Please update the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company Code</p></li>
<li><p>Chart of Accounts “SCOA”</p></li>
<li><p>Financial Statement: “ZFSG”</p></li>
<li><p>For Reporting Year and Periods: input this year Period 1 to current month.</p></li>
<li><p>For Comparison Year and Periods: input last year’s Period 1 to 16.</p></li>
<li><p>Tick “ALV grid control” and use Layout: “/MEO-F.01”</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click the Execute button<img src="media/image104.png" style="width:0.20764in;height:0.19792in" /> at the top of the page (or F8).</p>
<p><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:5.87477in;height:2.82735in" /></p>
<p>For YTD figures:</p>
<p>Reporting Year and Periods: this year, Period 1 to current month</p>
<p>The following pop up is for information only, so click the green tick (or Enter) to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image107.png" style="width:6.49375in;height:1.62708in" /></p>
<p>Export the resulting report by clicking on “List”, select “Export” click “Spreadsheet”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image108.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:4.35208in" /></p>
<p>The Save As pop up will appear. Save the report on the “Desktop” and name the file. Then click on “Save”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image109.png" style="width:4.15828in;height:3.29167in" /></p>
<p>Column G: this year’s YTD amount</p>
<p>Column H: last year’s YTD amount to Period 16</p>
<p>Column I: YTD movement</p>
<p><img src="media/image110.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.52471in" /></p>
<p>Copy the entire report and paste it into the Depreciation Analysis file in “F.01” Tab. Make sure the Account numbers (Column C) are converted from text to number.</p>
<p>The F.01 data will be used to populate the YTD Depreciation in the green P&amp;L table in “Dep Analysis” Tab.</p>
<p>Ensure correct formula is present in Column K.</p>
<p>Column L’s values are linked to F.01 by using the formula to VLOOKUP from Column C to Column G in “F.01” Tab. This formula should not be adjusted.</p>
<p>Formula = IFERROR(VLOOKUP(K14,F.01!C:G,3,0),0)</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:5.48679in;height:3.46047in" /></p>
<p>The difference, Column M’s formula is found by adding Column L (P&amp;L YTD Depreciation) with Column J (Asset Ledger YTD Depreciation Amount).</p>
<p>For GL Accounts which map to multiple Asset Classes, adjust the formula to add all the applicable Asset Classes’ “YTD Depreciation” value.</p>
<p><img src="media/image112.png" style="width:5.96763in;height:3.19249in" /></p>
<p>Column M should show zero difference, meaning that Depreciation in the Asset Register has been reconciled to the depreciation movements in the P&amp;L statement.</p>
<p>Besides the screenshots of the test run and final run, there are two more print screens required in the Dep Print Screen Tab.</p>
<ol start="6" type="A">
<li><p>F.01 of the Accumulated Depreciation GLs in Balance Sheet</p></li>
<li><p>F.01 of the Depreciation Expense GLs in the Profit &amp; Loss</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code F.01 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:6.18233in;height:1.50026in" /></p>
<p>This time input the list of Accumulated Depreciation GLs into the GL account selection. Click Execute <img src="media/image113.png" style="width:0.21947in;height:0.19204in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image114.png" style="width:5.89583in;height:3.40625in" /></p>
<p>The total “Abs Diff” column should show the total depreciation posted in the month. Print Screen this and paste into the “Dep Print Screen” Tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:6.00996in;height:2.84375in" /></p>
<p>Input T-code F.01 again.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:6.18233in;height:1.50026in" /></p>
<p>This time input the list of Depreciation Expense GLs into the G/L account selection.</p>
<p>Press F8 or click on execute icon<img src="media/image113.png" style="width:0.21947in;height:0.19204in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image116.png" style="width:6.06612in;height:3.19294in" /></p>
<p>The total “Abs Diff” column should show the total depreciation posted in the month. Print Screen this and paste into the Dep Print Screen Tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image117.png" style="width:3.99656in;height:2.79433in" /></p>
<p>The Depreciation Analysis section has been completed. Send the FA Movement and Analysis file to the reviewer. After the review is completed, save the file in the R2R working folder for the month.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

# GLOSSARY

The table below contains the definition of all terms, acronyms and abbreviations required to properly interpret this document:

| Term | Definition |
|----|----|
| AFAB | SAP T-code to run depreciation test run |
| AR02 | SAP T-code to extract year-to-date depreciation amount by asset class |

| ASKB | SAP T-code use to run for alphanumeric account to be updated for local GAAP |
| AFBP | SAP T-code to check background job run or scheduled job run |
| AW01N | SAP T-code to display depreciation calculation |
| AZ | AstraZeneca |
| BS | Balance Sheet |
| CC | Cost Centre |
| DMT | Data Management Team |
| F.01 | SAP T-code to extract financial statement |
| FA | Fixed Asset |
| FCAS | Financial Controls and Assurance System |
| FCF | Financial Control Framework |
| FI | Financial Accounting |
| FT | Finance Transformation |
| GAAP | Generally Accepted Accounting Principles |
| GFS | Global Finance Services |
| GL | General Ledger |
| IT | Information Technology |
| N/A | Not applicable |
| R2R | Record to report |
| SAP | Finance enterprise software used by AZ to record transactions for internal and external reporting |
| WD | Working day |
| YTD | Year to Date |

## ASKB run

GFS Back Office R2R runs **T-code ASKB** for alphanumeric account to be updated for local GAAP.

Steps are given below**:**

1)  **<u>Perform ASKB Test Run</u>**

Run T-code “ASKB” in SAP.

<img src="media/image119.png" style="width:3.32222in;height:1.22917in" />

![](media/image122.png)Input “Company Code” \>\> Tick “Test Run” \>\> Select "Program" \>\> "Execute in background".

<img src="media/image124.png" style="width:2.36458in;height:0.97917in" />

Enter “Output device” as “local\_en” and click on the green tick as shown in the screenshot below:

<img src="media/image125.png" style="width:5.45833in;height:3.35417in" />

Click “Immediate” \>\> Untick “Periodic Job” \>\> Click “Save”.

<img src="media/image126.png" style="width:4.75125in;height:3.47562in" />

Click on “Own Jobs” in system drop-down.

<img src="media/image127.png" style="width:1.72917in;height:2.5in" /><img src="media/image128.png" style="width:5.22264in;height:3.00525in" />

Click on “Refresh” until the status changes from “Active” to “Finished”.

![](media/image131.png)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.33333in;height:0.29167in" />

Next, tick the box on the job name and double-click on the Spool list icon.

<img src="media/image134.png" style="width:6.24873in;height:1.97917in" />

<img src="media/image135.png" style="width:0.30208in;height:0.28125in" />Tick the spool no. and click on ABAP list .

<img src="media/image136.png" style="width:6.30208in;height:2.43889in" />

Ensure all statuses are green. This means the test run is successful. If it is red, then check the errors before proceeding to depreciation run. There are rarely any failed sessions for the ASKB process.

<img src="media/image137.jpeg" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.39844in" alt="cid:image001.jpg@01D51F9E.E04F87E0" />

2)  **Perform ASKB Actual Run**

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><p>Before monthly deprecation run, perform ASKB actual run for each country to capture the local GAAP’s asset amounts.</p>
<p><img src="media/image138.png" style="width:3.32222in;height:1.22917in" /></p>
<p>Input “Company Code” &gt;&gt; Untick “Test Run” &gt;&gt; Select "Program" &gt;&gt; "Execute in background".</p>
<p><img src="media/image124.png" style="width:2.36458in;height:0.97917in" /><img src="media/image139.png" style="width:5.52083in;height:4.70833in" /></p>
<p>Click on F9. Click on green tick in below screen:</p>
<p><img src="media/image140.png" style="width:5.46807in;height:3.35375in" /></p>
<p>Click “Immediate” &gt;&gt; Untick “Periodic Job” &gt;&gt; Click “Save”.</p>
<p>Click on “Own Jobs” in “System” option.</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:4.42745in;height:3.34816in" /></p>
<p>Click On “System” and click on “Own Jobs”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image128.png" style="width:5.48958in;height:3.75in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Refresh” until the status changes from “Active” to “Finished”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image131.png" /></p>
<hr />
<hr />
<hr />
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.33333in;height:0.29167in" /></p>
<p>Next, tick the box against the job name and double-click on the Spool list icon.</p>
<p><img src="media/image134.png" style="width:6.27083in;height:2.43958in" /></p>
<p>Tick the spool no. and click on ABAP list.</p>
<p><img src="media/image135.png" style="width:0.30208in;height:0.28125in" />Tick the spool no. and click on ABAP list .</p>
<p><img src="media/image136.png" style="width:6.30208in;height:2.43889in" /></p>
<p>Ensure all status is green. This means the final ASKB run is successful. If it is red, then check the same before proceeding to depreciation run.</p>
<p><img src="media/image137.jpeg" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.39844in" alt="cid:image001.jpg@01D51F9E.E04F87E0" /></p></th>

All postings received by the request deadline will need to be processed by the Back Office, prior to the asset posting deadline as per GCC. This covers requests for asset acquisition, scrapping, retirement, sale, impairment etc.

- On a review of the current month depreciation against the previous month's depreciation, if variance is above threshold (+/- Threshold) as per the Capital and Fixed Asset Standard (Please refer to the link in Section 9 Appendices), the variance must be further investigated and assessed for reasonableness.

# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for the closure and capitalisation of a project.

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Business, Embedded Finance, GFS Middle Office, and GFS Back Office R2R and GDO Back Office DMT.

# SCOPE

The table indicates the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded:

|                  |                                               |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| Business Process | Description                                   |
| Global           | This process is applicable to all AZ entities |

# PROCEDURE

## Process Map

<img src="media/image1.png" style="width:6.69306in;height:4.00833in" />

## Assumptions and Prerequisites

The table below contains a summary of the assumptions and pre-requisites required for the process this operating procedure relates to:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Assumption / Prerequisite | Description |
| Project WBS structure is created in SAP | The project WBS is created in SAP, along with settlement rules and that costs have been booked onto the project WBS |
| All project related transactions have been recorded | It is important to ensure that all costs associated with the project have been received before the project closure |

## Frequency

This process happens ad-hoc as per requests from Project Manager.

## Process Detail

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.1</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="generate-the-open-capital-projects-reports">Generate the open capital projects reports</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Open project reports are generated to keep track of open projects which might be subject for project closure (for example, percentage of completion based on actual amount and budget). Once generated, submit the report to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office for review.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Prepare Open Capital Project Report</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The purpose of month end report for capital projects is to monitor the current open capital projects, budgeted amount against actual spend.</p>
<p>Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:4.32778in" /></p>
<p>Enter T-code CN41N to extract open projects actual cost and budget.</p>
<p><img src="media/image3.png" style="width:4.38673in;height:1.93379in" /></p>
<p>Select the PS Info Profile “000000000001” in the pop-up screen and click the green tick <img src="media/image4.png" style="width:0.25in;height:0.15625in" />.</p>
<p>Note: Project System Info Profile vary amongst different SAP instances. Please ensure you input according to the SAP instance that you are supporting.</p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:4.42083in" /></p>
<p>At the parameter screen select Dynamic selections <img src="media/image6.png" style="width:0.21875in;height:0.22917in" />, double click on Company Code and input accordingly. Input multiple selection “E*” to include all projects in the project field.</p>
<p>Please note: If the selected country has some old projects code other than E, please include here as well.</p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:4.53363in;height:3.10084in" /></p>
<p>Click F8 to Execute.</p>
<p>The report output is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image8.png" style="width:5.6875in;height:2.54861in" /></p>
<p>Click on Extract icon as highlighted below and then on “MS Excel (xls)” to export the report into excel:</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.42431in" /></p>
<p>Select “Table” in the pop-up box and click on green tick <img src="media/image10.png" style="width:0.14746in;height:0.13533in" /> to proceed as displayed below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.39514in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Microsoft Excel” and then on green tick <img src="media/image10.png" style="width:0.14583in;height:0.13194in" />to extract the report in excel:</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.65417in" /></p>
<p>py this data and place it in “Data ALL” tab in the monthly main file (Open project capital report). This is done to extract current open projects with budget and match the AUC balance against it.</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:5.93709in;height:3.77777in" /></p>
<p>The next step is to extract AUC asset balances and match AUC asset number against WBSE.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retrieve Asset List</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code AR02 (Asset History Sheet) or T-code is S_ALR_87011990 (Asset History Sheet) to extract AUC number and amounts. Fill in the parameters as per below instructions:</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.jpeg" style="width:4.25347in;height:1.475in" alt="cid:image001.jpg@01D598C1.F22FB2E0" /></p>
<p>Complete the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company Code – Input Company code</p></li>
<li><p>Asset class – range from 9000 to 9599 (please refer the AUC asset classes as per your respective SAP instances)</p></li>
<li><p>Report Date – Current month-end</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation Area – “20” (“Cost-acc”) (please refer Local Book for respective SAP instances)</p></li>
<li><p>Sort variant: Please select Sort Variant with WBSE Reference</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Choose “List assets”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:5.48298in;height:4.51242in" /></p>
<p>Click Select Layout button <img src="media/image16.png" style="width:0.20833in;height:0.19792in" /> to change the Layout to “/MEO”, which will display a summary of asset movement during the year by asset class.</p>
<p>Choose Layout – “/MEO” as mentioned above and click on green tick<img src="media/image10.png" style="width:0.14746in;height:0.13533in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.19861in" /></p>
<p>Press F8 to Execute or click on <img src="media/image18.png" style="width:0.21126in;height:0.19262in" /> icon and it will generate the report with asset class as given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.47392in;height:3.58337in" /></p>
<p>Click “List”, choose “Export” and then click on “Spreadsheet” to extract the AR02 report in excel:</p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:4.85369in;height:1.42216in" /></p>
<p>Name the file and click on “Save”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:4.92898in;height:3.80069in" /></p>
<p>The excel report will appear as below and will be used in the subsequent <strong>step C) Extract report for AUC with WBSE reference</strong> to match against WBSE.</p>
<p><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.37292in" /></p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Extract report for AUC with WBSE reference</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code S_ALR_87012058 (List of Origins of Asset Charges) to extract AUC assets with WBSE number.</p>
<p><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:5.56352in;height:1.88227in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the below details and click on execute icon <img src="media/image24.png" style="width:0.23472in;height:0.2in" />:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset number: Copy all the AUC asset numbers from AR02 list and paste <img src="media/image25.png" style="width:0.26351in;height:0.23423in" /> the list at asset number in SAP</p></li>
<li><p>Report date: Current month-end date</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation Area: Please refer local books for respective SAP instances.</p></li>
<li><p>Sort Variant: Please select Sort Variant with WBSE Reference</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The screen will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:7.59306in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:3.54583in;height:0.80556in" /><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:1.27083in;height:1.13889in" />The report will appear as below. Click on Systems at menu bar &gt; List &gt; Save &gt; Local File to extract the report in excel. Follow the below steps to save the extracted excel file:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Click on List</p></li>
<li><p>Select Save</p></li>
<li><p>Local file</p></li>
<li><p>Text with Tabs</p></li>
<li><p>Enter the File Name</p></li>
<li><p>Click on Generate</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Using the report from S_ALR_87012058, VLOOKUP the WBSE element number at Column I to the AR02 report (Column D) with AUC asset numbers.</p>
<p>Use the formula in D2 in AR02 report “=VLOOKUP(A2,[Report] S_ALR_87012058_SE10!A:I,9,0)”</p>
<p>Subsequently, create another column (Column C) in AR02 report to capture the project definition (e.g. E.012641.05.01 to E.012641). Use the formula “=left(D2,8)”</p>
<p>The screen will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image30.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:6.50764in" /></p>
<p>The next step is to create a Pivot by following the steps as given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image31.png" style="width:6.53044in;height:1.39997in" /></p>
<p>Select the table range for which you want to create a pivot in the pop-up box and click “OK”: -</p>
<p><img src="media/image32.png" style="width:6.26328in;height:3.46785in" /></p>
<p>A pivot table will be created on the same tab below the table. Select the rows and values for the pivot table as given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image33.png" style="width:6.10515in;height:2.36634in" /></p>
<p>Filter level “00” in Column B in CN41N report. Insert a VLOOKUP formula:</p>
<p>=VLOOKUP(D116,’Extraction from AR02’!$A$3931:$B$4895,2,0) to copy the AUC balances from AR02 report pivot table with project ID at Column D.</p>
<p>Filter Level “00”</p>
<p>Ensure that the AUV balance tie with AR02</p>
<p>VLOOKUP AUC balances from AR02 report</p>
<p>Use the below report for VLOOKUP formulas in above sheet:</p>
<p>VLOOKUP AUC balances from AR02 report</p>
<p>The final Open Project Report with “Actual Cost” and “Budget” appears as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image36.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.87014in" /></p>
<p>To support CAPEX 3 reporting, T-code CN41N displays cumulative authorised budget of all projects against the project’s life.</p>
<p>To match sub-ledger AR02 AUC balance with General Ledger, enter T-code F.01.</p>
<p><img src="media/image37.png" style="width:3.43388in;height:1.56203in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the below fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Chart of Accounts: SCOA</p></li>
<li><p>G/L Account: Input the G/L accounts for which AUC balance is to be verified by clicking on the highlighted icon, inputting the AUC G/L Numbers and then click on execute icon <img src="media/image38.png" style="width:0.21875in;height:0.1875in" /></p></li>
<li><p>Reporting Year: Current Year</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click on <img src="media/image39.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.1875in" />icon against G/L account to enter more than one G/L account.</p>
<p>Enter the GL numbers to be used as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.png" style="width:5.94607in;height:3.37636in" /></p>
<p>Once all the details are entered, press F8 or click execute icon <img src="media/image41.png" style="width:0.32292in;height:0.28125in" /> to proceed.</p>
<p>Below screen shows the output:</p>
<p><img src="media/image42.png" style="width:6.04756in;height:4.95964in" /></p>
<p>Verify the AUC balance in F.01 from AR02 and prepare a working as shown below keeping the screenshots of balances verified as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:5.94411in;height:2.7679in" /></p>
<p>AR02 excel extract is given below to verify the balance:</p>
<p><img src="media/image44.png" style="width:6.28777in;height:2.5487in" /></p>
<p>The reason for balance mismatch, if any, would be due to manual posting to AUC GL 12100901, supporting will need to be provided in the report at Manual Posting” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image45.png" style="width:5.84313in;height:3.1829in" /></p>
<p>Save a copy of the Open Capital Project Report by pasting the data as values in the report and share the file with GFS Middle Office and respective project managers.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="review-and-determine-capital-projects-for-closure">Review and determine capital projects for closure</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Business</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office performs a review of the open capital projects report submitted by GFS Back Office R2R to identify projects for closure. A review of open projects or assets in the course of construction should be completed to confirm assets brought into use. This will also serve as a reminder for Project Managers to close their respective capital projects.</p>
<p><strong><u>Determine capital projects for closure</u></strong></p>
<p>Review the received report focusing on “% Compl.” Field. Communicate with the respective Project Managers on whether the project with 90% completion rate is ready for closure and capitalisation. Business will make a decision on closing based on their knowledge of the status of the project.</p>
<p>The report will appear as below with “% completion” in Column P:</p>
<p><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:6.14383in;height:3.22409in" /></p></td>
</tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5">Submit the open capital projects report to the Business for review. The Business validates and confirms capital projects for closure based on their knowledge of the status of the project.</td>
</tr>

<td><strong>8.4.2.4.4</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="initiate-project-capitalisation-andor-close">Initiate project Capitalisation and/or close</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<col style="width: 11%" />

<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>

</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.5</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="review-of-capital-project-expenditure">Review of capital project expenditure</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office reviews the capital project expenditure before proceeding to the final settlement run. Capital expenditures are reviewed against the budget assigned to the project.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive Assets Master Data Maintenance Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The project manager or Business partner shares the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template via email.</p>
<p><img src="media/image47.png" style="width:5.07058in;height:2.26866in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Ensure all fields in “Assets Master Data Maintenance Template” Tab “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” in red / marked with an asterisk are completed as per screenshots below:</p>
<p>Refer “Instructions” tab in the template for details.</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:6.30172in;height:2.38163in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image49.png" style="width:6.25342in;height:1.52003in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:6.32607in;height:1.96332in" /></p>
<p>Fill out the “Tax useful life” field based on local taxation ruling or another authorised source if applicable.</p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Compare Capital expenditures against the budget</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>In order to get the value of the asset (in local currency), go to SAP and key in T-code “S_ALR_87013558”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image51.png" style="width:4.77917in;height:1.48951in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D52864.A4BC6B70" /></p>
<p>Click on Dynamic selection icon <img src="media/image52.png" style="width:0.19539in;height:0.2247in" /> then under “Org. units definition”. Input Company code and Controlling Area or click on <img src="media/image53.png" style="width:0.34375in;height:0.25in" />to input details. Enter “E*” in “Project field” for all capital projects. Click on “execute” icon<img src="media/image54.png" style="width:0.1826in;height:0.2087in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:4.56806in" /></p>
<p>The report appears as below. Convert the report to local currency by clicking on “Currency selection” <img src="media/image56.png" style="width:0.16522in;height:0.16522in" />.</p>
<p>Current selection</p>
<p>Input local currency in “Currency” column and select “Default for drilldown reporting” in “Translation Key” column from the drop-down options, then click on “Execute” <img src="media/image54.png" style="width:0.17191in;height:0.19647in" /> icon.</p>
<p>\<img src="media/image60.png" /></p>
<p>Use the generated report to compare the capital expenditures against the budget and check available amounts by project as highlighted in below screen:</p>
<p><img src="media/image62.png" style="width:6.15625in;height:4.24167in" /></p></td>
</tr>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="request-for-creation-of-asset-shell-request">Request for creation of asset shell request</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GDO Back Office DMT</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>After ensuring all details are correct, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office requests GDO Back Office DMT for creation of asset shell with the updated templates.</p>
<p><strong><u>Send a request for asset shell creation</u></strong></p>
<p>Once the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template is complete, send the completed template for approval to the GFS Middle Office team lead. A sample email approval request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:6.226in;height:2.19387in" /></p>
<p>A sample email approval is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image64.png" style="width:6.17983in;height:2.83535in" /></p>
<p>Once approved, send an email request for a fixed asset creation to GDO Back Office DMT to process the request. A sample email request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image65.png" style="width:6.2708in;height:4.82571in" /></p></td>
</tr>
