<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.7</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="create-asset-shell">Create asset shell</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GDO Back Office DMT</td>
<td>GDO Back Office DMT</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office has submitted the request to create a new asset number, GDO Back Office DMT will create the asset shell in ERP system.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive and validate request to create a new capital asset</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>A.1) <u>Receive a request for new capital asset creation</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>GDO Back Office DMT accesses the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template through the mailbox. In case of Hubs, NPC template will be used instead of Assets Master Data Maintenance Template.</p>
<p>Note: Refer to the hubs-specific SOP for details. Please refer appendices for link.</p>
<p><img src="media/image66.png" style="width:6.08333in;height:2.07292in" /></p>
<p>A sample fixed asset creation request email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image65.png" style="width:6.2708in;height:4.82571in" /></p>
<p><strong>A.2) <u>Open Assets Master Data Maintenance Template </u></strong></p>
<p>Open the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template from the attachment in the email request.</p>
<p>Make sure the requester has filled out all required information into the respective tabs as per following steps:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Ensure all mandatory fields (all fields with asterisk ‘*’, highlighted in red and blue colour font for the ‘New’ request type) are complete in the “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>Ensure that the maintenance type is “NEW”</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Please refer to the screen shot of the template below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:6.30172in;height:2.38163in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image67.png" style="width:6.30856in;height:1.96638in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:6.30849in;height:1.81432in" /></p>
<p>Make sure all information is accurate and then proceed to create the asset number. In case of any clarification being required, contact the requestor.</p>
<p><strong><u>Open SAP for capital asset verification</u></strong></p>
<p>Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Go to T-code KS03 to check whether the cost centre is active.</p>
<p><img src="media/image69.png" style="width:1.96875in;height:0.51042in" /></p>
<p>Please update the following information in fields below:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Controlling Area – Controlling Area code for the respective country from the asset shell creation request (refer to <strong>section 9 Appendices</strong>)</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Center – the Cost Centre as per the request</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image70.png" style="width:5.30208in;height:3.48958in" /></p>
<p>To open a list of controlling areas, click on the icon <img src="media/image71.png" style="width:0.16667in;height:0.2in" />. Select a controlling area and click on <img src="media/image72.png" style="width:0.18537in;height:0.16683in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image72.png" style="width:4.17312in;height:2.61825in" /></p>
<p>To ensure the cost center is active, proceed to the “Control” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image73.png" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>New single capital asset creation</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To create asset log in using the T-code AS01 and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image74.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.66667in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the company code and asset numbers as per the request template (the fields “Asset Class” and “Company Code” in “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab. “Number of similar assets” is “1” by default for a single asset creation)</p>
<p>The screen will appear as below while entering the above-mentioned details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image75.png" style="width:3.67in;height:2.27in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the information on the SAP screen as given below:</p>
<p>Note: <strong>Create Asset: Master data</strong> varies amongst different SAP instances. Please refer to your respective Regional SOP if applicable.</p>
<p><img src="media/image76.png" style="width:6.41154in;height:6.53634in" /></p>
<p>In case “Description” is too long refer to screenshot below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image79.png" style="width:5.65765in;height:5.67083in" /></p>
<p>Insert full description and click<img src="media/image80.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.27083in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image81.png" style="width:6.22861in;height:3.17in" /></p>
<p>Once clicked <img src="media/image80.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.27083in" />, click Yes before exiting the text.</p>
<p><img src="media/image82.png" style="width:3.5in;height:1.34375in" /></p>
<p>A notification appears at the bottom of the page stating, “Text was saved”, per below screenshot:</p>
<p><img src="media/image84.png" style="width:6.07292in;height:4.98958in" /></p>
<p>Continue to “Time-dependent” tab in SAP, fill-in the details as per the template:</p>
<p><img src="media/image85.png" style="width:5.96199in;height:3.4945in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Deprec. Areas” tab. Depreciation areas show the depreciation information of a fixed asset for the accounting and tax purposes. Complete the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>‘Dkey’:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For ‘Book deprec.’ – ‘Depreciation Key for Book’ in the “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For ‘Spec. dep.’ – ‘Depreciation Key for Tax’ in the “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>‘UseLife’:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For ‘Book deprec.’ – ‘Useful Life for Book’ in the “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For ‘Spec. dep.’ – ‘Useful Life for Tax’ in the “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p>The below screen appears on entering these details:</p>
<p>4. Click Save</p>
<p>After filling out all the information, click <img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.26042in" /> in above screen to generate asset number in the system. SAP will reflect the Asset number of the asset so generated.</p>
<p><img src="media/image88.png" style="width:6.01181in;height:3.44194in" /></p>
<p>Fill Asset Number into the “Asset Number” and “Asset Sub-Number” fields in the “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab in the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template for recording purposes.</p>
<p><img src="media/image89.png" style="width:6.4256in;height:2.45847in" /></p>
<p>Click Save as and save the templates into GDO Back Office DMT shared folder:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>The shared folder as per following example: \YYYY\Operation\Country code\2. Maintain Asset Master data\MM. MMMM\New (e.g.\2017\Operation\AU\2. Maintain Asset Master Data\01. January\New)</p></li>
<li><p>The file name as per the following mask: Request date_R2R-Asset number – Asset New / AUC Completion (e.g.: 12.01.2017_R2R-117100036791 – Asset New)</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Kindly attach the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template into an email to inform the requester, once the asset creation is complete. A sample email confirmation is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image90.png" style="width:1.72656in;height:0.12121in" /><img src="media/image91.png" style="width:3.2845in;height:4.11667in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>New mass capital assets creation</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>When the request is for creation of more than one asset with different information e.g. description or asset class, the requester will have filled in the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template.</p>
<p>The following steps only apply to asset creation with the same Asset Class. In case of different asset class, follow the steps under <strong>B) New single capital asset creation</strong> for asset creation.</p>
<p>Open the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image92.png" style="width:6.38402in;height:2.77475in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image93.png" style="width:6.37985in;height:1.2421in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image94.png" style="width:6.36974in;height:1.60111in" /></p>
<p>Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:6.32153in;height:4.25208in" /></p>
<p>To create asset log in using the T-code AS01 and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image74.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.66667in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the company code and fill in the number of similar assets as per the template and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image95.png" style="width:6.21844in;height:2.68693in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image96.jpeg" style="width:4.81739in;height:2.97523in" /></p>
<p>Create the Asset by filling up details in SAP as per template:</p>
<p>Note: <strong>Create Asset: Master data</strong> varies across different SAP instances. Please refer to your respective Regional / Local SOP if applicable.</p>
<p><img src="media/image97.png" style="width:5.46126in;height:5.59317in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Time-dependent” tab and create as per the template, if data is provided:</p>
<p><img src="media/image85.png" style="width:5.96199in;height:3.4945in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Deprec.Areas” tab. Update the details as mentioned in the below screenshot:</p>
<p><img src="media/image86.png" style="width:6.44583in;height:3.23819in" /></p>
<p>After filling out all the information, click <img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.26042in" />.</p>
<p>Click on “Create” when a message appears to confirm for Asset creation:</p>
<p><img src="media/image98.png" style="width:5.58714in;height:3.31786in" /></p>
<p>For multiple assets, complete a new line for the different asset. Fields to update include:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Description (mandatory field)</p></li>
<li><p>Inventory number</p></li>
<li><p>Business Area</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Center (mandatory field)</p></li>
<li><p>Evaluation group from Ev.1 until Ev.5</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image100.png" style="width:5.76721in;height:2.64613in" /></p>
<p>After completing the information, click <img src="media/image99.png" style="width:0.26042in;height:0.30208in" /> and SAP will pop up messages again, click “Create”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image98.png" style="width:4.91717in;height:2.92in" /></p>
<p>System will generate the Asset numbers as shown in below screenshot:</p>
<p><img src="media/image101.png" style="width:4.87682in;height:3.05051in" /></p>
<p>For those fields which are different for mass asset creation and haven’t been updated in previous step, go to T-code AS02 to change them manually.</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:1.20833in;height:0.42227in" /></p>
<p>Change asset master record if required as per the request.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:2.90573in;height:2.93in" /></p>
<p>Fill asset number into the “Asset Number” and “Asset Sub-Number” fields in the “Assets Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab in the Assets Master Data Maintenance template for recording purposes.</p>
<p><img src="media/image104.png" style="width:6.23823in;height:2.43514in" /></p>
<p>Click Save as and save the templates into GDO Back Office DMT shared folder:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>The shared folder as per following example: .. \YYYY\Operation\Country code\2. Maintain Asset Master data\MM. MMMM\New (e.g.: ..\2017\Operation\MY\2. Maintain Asset Master data\01. January\New)</p></li>
<li><p>The file name as per the following mask: Request Date_R2R-Asset number – Asset Change (e.g.: 12.01.2017_R2R-911510000888 – Asset New)</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Kindly attach the templates into an email to inform the requester, once an asset creation is completed. A sample email confirmation is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image90.png" style="width:1.72656in;height:0.12121in" /><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:2.88479in;height:3.7449in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.8</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="ensure-hr-assignments-to-the-project-are-closed-and-check-for-open-po-and-te-commitments">Ensure HR assignments to the project are closed and check for Open PO and T&amp;E commitments</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once GDO Back Office DMT has created the asset shell in ERP system, to ensure readiness for project closure, the Business needs to get the report from the payroll system for all employees who have assignment to WBSE (Work with HR to update the salary assignment to other relevant cost centre or other open WBSE). Other reports that need to be requested are: Open PO report and Travel and expense report. In case of any pending items (such as open</p>
<p>Pos and not assigned T&amp;E) they should be closed first before proceeding to the <strong>step 4.7.9: 8.4.2.4.9 Complete project capitalisation template.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 11%" />
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.9</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="complete-project-capitalisation-template">Complete project capitalisation template</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Business completes the capitalisation template and attaches the template in an email to request for approval. Business completes settlement rules based on its understanding of the AUC nature and the physical assets created referring to supporting purchasing documents if applicable. For Hubs, Business will need to submit Notice of Project Completion (NPC) Template. For details, please refer to respective Regional SOP.</p>
<p>Please note that the below example is for illustrative purposes only. The amounts in the example do not match with the above template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image106.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.97708in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.10</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="obtain-approval">Obtain approval</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance/GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>The Business submits the capitalisation request for review and approval by the required personnel as listed in the DOA. Obtain approval via email so that capitalisation can proceed.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Request approval</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>If the request is declined <strong>proceed to step 4.7.8:</strong> <strong>8.4.2.4.8 Ensure HR assignments to the project are closed and check for Open PO and T&amp;E commitments</strong>.</p>
<p>When approval is obtained and:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Template is not complete <strong>proceed to step 4.7.8:</strong> <strong>8.4.2.4.8 Ensure HR assignments to the project are closed and check for Open PO and T&amp;E commitments</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>Template is complete <strong>proceed to step 4.7.11:</strong> <strong>8.4.2.4.11 Perform Final Settlement (WBSE to AUC)</strong>.</p></li>
</ul>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Send a request for asset capitalisation.</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image107.png" style="width:4.8804in;height:3.14962in" /></p>
<p>Once approved, the next step is for the GFS Back Office R2R team to process the email request.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.11</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="perform-final-settlement-wbse-to-auc">Perform final settlement (WBSE to AUC)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>GFS Back Office R2R checks the asset under construction identified to be put into operations. Then performs the settlement process from WBSE to AUC.</p>
<p>Please note: The AUC settlement can be both single and mass settlement. Refer <strong>step A) Single settlement and B) Mass settlement for details.</strong></p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Single settlement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>A.1) Test run for single settlement</strong></p>
<p>Enter T-code CJ88 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image108.png" style="width:3.02541in;height:1.94448in" /></p>
<p>Key in the Project Number and execute in the present period. Execute Test Run to check for any errors.</p>
<p><img src="media/image109.png" style="width:3.31447in;height:2.96708in" /></p>
<p>The Settlement will show a page like below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image110.png" style="width:5.5339in;height:4.10211in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>A.2) <u>Run actual single settlement</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>After ensuring settlement can run correctly without error, go back to the previous page (Press F3).</p>
<p>Untick Test Run and proceed to Execute.</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:5in;height:4.4667in" /></p>
<p>The result after the actual run will be as follows:</p>
<p><img src="media/image112.png" style="width:5.5339in;height:4.08475in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>A.3) <u>Check settlement run results</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>CJ88 will move costs from WBSE to AUC by triggering the following entry:</p>
<p>Debit AUC GL Asset Under Construction/AICC</p>
<p>Credit 99101090 Capital project settlement</p>
<p>After settlement, check that 99101090 and 99100010 combinations net off to zero. This can be examined via CJI3 or F.01.</p>
<p><u>Option 1</u>: CJI3 – Display WBSE actual costs by line item</p>
<p><img src="media/image113.png" style="width:6.29167in;height:1.86806in" /></p>
<p><u>Option 2</u>: F.01 – Display Financial Statement</p>
<p><img src="media/image114.png" style="width:6.26042in;height:2.21875in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>A.4) <u>Check settlement values posts to GL</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Also, check that the settlement is posted into the correct AUC GL. This can be examined via FBL3N. Enter T-code FBL3N in SAP:</p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:3.45316in;height:1.59188in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D5286F.14CC9390" /></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Key in Company Code</p></li>
<li><p>Key in G/L account: 99100010 and 99101090</p></li>
<li><p>Key in all items posting date: Current month.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image116.png" style="width:6.1875in;height:3.47917in" /></p>
<p>Check “Offset.acct” column to ensure the settlement has posted into AUC GL – 12XXXXXX.</p>
<p><img src="media/image117.png" style="width:6.22917in;height:1.30208in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Mass settlement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>B.1) Test run for mass settlement</strong></p>
<p>Enter T-code CJ8G in SAP and press Enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image118.png" style="width:3.51304in;height:1.18261in" /></p>
<p>Below screen will appear. Enter Controlling Area:</p>
<p><img src="media/image119.png" style="width:5.67708in;height:3.07844in" /></p>
<p>To change the Controlling Area, click on “Extras” in the Menu Bar and select Set Controlling Area as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image120.png" style="width:5.72627in;height:3.1427in" /></p>
<p>Check the list of controlling Areas in the below screenshot</p>
<p><img src="media/image121.jpeg" style="width:4.56522in;height:3.54774in" alt="cid:image003.jpg@01D5A548.CE4626F0" /></p>
<p>Click on Selection Variant and a box appears.</p>
<p><img src="media/image122.png" style="width:5.43481in;height:3.55149in" /></p>
<p>Choose the required variant from below list as shown below:</p>
<p>Choose Variant “Projects-all projects”</p>
<p>For NAM : Choose Variant “PS.CPRJSE.ALL-ALL Co Codes C Proj settlement”</p>
<p><img src="media/image123.png" style="width:2.95652in;height:2.53044in" /><img src="media/image124.png" style="width:3.44156in;height:2.57532in" /></p>
<p>Key in the Settlement and posting period, fiscal year and choose processing type “automatic type”. Please ensure “Test run”, “Detail list” &amp; “Check. Trans data” should be ticked in Processing Options box. Then click the pencil icon to check the variant parameter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image125.png" style="width:4.61975in;height:2.22271in" /></p>
<p>For single project selection and input specific WBS element under “Select Single Values”.</p>
<p>Further on same screen, click on “Select Ranges” tab and key in “00000 to 29999” and click execute <img src="media/image126.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /> button.</p>
<p><img src="media/image127.png" style="width:5.99883in;height:2.51999in" /></p>
<p>Below screen will appear, now click on dynamic icon on the left of the screen as highlighted below and input Project number:</p>
<p><img src="media/image128.png" style="width:5.7126in;height:1.90642in" /></p>
<p>Key in company code which needs to be excluded, if any.</p>
<p><img src="media/image129.png" style="width:4.65217in;height:2.35652in" /></p>
<p><u>Note:</u> If extracting the data for UK only, exclude the data for UK40,UK46 and UK47 as these company codes are for UK MEDI. To exclude multiple company codes, click on the right arrow icon in above screen and enter the company codes in “Exclude Single Values tab”. Eg. For UK key in UK40,UK46 and UK47 and click on execute <img src="media/image130.png" style="width:0.16662in;height:0.17704in" /> icon.</p>
<p><img src="media/image131.png" style="width:4.42693in;height:2.27921in" /></p>
<p>Click F8 to run T-code CJ8G in background:</p>
<p>Key in “LOCL Generic Frontend Printing” in the output device icon.</p>
<p>Key in Page 1 until 10000000 in page icon.</p>
<p>Choose “Immediately” in Print time drop-down.</p>
<p>Then click the green tick. Sap will run in background.</p>
<p><img src="media/image132.png" style="width:2.98261in;height:2.7913in" /></p>
<p>Go to SAP T-code SM37.</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:5.8in;height:2.13889in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D54D36.D934DA30" /></p>
<p>Check the status as “Finished” means the file is finished and executed. Double click the spool icon.</p>
<p><img src="media/image134.png" style="width:4.06087in;height:1.75652in" /></p>
<p>After clicking on the Spool icon in above screen, below screen will pop up ,double click on ABAP list:</p>
<p><img src="media/image135.png" style="width:4.13043in;height:0.84348in" /></p>
<p>Key in the settings from “page 1 to 100000” in the pop-up box which comes on clicking on “Settings”.</p>
<p>Click on the green tick<img src="media/image136.png" style="width:0.15832in;height:0.20703in" /> in below screen:</p>
<p><img src="media/image137.png" style="width:3.6in;height:3.25217in" /></p>
<p>File will be executed in excel, if there is no error, run CJ8G without ticking the test run. If there is any error, please rectify them and run CJ8G without ticking the test run.</p>
<p>If there is no error, screen will show as below. (Please note the project number E.009260 shown here is for illustrative purposes only. It doesn’t match with the above template).</p>
<p><img src="media/image138.png" style="width:5.81394in;height:3.28935in" /></p>
<p>If there is an error, screen will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image139.png" style="width:5.84004in;height:3.03194in" /></p>
<p>Examples of errors are shared below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image140.png" style="width:5.34375in;height:0.11532in" /><img src="media/image141.png" style="width:5.33333in;height:1.36042in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image142.png" style="width:5.33333in;height:0.23352in" /></p>
<p>Follow the steps below to rectify if the error is about the settlement rule. Here we are referring to WBS Element E.009851.01.04.10 as an example.</p>
<p><img src="media/image143.png" style="width:4.45217in;height:2.63478in" /></p>
<hr />
<p>To resolve error of Settlement rule, please enter T-code CJ02 in SAP:</p>
<p><img src="media/image144.png" style="width:3.80863in;height:2.02797in" /></p>
<p>Below screen will pop up, key in WBS element and press Enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image145.png" style="width:5.73958in;height:2.45833in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the below fields:</p>
<p>In Cat field key in: WBS,</p>
<p>In “%” field key in: “100”,</p>
<p>In Settlement type field key in “FUL”</p>
<p>Now click on “Ctrl+S”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image146.png" style="width:5.13913in;height:2.26087in" /></p>
<p>Then run back again in CJ88, WBS will be executed and check in CJI3 again amount will be zero. That means the unsettled amount will be fully settled.</p>
<p><u>Note:</u> In case the error pertains to one WBS, use SAP T-code CJ88 to settle errors. In other cases where errors occur in more than one WBS, use T-code CJ8G.</p>
<p><strong>B.2) <u>Run actual mass settlement </u></strong></p>
<p>After rectifying all the errors, re-run CJ8G again and if the report is executed successfully with no errors, un-tick the test run and run back again the CJ8G for an actual production run.</p>
<p>Enter T-code CJ8G in SAP and press Enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image147.png" style="width:4.23478in;height:1.8in" /></p>
<p>Below screen appears when settlement run without error:</p>
<p>If error occurs, follow the steps mentioned in <strong>Step 4.7.9: 8.4.2.2.9 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)</strong> to run CJ8G to resolve errors.</p>
<p><img src="media/image138.png" style="width:5.38542in;height:4.33194in" /></p>
<p>Click on the detail list icon <img src="media/image148.png" style="width:0.25in;height:0.27083in" /> as highlighted in above screen and check whether the amount has been executed / settled.</p>
<p><img src="media/image149.png" style="width:5.82292in;height:2.56944in" /></p>
<p>Enter SAP T-code CJI3 in SAP to check completeness of projects settlement:</p>
<p><img src="media/image150.png" style="width:3.9913in;height:1.95652in" /></p>
<p>The below screen will appear when you hit Enter.</p>
<p>Enter the Controlling Area and click on green tick<img src="media/image151.png" style="width:0.17387in;height:0.17389in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image152.png" style="width:6.05661in;height:3.18511in" /></p>
<p>Enter Database prof. as shown below and click on green tick <img src="media/image151.png" style="width:0.17387in;height:0.17389in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image153.png" style="width:5.60996in;height:1.60701in" /></p>
<p>Enter Project number and Posting date and click on execute<img src="media/image126.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /> icon.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Fill in project number</p></li>
<li><p>Enter date range in project date</p></li>
<li><p>Click on execute</p></li>
</ol>
<p>The report will appear as below. Check the Val/CO Area Crcy is zero.</p>
<p><img src="media/image155.png" style="width:5.75in;height:3.99792in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.12</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="post-project-settlement-auc-to-assets">Post project settlement (AUC to Assets)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once GFS Back Office R2R has completed the settlement process from WBSE to AUC and Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office has submitted the request to capitalise AUC, GFS Back Office R2R transfers the costs from AUC to Asset.</p>
<p>Please ensure that you perform control CPX005B / CPX005BC as per FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<p>Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive and validate request to capitalise asset</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Validate the AUC Settlement template received in email. Please find below the AUC template for reference.</p>
<p><img src="media/image156.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.94444in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Post project settlement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code AS03 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image157.png" style="width:5in;height:2.36041in" /></p>
<p>Enter the AUC number (field “Asset Number”) and the company code (field “Company Code”) as in the “AUC Settlement” tab to check its details. Press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image158.png" style="width:4.49118in;height:1.95146in" /></p>
<p>Check the asset details. Make sure the asset is not deactivated. “Deactivation on” should be blank.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Insert the “Asset no”</p></li>
<li><p>Class no</p></li>
<li><p>Fill in the Description</p></li>
<li><p>Enter Asset main no.text</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Click on “Asset Values” to check the AUC NBV.</p>
<p><img src="media/image160.png" style="width:5in;height:1.9152in" /></p>
<p>The NBV should be equal to or greater than the settlement amount in the Capitalisation template. In this example, the settlement amount is smaller (CNY 2,837,071.04) than the NBV amount (CNY 2,963,609.55), so that is correct.</p>
<p><img src="media/image161.png" style="width:1.375in;height:0.34375in" /><img src="media/image162.png" style="width:5.97699in;height:3.48449in" /></p>
<p>Check if the values match i.e. values in SAP to values in AUC Settlement Form / Template, continue to the next step. If the asset values don’t match, query back this request to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office for amendment.</p>
<p><img src="media/image163.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.97639in" /></p>
<p>Check that the Receiver Asset Numbers have already been created, using T-code AS03 in the same way as when checking the AUC number.</p>
<p><img src="media/image164.jpeg" style="width:3.73333in;height:3.67376in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image163.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.97639in" /></p>
<p>Check for all the Receiver Asset numbers from AUC Settlement Template.</p>
<p>After checking all the asset numbers, proceed to T-code AIAB to assign the distribution rule.</p>
<p><img src="media/image165.png" style="width:5in;height:1.44068in" /></p>
<p>Enter the company code (field “Company Code”), AUC number and Sub-Number {field “Sender (Asset Number)”} as per the “AUC Settlement template” tab in the AUC Settlement Template. Click the “Execute” button<img src="media/image166.png" style="width:0.26042in;height:0.22917in" /> (Or F8).</p>
<p><img src="media/image167.png" style="width:5in;height:3.31151in" /></p>
<p>You will see the list of transaction lines for the AUC that total to its NBV. Click on the AsstValDat column, then click the Ascending button<img src="media/image168.png" style="width:0.21875in;height:0.20833in" /> to sort them from oldest to newest.</p>
<p><img src="media/image169.png" style="width:6.22133in;height:2.99315in" /></p>
<p>Start to assign the lines with status <img src="media/image169.png" style="width:0.26869in;height:0.13898in" /> to the Receiver assets, starting from the oldest line where possible. Select the line (or multiple lines), then click “Enter” button<img src="media/image170.png" style="width:0.59375in;height:0.1875in" />. There are four possible options:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>It is possible to match one transaction to one asset based on values.</p></li>
<li><p>It is possible to match one transaction to multiple assets based on values.</p></li>
<li><p>It is possible to assign multiple transactions to one asset.</p></li>
<li><p>Assign a part of the remaining transaction value to an asset.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>In case it is possible to match one transaction to one asset based on values perform one-to-one assignment.</p>
<p><img src="media/image171.png" style="width:6.21684in;height:2.94175in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image172.png" style="width:4.7913in;height:2.13889in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image173.png" style="width:4.76522in;height:0.21736in" /></p>
<p>Enter the Receiver asset number into the “Settlement Receiver” column.</p>
<p><img src="media/image174.png" style="width:5.98031in;height:1.46793in" /></p>
<p>If 100% of the line’s amount will be distributed to the asset, press Enter. The Cat (Category) and Receiver Short Text (Asset description) will auto populate, and the percentage will be automatically set to 100%.</p>
<p><img src="media/image175.jpg" style="width:6.13052in;height:1.25942in" /></p>
<p>Click on the back button <img src="media/image176.png" style="width:0.21995in;height:0.2118in" /> (or F3) to return to continue to assign the other transaction lines. You will notice that the line now has a green status to show that it has been assigned a distribution rule.</p>
<p>Assign a single transaction line to multiple assets like below example.</p>
<p>Select the line and click “Enter” <img src="media/image177.png" style="width:0.625in;height:0.25in" />button.</p>
<p><img src="media/image178.png" style="width:5.84269in;height:2.3887in" /></p>
<p>Key in the multiple assets and their amounts since we are not assigning the full transaction line amount to the assets, but just a portion.</p>
<p><img src="media/image179.png" style="width:6.18677in;height:2.38451in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image180.png" style="width:6.44583in;height:2.93264in" /></p>
<p>Press Enter for the Category and Receiver Short Text to get auto populated. Then click the back button <img src="media/image176.png" style="width:0.21995in;height:0.2118in" /> (or F3) to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image181.jpg" style="width:4.67879in;height:2.22642in" /></p>
<p>To select multiple lines, hold down the control (“Ctrl”) key while clicking the left mouse button on the certain lines. Note: the multiple lines cannot have total value more than the asset, if it does, the system will encounter an error when trying to post the distribution.</p>
<p><img src="media/image182.png" style="width:6.19373in;height:4.07619in" /></p>
<p>As we want to assign the total amount of the selected lines (CNY2,258,669.28), the percentage should be 100%. Press Enter and allow the details to auto-populate. Then click on the Back button.</p>
<p><img src="media/image183.jpg" style="width:6.18333in;height:1.37259in" /></p>
<p>Asset 1201085 is still short of CNY488,976.12. Assign that value with the second line (CNY525,495.83). If there is only one line selected, its value can exceed the value to be assigned to the asset. Click the “Enter” button.</p>
<p><img src="media/image184.png" style="width:5.02558in;height:1.58491in" /></p>
<p>Enter the asset number and the remaining amount. Press Enter for the details to auto-populate. Then click on F3 to go back.</p>
<p><img src="media/image185.jpg" style="width:6.1958in;height:1.46725in" /></p>
<p>Once all the assets have been assigned their values as requested in the form. Click the Save button <img src="media/image186.png" style="width:0.25in;height:0.26042in" />(Or Ctrl+S). Then click “Settlement” button <img src="media/image187.png" style="width:0.77083in;height:0.21875in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image188.png" style="width:6.20165in;height:4.57622in" /></p>
<p>If you clicked “Settlement” without saving, the system will prompt you to save the distribution rules: Simple click Yes to save.</p>
<p><img src="media/image189.png" style="width:2.587in;height:1.31019in" /></p>
<p>Clicking the “Settlement” button will automatically take the user to the AIBU T-code page.</p>
<p>The company code and AUC number have already been filled out. Make sure they are correct, correct them if needed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image190.jpg" style="width:5.61107in;height:2.87218in" /></p>
<p>Once all details are complete, click Simulate button <img src="media/image191.png" style="width:0.25in;height:0.23958in" /> to show the transaction.</p>
<p><img src="media/image192.png" style="width:4.90489in;height:1.3346in" /></p>
<p>If there are no errors, you will see the transaction like the example below. Check that the amounts match to the correct asset number.</p>
<p><img src="media/image193.png" style="width:6.20229in;height:3.62634in" /></p>
<p>To ensure the project settlement is posted successfully, go back to T-code AS03 and check the AUC number.</p>
<p>In “Planned Values” tab, the NBV will now show the asset’s remaining value after the AUC Capitalisation. There will also be new transaction(s) below showing the capitalisation.</p>
<p><img src="media/image194.png" style="width:6.22707in;height:3.61092in" /></p>
<p>To check the capitalisation posting, go to T-code FB03.</p>
<p><img src="media/image195.png" style="width:5.375in;height:1.97222in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D52C60.0BA01220" /></p>
<p>Key in the Document Number, Company Code and Fiscal Year. Press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image196.png" style="width:6.17914in;height:2.42772in" /></p>
<p>The document will look like below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image197.png" style="width:6.17845in;height:3.38617in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.13</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="generate-report-on-open-po-commitments-on-wbse-elements-request-for-capitalisation">Generate report on open PO commitments on WBSE elements request for capitalisation</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Business, GDO Back Office DMT</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>GFS Back Office R2R will generate a report within SAP to review and confirm if all transactions have been finalised and if project settlement has been posted.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retrieve open PO commitments.</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Access SAP transaction S_ALR_87013542.</p>
<p><img src="media/image198.png" style="width:5.50694in;height:2.03472in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D52DC8.B8A248D0" /></p>
<p>Insert WBSE Number and Controlling Area and then Press Execute.</p>
<p><img src="media/image199.png" style="width:5.00003in;height:3.6in" /></p>
<p>The screen below contains Actual, Commitment and Total amount against this WBSE.</p>
<p><img src="media/image200.png" style="width:5in;height:2.7625in" /></p>
<p>To proceed to Pending Commitments double click on Commitments Amount, a new window will open as in screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image201.png" style="width:5in;height:3.46774in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Change Layout” icon in order to adjust the set of fields and shown PO and Other details as in screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image202.png" style="width:5in;height:3.24033in" /></p>
<p>Select options: Ref Document Number, Transaction Currency, Reference Item, Acct assgnmnt number. Click<img src="media/image99.png" style="width:0.26042in;height:0.30208in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image203.png" style="width:6.19203in;height:2.57479in" /></p>
<p>Report contains commitment line items for projects.</p>
<p><img src="media/image204.png" style="width:6.19792in;height:2.48958in" /></p>
<p>Commitments at PO level can only be closed by the PO creator or PO superuser. Share this report with the requester to get these commitments closed.</p>
<p>Click on List&gt; Export&gt;Spreadsheet to extract the file for sharing.</p>
<p><img src="media/image205.png" style="width:5.46667in;height:1.60833in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D37A5D.AB853F60" /></p>
<p>Click <img src="media/image206.png" style="width:0.225in;height:0.25833in" alt="cid:image004.png@01D37A5D.AB853F60" /> to close the information window.</p>
<p><img src="media/image207.png" style="width:4.5in;height:1.75in" alt="cid:image002.png@01D37A5D.AB853F60" /></p>
<p>Select “Table”, then click<img src="media/image206.png" style="width:0.225in;height:0.25833in" alt="cid:image004.png@01D37A5D.AB853F60" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image208.png" style="width:2.96667in;height:2.40833in" alt="cid:image003.png@01D37A5D.AB853F60" /></p>
<p>Click <img src="media/image206.png" style="width:0.225in;height:0.25833in" alt="cid:image004.png@01D37A5D.AB853F60" /> to confirm the report export.</p>
<p><img src="media/image206.png" style="width:1.9in;height:1.25833in" alt="cid:image004.png@01D37A5D.AB853F60" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>ii) Retrieve open PO commitments (COUPA PO commitment)</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Go to <a href="https://astrazeneca.coupahost.com/user/home">Coupa</a>.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>For <strong>single project code</strong>:</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Go to Purchase Orders. Select parameters as below, then click Search.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Filter by: Account</p></li>
<li><p>Is in: (<em>Respective company code</em>) _Fixed_Assets_Capex_Purchases</p></li>
<li><p>And: Contains</p></li>
<li><p>ACT_TYPE: insert project code without dot (“.”)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image209.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:1.81319in" /></p>
<p>Ensure the statuses of all POs are inactive (eg: Soft closed [PO invoice has been received], Cancelled [PO has been cancelled], Closed [PO has been closed], etc.)</p>
<p>If the PO status is issued [Open PO commitment], proceed to <strong>Step C - Send the open commitments reports to the requester</strong></p>
<p><img src="media/image210.png" style="width:6.19533in;height:3.18535in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="1">
<li><p>For <strong>multiple project codes:</strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Go to Invoices. Select parameters as below, then click Search.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Filter by: Account</p></li>
<li><p>Is in: (<em>Respective company code</em>) _Fixed_Assets_Capex_Purchases</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image211.png" style="width:6.47329in;height:1.98355in" /></p>
<p>Download the accrual report and it will be sent to your personal mailbox.</p>
<p>Filter ‘Segment 2’ by each project code. The amount showing in ‘Uninvoiced Total’ is the PO commitment value.</p>
<p><img src="media/image212.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:3.12083in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Send the open commitments reports to the requester</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Attach the reports and ask for the requester to get the commitments closed before WBSE can be closed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image213.png" style="width:5.46429in;height:6.98576in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check any open commitments exist.</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check whether open commitments exist:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>If yes, <strong>proceed to step 4.7.14: 8.4.2.4.14 Ensure all open commitments are closed.</strong></p></li>
<li><p>If there are no open commitments, proceed to step <strong>4.7.15: 8.4.2.4.15 Update project status upon review</strong></p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">

<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />

<thead>
<tr>

</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.14</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="ensure-all-open-commitments-are-closed">Ensure all open commitments are closed</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Business will review the completion of open commitments. If follow up is required because of a missing invoice, Business will provide guidance on the next steps and follow up with third party if required.</p>
<p><strong><u>Ensure all open commitments are closed.</u></strong></p>
<p>Once ensured that all open commitments are closed <strong>proceed to step 4.7.11: 8.4.2.4.11 Perform final settlement (WBSE to AUC).</strong></p></td>
</tr>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.15</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="update-project-status-upon-review">4.7.15 Update project status upon review</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2"><mark>GDO Back Office DMT</mark></td>
<td><mark>GDO Back Office DMT</mark></td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td><mark>GDO Back Office DMT</mark></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If there are no open commitments, Business will review the completion status of the capital project.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive a project closure request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p><mark>GDO Back Office DMT</mark> will access the E code WBSE Maintenance Form though the mailbox</p>
<p><img src="media/image214.jpeg" style="width:6.20833in;height:2.08256in" /></p>
<p>A sample email fixed asset creation request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image215.jpg" style="width:3.48624in;height:4.28351in" /></p>
<p>Open the E code WBSE Maintenance Form from the attachment of the email request.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Change project status to closed</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Access SAP transaction CJ02.</p>
<p><img src="media/image216.jpg" style="width:1.96in;height:0.71333in" /></p>
<p>Insert WBS Number which needs to be closed and ensure commitments are cleared and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image217.jpg" style="width:5in;height:2.28in" /></p>
<p>Click on Status in Edit Tab, go to Status, click on Close(B).</p>
<p><img src="media/image218.jpg" style="width:5in;height:2.97333in" /></p>
<p>The project status will change to Closed (CLSD). Click on Save and exit.</p>
<p><img src="media/image219.jpg" style="width:5in;height:3.00667in" /></p>
<p>Once status has changed to CLSD, confirm back to the requester by sending an email. A sample email confirmation is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image220.jpg" style="width:3.78549in;height:3.43134in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 13%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.16</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="confirm-that-all-open-items-are-closed-on-the-project">Confirm that all open items are closed on the project</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GDO Back Office DMT</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Business will confirm the completion of open commitments.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check any additional cost</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check if any additional cost is required to be booked on to the project:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>In case with additional cost <strong>proceed to step 4.7.17:</strong> <strong>8.4.2.4.17 Release project.</strong></p></li>
<li><p>In case without additional cost <strong>proceed to step 4.7.15: 8.4.2.4.15 Mark project as closed.</strong></p></li>
</ul>
<p>In each case E code WBSE Maintenance Form should be complete and an email request should be placed. Refer to <strong>step B) Complete the E code WBSE Maintenance Form and step C) Create an Email request</strong>.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Complete the E code WBSE Maintenance Form</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Complete the <strong>“Project Creation Webform” tab</strong> in the E code WBSE Maintenance Form. All fields marked with an asterisk (*) and red colour are mandatory to complete.</p>
<p>Input the below fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Maintenance Type:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>To release the project back – “Change”</p></li>
<li><p>To close the project – “Close”</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>Country – Country of the entity</p></li>
<li><p>Requester’s email – Email Address of the requester</p></li>
<li><p>System Status:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>To release the project back – “REL Released”</p></li>
<li><p>To close the project – “CLSD Closed (Definitive)”</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p>The change request form to release the project back as per the screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image221.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:5.97361in" /></p>
<p>The close request form to close the project as per the screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image222.png" style="width:3.72533in;height:3.89613in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create an Email request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once the E code WBSE Maintenance Form is complete, send the completed form for approval to the team lead. Sample email approval request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image223.png" style="width:3.09636in;height:0.14236in" /><img src="media/image224.jpg" style="width:4in;height:2.11618in" /></p>
<p>A sample email approval is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image225.jpg" style="width:4in;height:3.36929in" /></p>
<p>Once approved, send an email request for a project status change to the GDO Back Office DMT team to process the request. A sample email request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image227.jpeg" /></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="4">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.4.17</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="release-project">Release project</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GDO Back Office DMT</td>
<td>GDO Back Office DMT</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Mark project back as released.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive a project status change request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>GDO Back Office DMT will access the E code WBSE Maintenance Form though the mailbox.</p>
<p><img src="media/image214.jpeg" style="width:6.32292in;height:2.08256in" /></p>
<p>A sample email fixed asset creation request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image223.png" style="width:2.42197in;height:0.11136in" /><img src="media/image215.jpg" style="width:3.26685in;height:4.01395in" /></p>
<p>Open the E code WBSE Maintenance Form from the attachment in the email request.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Change project status to released</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Access SAP transaction CJ02.</p>
<p><img src="media/image216.jpg" style="width:1.96in;height:0.71333in" /></p>
<p>Insert WBS Number which needs to be closed and ensure commitments are cleared and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image217.jpg" style="width:5in;height:2.28in" /></p>
<p>Click on Edit and “Cancel Close tech.”; status will change to Released (REL).</p>
<p><img src="media/image227.jpg" style="width:4.99774in;height:3.0253in" /></p>

# RESPONSIBILITIES

## Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Role / Team | Description |
| Business | Refers to the respective Project Requesters (e.g. Project Managers) that would run the project on a day-to-day basis and would know when to request the closure of the project code. They would then be notified of project code closure |
| Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office | Refers to Embedded Finance and GFS Middle Office that would assist Business identifying projects for closure, reviewing project expenditure and requesting for asset shell creation |
| GDO Back Office DMT | Refers to the GDO Back Office DMT team that would create an asset shell as part of the project closure |
| GFS Back Office R2R | Refers to the GFS Back Office R2R Fixed Assets team that would prepare open projects report, perform and post final project settlement |

# GLOSSARY

| **Terms** | **Definition** |
|----|----|
| AR02 | SAP T-code to retrieve Asset Master List |
| AIAB | SAP T-code to check asset number |
| AS01 | SAP T-code to create a new asset number |
| AS02 | SAP T-code to change the asset master data |
| AS03 | SAP T-code to display the asset master data |
| AUC | Assets under Construction |
| AZ | AstraZeneca |
| AUC | Assets under Construction |
| CJ02 | SAP T-code to change WBSE |
| CJ20N | SAP T-code to create a WBSE |
| CJ31 | SAP T-code to display an original budget |
| CJ88 | SAP T-code to transfer WBSE element costs into corresponding AUCs |
| CJ8G | SAP T-code for month end settlement |
| CJI3 | SAP T-code to display WBSE actual costs by line item |
| CN41N | SAP T-code to check budgets |
| DMT | Data Management Team |
| DOA | Delegation of Authority |
| ERP | Enterprise resource planning |
| F.01 | SAP T-code to display Financial Statement |
| FA | Fixed Assets |

| **Terms** | **Definition** |
|----|----|
| FBL3N | SAP T-code to check that settlement is posted into correct AUC |
| FCAS | Financial Controls and Assurance System |
| GFS | Global Finance Services |
| GL | General Ledger |
| KS03 | SAP T-code to check a cost centre |
| N/A | Not applicable |
| NBV | Net Book Value |
| S_ALR_87012277 | SAP T-code to check G/L Account Balances |
| S_ALR_87011964 | SAP T-code to retrieve Asset Balances |
| S_ALR_87013542 | SAP T-code to retrieve open commitments |
| S_ALR_87013558 | SAP T-code to retrieve Capex actual spending, commitments and budget for WBS Projects |
| SAP | Finance enterprise software used by AZ to record transactions for internal and external reporting |
| SCOA | Single Chart of Accounts |
| SOX | Sarbanes–Oxley Act |
| PDF | Portable Document Format |
| T&E | Travel & Expense |
| WBS | Work Breakdown Structure |
| WBSE | Work Breakdown Structure Element |
| YTD | Year to Date |

# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), sets out the mandatory activities to create project account codes. This process relates to the creation of a project account code (WBSE) for each project. A project is a planned piece of work, with a defined scope, timeline and budget (and other characteristics as defined by the AZ Project Management Framework). It covers the following project types:

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 23%" />
<col style="width: 9%" />
<col style="width: 39%" />
<col style="width: 27%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th rowspan="2">Global Project Category</th>
<th rowspan="2">Project Prefix</th>
<th rowspan="2">Project Type</th>
<th rowspan="2">Project Category Description</th>
</tr>
<tr>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Capital Projects</td>
<td>E</td>
<td><p>E1 - Capital Engineering or Equipment (Including R&amp;D Lab Equipment)</p>
<p>E2 - Capital IT</p>
<p>E3 - Revenue Settlement</p></td>
<td>Capital projects, including engineering, construction and capital IT projects</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Research Projects</td>
<td>R</td>
<td>R1 - Drug Discovery</td>
<td>R&amp;D discovery projects</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Development Projects</td>
<td>D</td>
<td><p>D1 - International R&amp;D Clinical Trials</p>
<p>D2 - Local Clinical Trial</p></td>
<td>Drug development projects, including global and local clinical studies</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Business Improvement / IT Revenue Projects</td>
<td>N</td>
<td><p>N1 - Revenue IT Global</p>
<p>N2 - Revenue IT Local</p>
<p>N3 - Business Improvement</p></td>
<td>Business Improvement and IT Revenue Projects</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Restructuring Projects</td>
<td>U</td>
<td>U1 – Restructuring</td>
<td>Restructuring projects, global and local</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

The purpose of using the WBSE for Project accounting is to capture globally relevant project costs consistently and accurately. The benefits of Project accounting are:

- Fast, global visibility for individual projects

- Insight into the total AZ project portfolio by project type and project phase

- Clear segregation of one-off investment cost vs ongoing “run the business” costs

- Rationalised coding for capital projects across CAS (Capital Approval System) and SAPs (avoiding cross-reference in both systems)

- One way of working for delivery centres & global functions

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Embedded Finance, GFS Middle Office and GFS Back Office DMT.

## Process Detail

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<table>
<colgroup>
