<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.1.1</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="create-project-account-code-wbse">Create Project Account Code (WBSE)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td colspan="2">Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td>GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office / Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="6"><p>Once a project is approved, project account code (WBSE) needs to be created in SAP by GFS Back Office DMT. Details of the WBSE are included in the request form raised in an email request by Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office or the Business.</p>
<p>There are two categories of project: Non-statistical projects (type E - Capital Projects) and statistical (Other project types). Non-statistical projects require more information to be provided in the request form.</p>
<p>Please see <strong>Section 7: References</strong>, for guidelines around the Capital Projects WBSE structure.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive WBSE Maintenance Form</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once the GFS Back Office DMT Team receives an email request, the processor will open the email and validate the request details.</p>
<p><img src="media/image2.jpeg" style="width:6.29167in;height:2.05545in" /></p>
<p>The request will contain an Excel form attached with a completed WBSE template, for creation of WBSE, as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image3.png" style="width:4.50775in;height:2.30218in" /></p>
<p>An E Code WBSE Maintenance Form as an example is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:5.17826in;height:6.83126in" /></p>
<p>Validate whether the request received is correct and contains all information required:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Check if the WBSE Maintenance Form is the correct one for the project type (<strong>refer to Section 9: Appendices</strong>)</p></li>
<li><p>Check if the coding mask is used by following the format of the respective project type</p></li>
</ul>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 16%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 26%" />
<col style="width: 46%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Global Project Category</th>
<th>Project Prefix</th>
<th>Project Type</th>
<th><strong>Coding Mask</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Capital Projects</td>
<td>E</td>
<td><p>E1 - Capital Engineering or Equipment (Including R&amp;D Lab Equipment)</p>
<p>E2 - Capital IT</p>
<p>E3 - Revenue Settlement</p></td>
<td><p>E.XXXXXX.XX.XX.XX.XX.XX</p>
<p>This coding mask represents a project hierarchy, where the overall project is broken down into a multiple-level Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). A WBS is a hierarchical structure that breaks down a project into smaller elements, and each element may have another set of elements below it (each project can be broken down up to 5 levels). In this coding mask, Blocks 3 through 6 represent the level (level 2 - level 5) of a WBS element.  There is a pre-defined work break down structure for these E-codes for Blocks 3 and 4. Further levels under Block 4 are not mandatory and there is no pre-defined structure, but these Blocks can be used to define a further break down of the project as required, usually only used for large / major projects</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Block 1: E is the identifier for Capital projects and 6 digits representing the CAS (Capital Approval System) Project Number created at the pre-sanction stage. The sanction code will be recorded in text field of WBS element</p></li>
<li><p>Block 2: ISO country code (e.g. AU)</p></li>
<li><p>Block 3: Two digit code to represent the next level of the project work break down, as per a pre-defined structure</p></li>
<li><p>Block 4: Two digit code to represent a further level of work break down, under block 3, as per a pre-defined structure</p></li>
<li><p>Block 5: Two digit code to represent a further level of work break down, under block 4. This further break down is applicable to large / major projects where more levels of a project hierarchy are required</p></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>Block 6: Two digit code to represent a further level of work break down, under block 5. This further break down is applicable to large / major projects where more levels of a project hierarchy are required</p>
</blockquote></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Research Projects</td>
<td>R</td>
<td>R1 - Drug Discovery</td>
<td><p>R.XXXX.XXXXXX.XXX</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Block 1: Project prefix “R” and 4 digits representing OPAL number</p></li>
<li><p>Block 2: OPAL activity number (six characters)</p></li>
<li><p>Block 3: ISO country code (e.g. AU)</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Development Projects</td>
<td>D</td>
<td><p>D1 - International R&amp;D Clinical Trials</p>
<p>D2 - Local Clinical Trial</p></td>
<td><p>D.XXXX.XXXXXX.XXXXXX</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Block 1: Project prefix “D” and 4 digits representing OPAL number</p></li>
<li><p>Block 2: OPAL activity number (six characters)</p></li>
<li><p>Block 3: ISO country code (e.g. AU)</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Business Improvement/ IT Revenue</td>
<td>N</td>
<td><p>N1 - Revenue IT Global</p>
<p>N2 - Revenue IT Local</p>
<p>N3 - Business Improvement</p></td>
<td><p>N.XXXX.XXXXXX.XXX</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Block 1: Project prefix “N” and 4 digits representing OPAL number</p></li>
<li><p>Block 2: OPAL activity number (six characters)</p></li>
<li><p>Block 3: ISO country code (e.g. AU)</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Restructuring Projects</td>
<td>U</td>
<td>U1 - Restructuring</td>
<td><p>U.XXXX.XXXXXX</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Block 1: Project prefix “U” and 4 digits representing Restructuring project number</p></li>
<li><p>Block 2: ISO country code (e.g. AU)</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Note: the ISO Country Code is omitted for the Hubs (NAM, Sweden, UK) and China excluding commercial markets of these countries.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Check if the maintenance type is NEW</p></li>
<li><p>Check if the fields that are red in colour and marked with * are completed</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The other fields are optional and will only be filled in depending on the requester’s needs.</p>
<p>If the information provided is insufficient query back to the requester via Email (i.e. missing responsible cost centre, missing CAS request number, etc. All fields coloured red are mandatory to complete, otherwise the information is insufficient). A sample email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:2.75in;height:0.14161in" /><img src="media/image6.png" style="width:3.98243in;height:3.84in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Validate whether request received is correct and contains all information required</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>For capital projects there is additional information required to be verified before processing the request.</p>
<p>The “Project Maintenance Form” tab:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>CAS Request number (6 digits) is the same number as in CAS</p></li>
<li><p>Ensure cost centre is the same cost centre as in CAS</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:5.61937in;height:2.4319in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image8.png" style="width:5.60497in;height:2.50775in" /></p>
<p>The “WBSE Creation Form” tab:</p>
<p>Ensure requester has selected with X for WBSE needed</p>
<p>Ensure requester has provided project type, system status, and Project Status (User status).</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.58333in" /></p>
<p>The “Settlement Rule Form” tab:</p>
<p>Ensure requester provides all information in all mandatory fields</p>
<p>If Project Type is ‘E3-Revenue Settlement’, then use ‘CTR’, otherwise ‘FXA’</p>
<p><img src="media/image10.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.62292in" /></p>
<p>For D1 type statistical projects (International R&amp;D Clinical Trials) project creation request should be confirmed with the ACCORD team whether the respective study has been registered in ACCORD system before proceeding with project creation.</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.jpeg" style="width:3.9in;height:7.17115in" /></p>
<p>A sample email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:6.07639in;height:2.07014in" alt="\\astrazeneca.net\global\Data\Users 02\kwmb624\Documents\My Received Files\AED45273.PNG" /></p>
<p>The ACCORD team will check whether the respective study has been registered in ACCORD system and contact the requester if required before sending a conformation email. A sample email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:0.6875in;height:0.10185in" /><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:6.19421in;height:2.85117in" /></p>
<p>If the information provided is insufficient (i.e. missing responsible cost centre, missing CAS request number, etc. All fields colour red are mandatory to complete, otherwise the information is insufficient) query back to the requester via Email by following the instructions provided in the sub-step <strong>A) Receive WBSE Maintenance Form</strong> (E code) and specifying what is required for the requestor to revise the form.</p>
<p>Once the information received is complete proceed to WBSE creation in SAP.</p>
<p>Log into SAP</p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check Responsible and Requesting Cost Centres</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Go to T-code KS03:</p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:1.96875in;height:0.65625in" /></p>
<p>Enter the following information:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Controlling Area – Controlling Area code for the respective country from the WBSE creation request (refer to the <strong>Section 9</strong>. <strong>Appendices</strong>)</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Center – the Responsible and Requesting Cost Centres as per the request</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:5.29167in;height:3.45833in" /></p>
<p>To open a list of controlling areas click on the icon <img src="media/image17.png" style="width:0.16667in;height:0.2in" />. Select a controlling area and click on <img src="media/image18.png" style="width:0.18537in;height:0.16683in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image18.png" style="width:4.17312in;height:2.61825in" /></p>
<p>If the cost centre provided is not active, it will give an error. In that case query back to the requester via Email by following the instructions provided in the sub-step <strong>A) Receive WBSE Maintenance Form</strong> (for E Code)</p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create WBSE within SAP as per Capital Project request received in standard Excel form</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Access SAP transaction CJ20N to create WBSE requested:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:3.125in;height:1.10417in" /></p>
<p>Click Project, then New and Project:</p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:6.26042in;height:4.33333in" /></p>
<p>Press Enter and the below screen will appear on the control tab.</p>
<p>Enter below-listed information as per “Project Maintenance Form” tab in the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form to meet minimum requirements within “Control” Tab in the following screen:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Project def. – “Project Definition” field</p></li>
<li><p>Project description – “Project Description” field</p></li>
<li><p>Project Profile – “Project Category” field</p></li>
<li><p>Object Class – “Object Class” field</p></li>
<li><p>“Statistical” option:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Checked for statistical projects (types D, R, N and U)</p></li>
<li><p>Unchecked for capital projects (type E)</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:0.10377in;height:0.10377in" /><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.05903in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:4.07961in;height:5.3819in" /></p>
<p>Enter below-listed information as per “Project Maintenance Form” tab in the WBSE Maintenance Form to meet minimum requirements within “Basic Data” Tab in SAP in the following screen:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company Code – “Company Code” field</p></li>
<li><p>CO area (Controlling area) – “Controlling Area” field</p></li>
<li><p>Plant – “Plant” field (if applicable)</p></li>
<li><p>Business Area – “Business Area” field (if applicable)</p></li>
<li><p>Profit Center – “Profit Center” field</p></li>
<li><p>Project currency – “This request value” currency from the CAS request</p></li>
<li><p>Start Date – “Start Date” field</p></li>
<li><p>Finish Date – “Finish Date” field</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image23.jpg" style="width:4.33544in;height:2.21787in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:0.23418in" /><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:3.1024in;height:4.09274in" /></p>
<p>Once done, go back to control tab page.</p>
<p>Enter below-listed information as per “Project Maintenance Form” tab in the WBSE Maintenance Form to meet minimum requirements within “Control” Tab in the following screen:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Object Class – “Object Class” field</p></li>
<li><p>“Statistical” option:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Checked for statistical projects (types D, R, N and U)</p></li>
<li><p>Unchecked for capital projects (type E)</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image25.png" style="width:6.27601in;height:2.81364in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:0.22152in" /><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:3.1024in;height:4.09274in" /></p>
<p>Input the Company code and Co area per details provided in Project Maintenance Form</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:5.41667in;height:2.63542in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to “Long text” Tab as per the following screen:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>It will be auto populated once the project description is entered at control tab</p></li>
<li><p>Enter any additional information as per the request form if provided</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.23958in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create WBSE levels within project</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>For capital projects (type E) refer to the “WBSE Creation Form” tab in the E code WBSE Maintenance Form for WBSE level details.</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.58333in" /></p>
<p>To create levels, click “WBS Element Overview” icon, as shown in the screen below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:6.26042in;height:1.79167in" /></p>
<p>Enter information for each level to be created as per the screen below. If the request form has more than one WBSE to be created, enter as many WBSEs, as marked with “X” sign in column A and highlighted in yellow colour from the “Project Type” column and onwards in the “WBSE Creation Form” tab of the WBSE Maintenance Form.</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.73403in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.58333in" /></p>
<p>WBSE Level 1 will always be the same as Project definition.</p>
<p>For each level created in WBSE, enter the following information for any discrepancy:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Project type – “Project Type” field in the “WBSE Creation Form” tab of the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form for respective element</p></li>
<li><p>Check or uncheck boxes <img src="media/image30.jpg" style="width:0.5in;height:0.2in" />:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Planning element (PE) – “PE” should be checked for all levels as Business may want to assign budget at the lowest level. However, in general, plan/budget will be maintained at Project level and not at the lowest level of WBSE</p></li>
<li><p>Account Assignment Element (Acct) – “Acct” should be checked at the lowest available WBSE level only. This implies that expenses can be booked only against the lowest level</p></li>
<li><p>Billing (Bill) – “Bill” in WBSE master data to be checked in case we want to use billing directly at the project level (usually not be checked)</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>“Bill” helps to create invoices using WBSE elements, in case it is marked in master data of WBSE</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="media/image30.jpg" style="width:6.25568in;height:3.40069in" /></p>
<p>To change a user status, click on “Edit”, then “Status” and “System/user status”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image31.png" style="width:4in;height:2.57181in" /></p>
<p>Select the user status as per the request form and then click on the icon <img src="media/image32.png" style="width:0.22014in;height:0.23532in" /> to go back to the main screen. For example, E_ID (Execute):</p>
<p><img src="media/image32.png" style="width:5.51515in;height:3.91707in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to “Responsibilities” Tab to check the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Responsible Cost Center – “Responsible Cost Centre” as per the E code WBSE Maintenance Form. For capital projects verify against the “Settlement Rule Form” tab and update different cost centres for various levels of WBSE if required</p></li>
<li><p>Requesting Cost Center – “Requesting Cost Centre” as per the E code WBSE Maintenance Form. For capital projects verify against the “Settlement Rule Form” tab and update different cost centres for various levels of WBSE if required</p></li>
<li><p>Other fields (CA – Controlling Area, Req.co.code – Requesting Company Code) will be auto populated based on the cost centre</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image33.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.09091in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:3.1024in;height:4.09274in" /></p>
<p>For statistical WBSE only one WBSE level should be created. Follow the instructions above and complete all fields according to the WBSE Maintenance Form.</p>
<p><img src="media/image34.jpeg" style="width:4in;height:7.35502in" /></p>
<p>For Research Projects (type D) the “Product” field is mandatory. In case no Enigma Activity provided in the request form use default Enigma activity as per table below:</p>
<table style="width:100%;">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 17%" />
<col style="width: 19%" />
<col style="width: 44%" />
<col style="width: 19%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Global Project Category</th>
<th>Project Prefix</th>
<th>Project Type</th>
<th>Default Enigma Activity</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Research Projects</td>
<td>R</td>
<td>R1 – Drug Discovery Project</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Development Projects</td>
<td>D</td>
<td><p>D1 - International R&amp;D Clinical Trials</p>
<p>D2 – Local Clinical Trial</p></td>
<td><p>Z420</p>
<p>Z415</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>IT Revenue / Business Improvement Projects</td>
<td>N</td>
<td><p>N1 – Revenue IT Project Global</p>
<p>N2 – Revenue IT Projects Local</p>
<p>N3 – Business Improvement Project</p></td>
<td><p>Z355</p>
<p>Z355</p>
<p>Z355</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Restructuring Projects</td>
<td>U</td>
<td>U1 – Restructuring Project</td>
<td>Z375</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>To enter the Product Brand and Enigma Activity code, select the WBSE and proceed to the “AZ Cust Flds” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image35.jpg" style="width:5in;height:3.12667in" /></p>
<ol start="6" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Save the project</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all required levels and information have been keyed in, save the project.</p>
<p><img src="media/image36.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:1.90694in" /></p>
<p>Once the project is saved, System Status for all elements within a project including for Project will be indicated as “CRTD” (Created) and User Status will be indicated as “PJ_I” (Pre-justify).</p>
<p>Once completed</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For non-capital projects (types R, D, N and U) proceed to the <strong>sub-step: 8.4.2.1.2 C)</strong> <strong>Release the project for cost posting</strong></p></li>
<li><p>For capital projects (type E) proceed to the <strong>sub-step</strong>: <strong>8.4.2.1.1 G) Create AUC</strong></p></li>
</ul>
<ol start="7" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create AUC</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Please note Create AUC is not applicable for NAM and Sweden, as the AUC Creation is triggered upon WBSE posting.</p>
<p>Also, for LATAM it is automatically created when GFS Back Office R2R runs T-code CJ88 during month end.</p>
<p>Once Project and WBSE levels are created, it is required to create AUC in order to specify settlement rules for each WBSE.</p>
<p><img src="media/image10.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.62292in" /></p>
<p>To create AUC, go to T-code AS01:</p>
<p><img src="media/image37.png" style="width:1.92708in;height:0.8125in" /></p>
<p>Enter the information provided in the E code WBSE Maintenance Form and press enter:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset Class – “Asset Class” field in the “Settlement Rule” tab</p></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><p>Company Code – “Company Code” field in the “Project Creation Webform” tab</p></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><p>Number of similar assets – “1” (For 1 asset creation)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image38.jpg" style="width:6.11401in;height:3.76042in" /></p>
<p>Key in the asset description in “General” tab, ensure there are ticks in “Manage historically” and “Include asset in inventory list” fields:</p>
<p>Please note that the fields available in each respective tab mentioned below may differ in respective SAP instances. Ensure the mandatary fields are filled accordingly.</p>
<p><img src="media/image39.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:4.14583in" /></p>
<p>“Acct Determination” will appear automatically depending on AUC Class.</p>
<p>Key in “Cost Center” in “Time-dependent” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.png" style="width:6.22917in;height:4.59375in" /></p>
<p>Fields in rest of the tabs are optional, populate all the applicable fields if there is any information provided in the request form.</p>
<p>Once done click save icon <img src="media/image41.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.27083in" /> (Ctrl + S) and new AUC number will be created.</p>
<p><img src="media/image42.png" style="width:2.22549in;height:0.25833in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to the “Settlement Rule Form” in the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form and enter the created AUC number in the “Receiver Number (Asset Under Construction Number)” column.</p>
<p><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.58264in" /></p>
<p>Save the updated E code WBSE Maintenance Form to the shared folder by clicking “Save As”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>The shared folder as per following example: .. \YYYY\Operation\Country code\1. Maintain WBSE Master data\MM. MMMM\New (e.g.: ..\2017\Operation\MY\1. Maintain WBSE Master data\08. August\New)</p></li>
<li><p>The file name as per the following mask: WBSE number – WBS (project prefix) code New (e.g.: E.008837 – WBS E code New)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image44.jpg" style="width:6.26088in;height:3.90972in" /></p>
<ol start="8" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create settlement rule</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Please note: Create settlement rule is not applicable for NAM and Sweden.</p>
<p>Log into SAP and T-code CJ20N and hit enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:3.125in;height:1.10417in" /></p>
<p>Click Project, then Open or click open icon <img src="media/image45.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.22917in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:4.79167in;height:2.39583in" /></p>
<p>Enter project definition and click enter <img src="media/image47.png" style="width:0.21875in;height:0.21875in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:3.85417in;height:1.86458in" /></p>
<p>Once project appears, expand all levels by clicking expand icon <img src="media/image49.png" style="width:0.33333in;height:0.30208in" /> located next to WBSE.</p>
<p>Click “WBS Element Overview” icon <img src="media/image50.png" style="width:0.27659in;height:0.2274in" /> and select WBSE(s) for which settlement rules need to be defined.</p>
<p><img src="media/image51.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.97014in" /></p>
<p>Settlement rules should be defined from level 3 and below. Once WBSE(s) selected click on the settlement rule icon.</p>
<p><img src="media/image52.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.92708in" /></p>
<p>Define settlement rules as per request form.</p>
<p><img src="media/image53.png" style="width:6.56477in;height:1.70059in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.58264in" /></p>
<p>Key elements to be entered in Settlement Rules:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Cat” Tab: Select FXA or CTR for AUC / Asset from the drop-down list</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image54.jpeg" style="width:1.11458in;height:0.40825in" /></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Settlement receiver: Enter AUC number created in the <strong>sub-step: 8.4.2.1.1 G) Create AUC</strong></p></li>
<li><p>%: enter the percentage of allocation to each receiver</p></li>
<li><p>Settlement type: select “FUL: Full Settlement”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:1.52083in;height:0.39167in" /></p>
<p>Once done for one WBSE, select “Next” icon <img src="media/image56.png" style="width:0.19792in;height:0.22917in" /> to enter settlement rules for all other WBSEs (level 3 and below). After settlement rules are entered for the last WBSE click on “Next” icon <img src="media/image56.png" style="width:0.19792in;height:0.22917in" /> to return to the main screen.</p>
<p><img src="media/image57.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.17917in" /></p>
<p>Click “Save” icon <img src="media/image58.png" style="width:0.32292in;height:0.25in" />to save the Settlement rules defined in the project.</p>
<p><img src="media/image59.png" style="width:2.36458in;height:0.29167in" /></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="5">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>8.4.2.1.2</td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="update-new-project-with-budget">Update new project with budget</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td colspan="2">Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td>GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="6"><p>Once the WBSE is created update the WBSE master data with the approved budget in SAP.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Open the project to enter budget</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Log on T-code CJ30 to enter budget for a capital project (type E).</p>
<p><img src="media/image60.png" style="width:1.89583in;height:0.78125in" /></p>
<p>Enter the created Project code in “Project Definition” field and hit enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image61.png" style="width:3.97917in;height:2.375in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Enter budget amount</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Key in the budget amount in the “Budget” column according to the amount specified in the CAS screenshot provided by the requestor as supporting information in the request form:</p>
<p><img src="media/image62.png" style="width:5.72483in;height:2.64643in" /></p>
<p>Enter the budget at the first level (Total project level), unless it is specified in the request form to be entered at other levels.</p>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:3.34634in;height:1.57857in" /></p>
<p>Click on save <img src="media/image58.png" style="width:0.32292in;height:0.25in" /> once the amount is entered.</p>
<p><img src="media/image64.png" style="width:2.14583in;height:0.33333in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Release the project for cost posting</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>WBSE must be reflected as “REL” (released) before Business can start using the WBSE.</p>
<p>Access SAP transaction CJ20N to change the project status:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:2.62614in;height:0.9279in" /></p>
<p>Click Project, then Open or click “Open” icon <img src="media/image45.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.22917in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:4.10091in;height:2.05045in" /></p>
<p>Enter the created project number in the “Project Definition” field and click <img src="media/image47.png" style="width:0.21875in;height:0.21875in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:3.85417in;height:1.86458in" /></p>
<p>Select the first level WBSE to change status to “REL”. Click on “Edit”, then “Status” and “Release”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image65.jpeg" style="width:6.25642in;height:2.23958in" /></p>
<p>The status at the highlighted WBSE level changed to “REL” in the screen below. Click “Save” icon <img src="media/image66.png" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image67.png" style="width:6.39583in;height:2.32153in" /></p>
<p>Once saved, the following message will appear to confirm the status change</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:2.38542in;height:0.33333in" /></p>
<p>As per the example above, once the first level WBSE is selected, all WBSE in this project code will be auto populated with the status “REL”.</p>
<p>However, if different status is required for a particular WBSE within the project code as stated in the request form, change that WBSE status accordingly by following the step above.</p>
<p>Note: Any change in the system status for a WBS element, will also be applicable to the WBS elements under it. Hence, changing the system status of a WBS element to “REL”, will also release any WBS elements under it.</p>
<p><img src="media/image69.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.11389in" /></p>
<p>If a status of any WBSE other than the first level WBSE has been changed from “REL” to any other status, the first level WBSE status will change automatically from “REL” to “PREL” (Partial Released) as in the screenshot below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image70.jpg" style="width:6.375in;height:2.075in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Notify the requester with the created project number</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once system status is set as released, send an email to the requester confirming the project account code creation with the newly created WBSE number and AUC number provided. A sample email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image71.png" style="width:4.02014in;height:3.64028in" /></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="5">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>8.4.2.1.3</td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="review-project-account-code-and-budget-maintained-in-sap">Review project account code and budget maintained in SAP</h3></td>
</tr>

## Roles and Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

| Role / Team Name | Description |
| Business | Refers to the respective Project Requesters (e.g. Project Managers) that would be notified of project code creation |
| Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office | Refers to Embedded Finance and GFS Middle Office that would review project account code creation in SAP |
| GFS Back Office DMT | Refers to GFS Back Office DMT that would create project account code in SAP |

**Supplementary request**

If there is a need to revise the project budget and a supplementary CAS request is approved Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will complete the E code WBSE Maintenance Form by indicating the revised budget amount in the “Reason for request” field. Then Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will send the “Change” request to GFS Back Office DMT via Email to update the project budget in SAP. GFS Back Office DMT updates the budget in SAP by following **the step 4.7.2: 8.4.2.1.2 Update new project with budget**.

#  PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), sets out the mandatory activities for the process relating to the creation of a fixed asset code for fixed asset addition(s) either through the direct purchase of an asset(s) or through capitalisation of capital projects. Due to the commercial information model’s validation rules, there is a system limitation in using Project Systems and hence they are exempt from the Global Capital standard

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Business, Embedded Finance, GFS Middle Office and GFS Back Office.

# SCOPE

The table below contains a summary of the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Business Process | Description |
| Commercial | This process is applicable to all commercial entities in APAC, MEA and India, LATAM and Europe |

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.11.3</strong></td>
<td colspan="6"><h3 id="create-fixed-asset-code">Create fixed asset code </h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Responsible</td>
<td colspan="2">Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="7"><p>GFS Back Office DMT accesses the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template from the email received.</p>
<p>Please ensure that you perform control CPX005BC as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<p>The template opens as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.59931in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:6.74516in;height:0.63303in" /></p>
<p>In case of any missing information / additional information required, contact the requester for clarification by replying to the above email.</p>
<p><img src="media/image6.png" style="width:5.00673in;height:5.06906in" /></p>
<p>If there is no missing information, proceed to create the asset in SAP. GFS Back Office DMT will create the fixed asset code in SAP with inputs from the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Validate new asset creation request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Verify that all mandatory fields are updated in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab in the Asset Master Data Maintenance template. For a request to create an asset, these fields will be marked with a “*” and coloured in red and blue. Instructions on mandatory fields are available in the “Instructions” tab of the template.</p>
<p>Additionally:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Check that the maintenance type is NEW</p></li>
<li><p>Check that the company code selected matches with the company code provided in the template</p></li>
<li><p>Check Workitem (especially for those countries which have more than one-unit code)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.59931in" /></p>
<p>The screen below shows the further information which is to be completed as a part of the above template:</p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:6.74516in;height:0.63303in" /></p>
<p>Log into the SAP system by following the steps below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Enter T-code KS03 in SAP to check whether cost centre is active:</p>
<p><img src="media/image8.png" style="width:1.96875in;height:0.65625in" /></p>
<p>Enter the following information:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Controlling Area – Controlling Area code for the respective country from the asset creation request (refer to <strong>Section 9 Appendices</strong>)</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Center – the Responsible and Requesting Cost Centres as per the request</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:5.66667in;height:3.375in" /></p>
<p>To open a list of controlling areas click on the icon<img src="media/image10.png" style="width:0.16667in;height:0.2in" /> as shown in the above screenshot.</p>
<p>Select a Controlling Area and click on <img src="media/image11.png" style="width:0.18537in;height:0.16683in" /> to proceed:</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:4.17312in;height:2.61825in" /></p>
<p>To ensure the Cost Center is active, proceed to the “Control” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:5.88951in;height:3.8in" /></p>
<p>If the Cost Centre provided is not active, query back to the requester via email by following the instructions provided in the step: A) <strong>Validate new asset creation request.</strong></p>
<p>In case a new single asset needs to be created, <strong>proceed to 4.7.3: 8.3.3.11.3 B) Create new single asset</strong>.</p>
<p>In case new mass assets need to be created, <strong>proceed to step 4.7.3:8.3.3.11.3 C) Create new mass assets</strong>.</p>
<p>In case new sub-assets need to be created, <strong>proceed to step 4.7.3: 8.3.3.11.3 D) Create asset for sub-assets</strong>.</p>
<p><strong>Note:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p>A new single asset needs to be created when the information in the template contains the details of one particular asset</p></li>
<li><p>New mass assets need to be created if the information in the template pertains to more than one asset containing different information</p></li>
<li><p>New sub-assets need to be created if the template contains asset sub-number description. Basically, a sub-asset needs to be created to differentiate additional acquisitions to an existing asset created earlier</p></li>
</ul>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create new single asset</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>B.1) Open Template</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Open the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template from the email to get the information required for an asset creation.</p>
<p>The Asset Master Data Maintenance Template will open with below details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.56111in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>B.2) Create asset code in SAP</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>To create an asset master record, enter T-code AS01 and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.66667in" /></p>
<p>When creating the asset master record, there are two options:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Use an existing asset with the same asset class as a reference for creating the new asset master record.</p></li>
<li><p>Choose the asset class as provided in the template, this will update fields with default values in SAP. Note: the asset class supplies the most important control parameters in the asset master record.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The creation asset window will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image16.jpg" style="width:6.27036in;height:5.64873in" /></p>
<p>Fill out the company code as per the template and the number of similar assets, the value is”1” by default for a new single asset creation and hit enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:6in;height:3.15625in" /></p>
<p>Create asset, fill in the details as per the template provided:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.10417in;height:4.625in" /></p>
<p>If Asset description is too long, follow the steps mentioned below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:6.13542in;height:5.13542in" /></p>
<p>Insert the full description and click<img src="media/image22.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.27083in" />. An example is shown in the screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:6.26042in;height:3.17708in" /></p>
<p>After clicking on<img src="media/image22.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.27083in" /> , click “Yes” before exiting the text box.</p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:3.5in;height:1.34375in" /></p>
<p>Check if the text was saved and click <img src="media/image25.png" style="width:0.21458in;height:0.21359in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:6.07292in;height:5.98958in" /></p>
<p>Enter the asset quantity as per as per the template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:6.125in;height:4.57292in" /></p>
<p>Continue to “Time-dependent” tab, update the details as per template:</p>
<p><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:6.19792in;height:3.73958in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to “Allocations” tab in SAP to insert Evaluation group 1-5 as per the template. These fields are updated basis the below table varying as per region:</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:0.85347in" /></p>
<p>Please note these fields are not mandatory and thus, not updated in all the cases.</p>
<p>As a general practice, MEA and India Commercial do not fill in these fields.</p>
<p>The SAP screenshot appears as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image30.png" style="width:6.05045in;height:3.87639in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to “Origin” tab in SAP to insert vendor information as per the template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image31.png" style="width:6.26602in;height:3.51969in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Deprec.Areas” tab. Depreciation areas show the depreciation information of a fixed asset for accounting and tax purposes. It is mandatory to update this tab. Complete the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>”Dkey”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Depreciation Key for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Depreciation Key for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>“UseLife”: Useful life is updated only on user request, if asset life is not as per the guidelines for the asset class as defaulted in SAP</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Useful Life for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Useful Life for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>“ODep Start” (Ordinary Depreciation Start):</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Depreciation Start Date for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab. If not provided leave the field blank, the system will change it automatically to the date of the first acquisition posting</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Depreciation Start Date for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab. If not provided leave the field blank, the system will change it automatically to the date of the first acquisition posting once it happened</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image32.png" style="width:6.25923in;height:3.1183in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:6.74516in;height:0.63303in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>B.3) Specific fields for special markets</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>The following information is only updated in Russia Markets.</p>
<p>Update the details of Vendor and tick the box highlighted below if asset being created is new.</p>
<p><img src="media/image33.png" style="width:5.3314in;height:2.53979in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image34.png" style="width:4.17681in;height:1.42708in" /></p>
<p>Input the OKOF code in “Net worth tax” tab, if provided in the “New OKOF code” column in the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image35.png" style="width:5.49221in;height:3.28692in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image36.png" style="width:4.02083in;height:1.92708in" /></p>
<p>Input Territorial code from template as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image37.png" style="width:5.59375in;height:3.23958in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image36.png" style="width:4.02083in;height:1.92708in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Note :</u></strong> Similarly, “Classification Key” and “Property Indicator” columns are updated only for JP10 market in “Net Worth Tax” tab, if provided in Assets Master Data Maintenance Template.</p>
<p><strong>B.4) <u>Generate Asset in system</u></strong></p>
<p>After filling out all the information, click save button <img src="media/image38.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.26042in" /> and the asset number will be generated by the system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image39.png" style="width:6in;height:3.66667in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create new mass assets</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>When request is for more than one asset with different information e.g. description or asset class, the requester will complete an Asset Master Data Maintenance Template for mass asset creation.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>C.1) Open Template</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Open the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template from the email received to get information required for an asset creation.</p>
<p>A request for mass asset creation will be as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.88889in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong><u>C.2) Create asset code in SAP</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>To create an asset master record, enter T-code: AS01 and hit enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image41.png" style="width:2.05208in;height:0.6875in" /></p>
<p>Fill out the company code and fill in the “Number of similar assets” field as per the template and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image42.png" style="width:6.06736in;height:2.72708in" /></p>
<p>Create the first asset as per the template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:6.10417in;height:3.92708in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Time-dependent” tab. Update the fields as per the template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image44.png" style="width:6.15625in;height:3.8125in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Deprec.Areas” tab. Depreciation areas show the depreciation information of a fixed asset for accounting and tax purposes. It is mandatory to update this tab. Complete the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“DKey”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Depreciation Key for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Depreciation Key for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>“UseLife”: Useful life is updated only on user request, if asset life is not as per the guidelines for the asset class as defaulted in SAP</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Useful Life for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Useful Life for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>“ODep Start” (Ordinary Depreciation Start):</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Depreciation Start Date for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab.</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>If not provided leave the field blank, the system will change it automatically to the date of the first acquisition posting once it happens</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Depreciation Start Date for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab. If not provided leave the field blank, the system will change it automatically to the date of the first acquisition posting once it happened</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image45.png" style="width:6.26042in;height:3.19792in" /></p>
<p>After filling in all the information, click save <img src="media/image38.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.26042in" /> and the below dialogue box will appear. Click on Create or Maintain shown in the screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:6.04167in;height:3.58333in" /></p>
<p>To update fields that are different in Assets within mass assets creation, complete a new line for the different asset. Fields to update include:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Description (mandatory field)</p></li>
<li><p>Inventory number</p></li>
<li><p>Business Area</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Center (mandatory field)</p></li>
<li><p>Evaluation group from 1 to 5</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:6.27083in;height:2.86458in" /></p>
<p>After clicking on <img src="media/image47.png" style="width:0.26042in;height:0.30208in" />,SAP will pop up with the following message. Now Click on “Create”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image49.png" style="width:6.08333in;height:4in" /></p>
<p>The system will automatically generate Asset numbers.</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:0.27429in" /><img src="media/image51.png" style="width:4.62265in;height:2.90315in" /></p>
<p>For those fields that differ between the assets within the mass creation template and were not covered in the previous steps, kindly go to T-code: AS02 to manually change the asset information.</p>
<p><img src="media/image52.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.67708in" /></p>
<p>Change asset master record, if required as per the request.</p>
<p><img src="media/image53.png" style="width:4.7275in;height:4.74438in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create asset for sub-assets</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Asset sub-numbers are used to:</p>
<ul>
<li><p> Differentiate additional acquisitions to an existing asset created earlier</p></li>
<li><p>Represent complex fixed assets with their component parts</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Open the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template from email to get information required for an asset creation. It will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image54.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.53569in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:0.90556in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image56.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:0.89097in" /></p>
<p>When the asset creation request is to create a sub number, please make sure the main asset has been created already.</p>
<p>To create an asset master record, enter T-code AS01 and hit enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.66667in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the company code as per the template and the number of similar assets (the value is “1” by default for a new single sub-asset creation, and as per the template for a new mass sub-asset creation) and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:0.27428in" /><img src="media/image57.png" style="width:5.31646in;height:2.5574in" /></p>
<p>Create the Asset as per details in the template:</p>
<p><img src="media/image58.png" style="width:6.26042in;height:4.10417in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Time-dependent” tab. Update the details as per template:</p>
<p><img src="media/image59.png" style="width:6.17708in;height:3.71875in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to the “Origin” tab<strong>.</strong> Create as per template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image60.png" style="width:6.18in;height:4.16505in" /></p>
<p>Continue to the “Deprec.Areas” tab. Depreciation areas show the depreciation of a fixed asset for the accounting and tax purposes. It is mandatory to update this tab. Complete the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“DKey”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Depreciation Key for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Depreciation Key for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>“UseLife”: Useful life is updated only on user request, if asset life is not as per the guidelines for the asset class as defaulted in SAP</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Useful Life for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Useful Life for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>“ODep Start” (Ordinary Depreciation Start):</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For “Book deprec.” – “Depreciation Start Date for Book” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab. If not provided leave the field blank, the system will change it automatically to the date of the first acquisition posting once it happened</p></li>
<li><p>For “Tax bal.sht.” – “Depreciation Start Date for Tax” in the “Asset Master Data Maint Tmplte” tab. If not provided leave the field blank, the system will change it automatically to the date of the first acquisition posting once it happens</p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image61.png" style="width:6.28125in;height:3.07292in" /></p>
<p>After filling out all the information, click <img src="media/image38.png" style="width:0.29167in;height:0.26042in" /> and an asset number will be automatically generated by the system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:0.3254in;height:0.11389in" /><img src="media/image62.png" style="width:6.04167in;height:4.15625in" /></p>
<p>Once the asset creation is complete, continue to create the sub-number<strong>.</strong></p>
<p><img src="media/image54.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.54438in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:0.72431in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image64.png" style="width:6.56404in;height:0.85861in" /></p>
<p>To create Asset sub-number, click on Asset below and follow the steps as per below screenshot:</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:0.32738in;height:0.11458in" /><img src="media/image65.png" style="width:5.53423in;height:4.27478in" /></p>
<p>Insert the asset number (this is the asset number just created), company code and number of similar sub numbers. Press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:0.32708in;height:0.13913in" /><img src="media/image66.png" style="width:3.97917in;height:2.51042in" /></p>
<p>Make sure there is a sub number next to the main asset number, see screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image67.png" style="width:6.22917in;height:4.48958in" /></p>
<p>Change the description as per the template and make sure all tabs are exactly the same as the main asset number, click<img src="media/image68.png" style="width:0.30208in;height:0.28125in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image69.png" style="width:6.1875in;height:4.42708in" /></p>
<p>Once we click on <img src="media/image68.png" style="width:0.30208in;height:0.28125in" />, the asset number with the sub number will be generated by the system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:0.32708in;height:0.11389in" /><img src="media/image70.png" style="width:3.96875in;height:2.73958in" /></p></td>
</tr>

<td colspan="6"><h3 id="send-notification-of-fixed-asset-code-creation-completion">Send notification of fixed asset code creation completion</h3></td>

<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>

<td colspan="7"><p>Business receives notification that the fixed asset number has been created and uses it as reference for the purchase requisition.</p>
<p>Send a notification by replying to the email received for new Asset creation. A sample email has been given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image71.png" style="width:5.20788in;height:4.67826in" /></p>
<p>Business receives notification that the fixed asset number has been created and uses it as reference for the Asset.</p></td>

</tr>

<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.11.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="review-unposted-assets-quarterly">Review unposted assets quarterly</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>On a quarterly basis, GFS Back Office R2R reviews the unposted Asset List report extracted from SAP which consists of a list of assets created in SAP but do not have any value posted to them yet.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Extract Asset Listing Report</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Input SAP T-code S_ALR_87012056 and press Enter to extract the asset listing.</p>
<p><img src="media/image72.png" style="width:5.13542in;height:1.59656in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the below fields as given below and click on execute icon <img src="media/image73.png" style="width:0.2087in;height:0.1913in" />to proceed:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company Code: Company for which asset listing is being extracted</p></li>
<li><p>Sort Variant: “0007”</p></li>
<li><p>Display variant: “/ST-UNPOSTED”</p></li>
<li><p>Date Created: The beginning date should be left blank and input last day of the month on which report is required (i.e. 31.12.2019 as of Dec 2019 report) in the field after “to”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image74.png" style="width:4.7491in;height:4.09514in" /></p>
<p>The unposted asset listing report appears as given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image75.png" style="width:6.78356in;height:4.49in" /></p>
<p>Click on List – Export – Local File to extract the asset listing report.</p>
<p><img src="media/image76.png" style="width:5.18261in;height:1.27095in" /></p>
<p>Select “Text with Tabs’ and click on green tick <img src="media/image77.png" style="width:0.28125in;height:0.22917in" /> to proceed in pop-up screen:</p>
<p><img src="media/image78.png" style="width:1.87881in;height:2.04218in" /></p>
<p>Change the destination of the file by clicking on <img src="media/image79.png" style="width:0.17432in;height:0.17432in" /> and another pop-up screen appears as shown below. Enter the file name, select “xls” as file type and select the designated folder. Click on Save to save the file.</p>
<p><img src="media/image80.png" style="width:6.59652in;height:3.17in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Prepare working for Unposted Asset List</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The saved file will appear as below in the file layout:</p>
<p><img src="media/image81.png" style="width:6.32044in;height:3.74003in" /></p>
<p>To format the data, select Column D and click on Data &gt; Text to Columns to format Col D as Text in order for asset Numbers to be reflected completely.</p>
<p><img src="media/image82.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:3.75308in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Delimited” and “Next” in the pop-up screen.</p>
<p><img src="media/image83.png" style="width:3.97454in;height:3.24548in" /></p>
<p>Select “Tab” in the next screen and click on “Next” to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image84.png" style="width:4.54843in;height:3.72307in" /></p>
<p>Select “Text” and click on “Finish” to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image85.png" style="width:4.2195in;height:3.42368in" /></p>
<p>The asset numbers are now reflected completely in the report as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image86.png" style="width:6.35536in;height:3.84909in" /></p>
<p>To format the report, select Row 1 to 7, 9 and delete them.</p>
<p><img src="media/image87.png" style="width:6.29825in;height:3.19182in" /></p>
<p>Select Column A, E, F and J and delete these, in order to fine tune the report.</p>
<p><img src="media/image88.png" style="width:5.99713in;height:3.62361in" /></p>
<p>Select the table and click on Data &gt; Filter to apply filter to the table.</p>
<p><img src="media/image89.png" style="width:5.52213in;height:3.34726in" /></p>
<p>Filter column C to select “Asset” and “(Blanks)” and delete the rows containing these values.</p>
<p><img src="media/image90.png" style="width:6.14398in;height:3.71858in" /></p>
<p>The report now appears as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image91.png" style="width:6.3913in;height:3.63478in" /></p>
<p>Select Column F and replace “.” to “/” to change the date format. It will aid in using the formula to calculate the asset’s aging. Press “Ctrl+H” to open the pop-up box and enter details as shown below. Click on “Replace All” to change the date format.</p>
<p><img src="media/image92.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:3.17945in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Extract PO report</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Input T-code SQ01 in SAP and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image93.png" style="width:3.81754in;height:1.41402in" /></p>
<p>Select “ZPOASSET_SAP” in the pop-up screen and click on execute icon <img src="media/image94.png" style="width:0.24348in;height:0.2in" /> to proceed:</p>
<p><img src="media/image95.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:4.76177in" /></p>
<p>The below screen pops up. Fill in the fields as given below:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Main Asset Number: Copy all the asset numbers from the Unposted Asset List report and paste in the below screen by clicking on <img src="media/image96.png" style="width:0.42708in;height:0.22917in" />, pasting them in the pop-up screen and Press F8.</p></li>
<li><p>Company Code: Input the company code for which report is being extracted</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click on execute icon to proceed:</p>
<p><img src="media/image97.png" style="width:6.44792in;height:2.48958in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image98.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:3.31646in" /></p>
<p>The report will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image99.png" style="width:6.00783in;height:3.85089in" /></p>
<p>Extract the report to excel by clicking on export icon <img src="media/image100.png" style="width:0.42708in;height:0.20833in" />. Select spreadsheet in the drop-down s shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image101.png" style="width:6.14517in;height:2.5913in" /></p>
<p>Copy the report into a new tab in the Unposted Asset List report and rename the tab to “PO Details – SQ01”. Swap column F with column G in order to perform VLOOKUP using the asset number.</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:4.07083in" /></p>
<p>Column F is “Asset” and Column G is “Requisnr” in the report.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:4.05in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Customise Unposted Asset Report</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Insert a grey header for the data as shown below. Insert the subject at the left corner with reporting date in the right corner. The date will be used as a base for the formulas to be applied in the following steps:</p>
<p><img src="media/image104.png" style="width:5.25179in;height:2.91922in" /></p>
<p>Add 9 columns Column G to Column O to be highlighted in blue, orange and green as follows:</p>
<ol type="a">
<li><p>Headers in orange Column I to L contain formulas for data to be pulled from SAP report. Refer to <strong>Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.11.6 C)</strong> <strong><u>Steps to extract PO details</u></strong>.</p></li>
<li></li>
<li><p><u>Note:</u> Not all assets will appear in SQVI list, only asset numbers used in PO creation will appear in the list.</p></li>
<li></li>
<li><p>Column N and O will need Business to input upon their review. Headers in green Column M to O include suggested action and require confirmation from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office on the actions along with comments (if any).</p></li>
<li><p>Column I until L will have VLOOKUP formulas with PO details report extracted with SAP T-code SQ01.</p></li>
<li><p>Update the columns as mentioned below:</p></li>
<li></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><p><strong>Column G :</strong> Insert header “No. of days”. Use formula to calculate the number of days between the creation date and the last day of previous month, use formula “=DAYS360($F5,$F$1)”</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Column H</strong> : Insert header “Status”. Use formula to categorise the unposted asset numbers into different categories based on the number of days calculated in column G into buckets- “0 – 3months”, “3 months to 1 year” and “More than 1 year”, use formula “=IF(G5&lt;90,"0 to 3 months",IF(G5&lt;365,"3 months to 1 year","More than 1 year"))”</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Column I</strong> : Insert header “PO No. Tagged”. Use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:I,4,0),"None")”</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Column J</strong> : Insert header “PO Creation Date”. Use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:L,7,0),"None")”</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Column K</strong> : Insert header “PO Created By” and use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:K,6,0),"None")”</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Column L</strong> : Insert header “PO Requestor” and use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:G,2,0),"None")”</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Column M</strong> : “Suggested Actions by R2R”. There are 4 types of recommended actions to be taken by Business, suggested by GFS Back Office R2R:</p></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><p><u>Recommend to delete:</u> For assets more than 1 year old without PO tagged</p></li>
<li><p><u>Investigation needed</u>: For assets more than 1 year old with PO tagged would require Business to investigate whether the PO is still valid. If PO is no longer valid, then it needs to be closed before asset deletion</p></li>
<li><p><u>Review required by LC</u>: For those assets aged 3 months to 1 year</p></li>
<li><p><u>No actions required</u>: For those assets created not more than 3 months, no action needed from local country</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Use Formula “=IF(H5="","",IF(AND(H5="More than 1 year",I5="None"),"Recommend to delete",IF(AND(H5="More than 1 year",I5&lt;&gt;""),"Investigation needed",IF(H5="3 months to 1 year","Review required by LC","No actions required"))))”</p>
<ul>
<li><p><strong>Column N</strong> : “Confirmed Actions by LC”</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Column O</strong> : Use header “Comments (if any)”.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The updated report will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:6.72872in;height:3.00567in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create Graph with Pivot</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Create a new tab and name it “Summary Analysis” for better presentation.</p>
<p><img src="media/image106.png" style="width:5.19792in;height:0.33333in" /></p>
<p>Go to View &gt; untick Gridlines in order to have better presentation.</p>
<p><img src="media/image107.png" style="width:5.4848in;height:1.64068in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Pivot” to summarise the data in tab “MY10 Unposted Asset List – Dec”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image108.png" style="width:5.80926in;height:2.06127in" /></p>
<p>Select the pivot table range from Row 4 onwards from tab “MY10 Unposted Asset List – Dec” and Click “Ok” to create a pivot table.</p>
<p><img src="media/image109.png" style="width:6.71288in;height:3.34426in" /></p>
<p>Arrange the table by Status and count of asset as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image110.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:3.26084in" /></p>
<p>Select the table B2: C6 create a diagram to indicate the summary by clicking on Insert&gt;Chart&gt; Clustered Column.</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:6.83958in;height:2.73333in" /></p>
<p>The chart will be displayed as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image112.png" style="width:5.80948in;height:3.29318in" /></p>
<p>Update the chart subject title to “Summary Analysis of CoCd Unposted Assets” and delete “Total” from the side of graph as it is not needed. Also, change the colours of the bar for:</p>
<p>“0 to 3 months” to green, “3 months to 1 year” to yellow and “More than 1 year” to red.</p>
<p><img src="media/image113.png" style="width:5.70148in;height:3.33665in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to share the file with Business when following-up on unposted assets.</p></td>

<td colspan="5"><p>Business decides and confirms back to GFS Back Office R2R whether the asset number is still required for the list of unposted assets shared with them.</p>

<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once Business is sure that asset number is no longer required on unposted assets, they send a request to GFS Back Office DMT for Asset Master Data Maintenance requesting deactivation of the asset from the Asset Register.</p>
<p>Update the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template_Global as given below:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Maintenance Types: “DELETE”</p></li>
<li><p>Country: Select the country which the asset to be blocked belongs to, from the unposted asset list</p></li>
<li><p>Company Code: Input the company code which asset belongs to</p></li>
<li><p>Region: Select region</p></li>
<li><p>Requestor’s Email: email of the requestor requesting asset blocking</p></li>
<li><p>Reason for maintenance request: “To deactivate unposted asset number in SAP”</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Class: Select asset class from the drop-down</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Number: Enter asset number as given in unposted asset list</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Description: Enter asset description as given in unposted asset list</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The filled template will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:6.49822in;height:2.94in" /></p>
<p>Send the updated template to GFS Back Office DMT via mail requesting to block the asset. Sample email is given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image116.png" style="width:5.66172in;height:3.58302in" /></p></td>

<td colspan="5"><p>Basis request from Business, GFS Back Office DMT proceeds to deactivate the asset in SAP.</p>
<p>Open the template from the mail received from Business. The template will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:6.49822in;height:2.25775in" /></p>
<p>To proceed to block the asset in SAP, input T-code AS06 in SAP and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image117.png" style="width:3.63542in;height:0.71875in" /></p>
<p>Input the asset number, sub-number(if any) and Company Code in the following pop-up screen:</p>
<p><img src="media/image118.png" style="width:3.83862in;height:1.45in" /></p>
<p>Press Enter and asset details are displayed in the next screen. Verify these details match with the details in the Assets Master Data Maintenance template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image119.png" style="width:5in;height:3.7183in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:6.26575in;height:2.22267in" /></p>

<p><img src="media/image120.png" style="width:6.32327in;height:2.39795in" /></p>
<p>Once the details match with the template, click on “Physically delete asset” in the screen, click on Save icon above and SAP deletes the card.</p>
<p><img src="media/image121.png" style="width:4.94051in;height:4.05002in" /></p>
<p>A notification appears on the screen confirming that asset is deleted.</p>
<p><img src="media/image122.png" style="width:6.25in;height:5.21875in" /></p>
<p>Post deactivation, send a confirmation to Business that given fixed asset has been deactivated.</p>
<p>Sample email is given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image123.png" style="width:5.5935in;height:3.729in" /></p></td>

# RESPONSIBILITIES

## Roles and Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Role / Team Name | Description |
| Business | Refers to the respective Requesters who request for fixed asset code creation |
| GFS Back Office DMT | This includes all job roles within the GFS Back Office DMT group |
| GFS Back Office R2R | This team reviews the unposted asset listing report, follows-up with Business and creates and maintains a collated list of Unposted asset listing report |

# GLOSSARY

| **Terms** | **Definition** |
|----|----|
| AS01 | SAP T-code to create new asset code |
| AS02 | SAP T-code to maintain asset details |
| AS03 | SAP T-code to display the asset master data |
| AS06 | SAP T-code to delete an asset |
| AZ | AstraZeneca |
| AUC | Asset Under Construction |
| DMT | Data Management Team |
| ERP | Enterprise Resource Planning |
| FA | Fixed Asset |
| GFS | Global Finance Services |
| KS03 | SAP T-code to display Cost centre |
| LC | Local Country |
| N/A | Not applicable |
| R2R | Record to Report |
| R&D | Research and Development |
| SAP | Finance enterprise software used by AZ to record transactions for internal and external reporting |
| SQ01 | SAP T-code to extract PO report |
| S_ALR_87012056 | SAP T-code to extract directory of unposted assets |

- Headers in orange Column I to L contain formulas for data to be pulled from SAP report. Refer to Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.11.6 C) Steps to extract PO details.
- Note: Not all assets will appear in SQVI list, only asset numbers used in PO creation will appear in the list.
- Column G : Insert header “No. of days”. Use formula to calculate the number of days between the creation date and the last day of previous month, use formula “=DAYS360($F5,$F$1)”
- Column H : Insert header “Status”. Use formula to categorise the unposted asset numbers into different categories based on the number of days calculated in column G into buckets- “0 – 3months”, “3 months to 1 year” and “More than 1 year”, use formula “=IF(G5<90,"0 to 3 months",IF(G5<365,"3 months to 1 year","More than 1 year"))”
- Column I : Insert header “PO No. Tagged”. Use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:I,4,0),"None")”
- Column J : Insert header “PO Creation Date”. Use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:L,7,0),"None")”
- Column K : Insert header “PO Created By” and use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:K,6,0),"None")”
- Column L : Insert header “PO Requestor” and use formula “=IFNA(VLOOKUP(C5,'PO Details - SQ01'!F:G,2,0),"None")”
- Column M : “Suggested Actions by R2R”. There are 4 types of recommended actions to be taken by Business, suggested by GFS Back Office R2R:
- Recommend to delete: For assets more than 1 year old without PO tagged
- Investigation needed: For assets more than 1 year old with PO tagged would require Business to investigate whether the PO is still valid. If PO is no longer valid, then it needs to be closed before asset deletion
- Review required by LC: For those assets aged 3 months to 1 year
- No actions required: For those assets created not more than 3 months, no action needed from local country
- Use Formula “=IF(H5="","",IF(AND(H5="More than 1 year",I5="None"),"Recommend to delete",IF(AND(H5="More than 1 year",I5<>""),"Investigation needed",IF(H5="3 months to 1 year","Review required by LC","No actions required"))))”
- Column N : “Confirmed Actions by LC”
- Column O : Use header “Comments (if any)”.
- Go to View > untick Gridlines in order to have better presentation.
- Select the table B2: C6 create a diagram to indicate the summary by clicking on Insert>Chart> Clustered Column.
- If asset number is still required, proceed to step 4.7.12: 8.3.3.11.12 Confirm asset numbers are still required
- If asset number is no longer required, proceed to step 4.7.9: 8.3.11.9 Request for Asset Master Data Maintenance

# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), sets out the mandatory activities for the process relating to the creation of a fixed asset code for fixed asset addition(s) either through the direct purchase of an asset(s) or through capitalisation of capital projects.

Business needs to identify the type of fixed asset addition being processed.

For Non-Commercial Entities, any asset additions (“Direct addition of a fixed asset”) will need to go through Project System. The process will need to start with a Project Creation, please proceed to **8.4.1.3 Review and approve capital projects** process map for additional details.

Project System is used to track capital expenditure by E-code WBSE for all non-commercial units and settled into Asset Under Construction (AUC). Upon project completion or partial completion, asset will be put into use following asset additions via the AUC process. Please refer to process **8.4.2.4 Close and Capitalise Projects** process map for additional details.

If addition type is “Transfer between legal entities” then the following process needs to be followed:

The process for the billing entity (the entity sending the asset to the receiving entity) is to first retire the asset through the process **8.3.3.10 Process and Record Fixed Asset Retirements**.

The billing / sending entity will then issue a Non-Trade Invoice (NTI) to the receiving entity through the process **8.3.2.12 Post Intercompany Non-Trade Transactions** (Please see the process map for additional details).

On the other hand, the receiving entity will need to create the transferred asset using the Project System module. A standard project will will be used for the purpose of receiving the cost from the billing entity. The standard of naming of this NTI project is as follows:

E.AA \<4 digits company code\>, 2nd level \<2 digits 99\>, next level \<01 – tangible, 02 -intangible\> e.g. E.AA0010.99.01 refers to an NTI-based asset transfer project for UK (company code 0010), for a tangible asset (next level posting key of 01). This project needs to be created just once and maintained in “TECO” status until an asset transfer needs to be initiated.

In case the receiving entity’s project is at system status “Closed” or “TECO”, the receiving entity will need to request for the project status update by sending E-Code WBSE Maintenance Form to GFS Back Office DMT team to set system status to “Released”. Please refer to activity **4.7.17 Release Project** under process **8.4.2.4 Close and Capitalise Projects for additional details.**

Upon receiving the NTI, the invoice will need to be posted into standard Capital Expenditure GL 99100010 with the WBSE. **Note** that for NAM and UK, GL 70770150 is currently used as shown in the sample given below. Once the posting of NTI is settled into AUC, asset addition will be processed using **8.4.2.4 Close and Capitalise Projects**.

Note: Intercompany transfer is excluded from CPS reporting.

Sample of NINTEX NTI is given below:

<img src="media/image1.png" style="width:5.82238in;height:7.19069in" />

# PURPOSE

The process of asset impairment is required to accurately reflect the recoverable value of assets in the fixed asset register. Note: this applies to both tangible and intangible assets.

The carrying values of non-financial assets should be reviewed at least annually to determine whether there is any indication of impairment due to external and internal factors.

This process covers the processing and recording of fixed asset impairments.

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Business, Embedded Finance, GFS Back Office R2R, GFS Back Office DMT and GFS Middle Office.

| Excludes Goodwill and product intangible impairment | This SOP excludes goodwill and product intangible impairments, since it will be handled separately on a case-by-case basis, in consultation with business and GFR. |

This process occurs on an ad-hoc basis, as and when asset impairment is required, or following the annual impairment review.

<p><strong>:RGUL </strong>- Genpact Uberlandia</p>
<p><strong>:RKLH </strong>- Kuala Lumpur Hubs</p></td>
<td><p>Used to perform impairment of asset with the following T-codes: ABAA for impairment posting through unplanned depreciation method and AW01N, AS03 to view asset data</p>
<p>The second profile is for executing posting provisional journals through the Manual Journal Entry process and performing reversals</p>
<p>The final profiles are for T-codes AS02 to impair the asset by updating asset useful life and AS03 to view the asset</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Spreadsheet</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>This refers to MS Excel. Required to perform asset reviews and compilation, and prepare journal entry templates</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Email</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Required by all parties to create, submit, approve, and escalate asset impairment request</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

## Controls

The table below contains a summary of the Controls in the related process map:

|  |  |  |  |
|----|----|----|----|
| Control Id / Name | Control Type | Control Objective | Control Owner |
| CPX013 | SOX | What controls exist to ensure that carrying values of fixed and intangible assets remain appropriate and asset values have not been impaired? | Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office |

Notes:

1)  For the above SOX controls, these are SOX controls for applicable units as per the FCAS framework. For other units, these are FCF controls.

2)  The control objective defines the risk that needs to be addressed by the control.

For the definition and for detailed information on the control operated for your unit,

please refer to [FCAS](http://seskwfcswbp01.emea.astrazeneca.net/) for your unit.

3)  UK and Sweden Hubs to continue with operating the CPX010 instead of CPX013.

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:
