<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.1</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="perform-tangible-and-intangible-asset-review">Perform tangible and intangible asset review</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p><strong>Note</strong>: Please ensure you perform control CPX013 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<p>The carrying values of non-financial assets should be reviewed at least annually to determine whether there is any indication of impairment, and anytime when there is a business trigger event that may impact the carrying value or useful life of assets. The asset review is performed by Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office.</p>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office performs an impairment test by comparing the carrying value of the asset on the Balance Sheet with the recoverable amount. The test is performed at least on annual basis for assets listed under Group Accounting Manual, Section D1, and anytime there is an indication of impairment.</p>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will share the outcome with Business to take subsequent action.</p>
<p>If an impairment is required, the Business <strong>proceeds with step 8.3.3.4.2: 4.7.2 Prepare List of assets for impairment with accounting treatment.</strong></p>
<p>If a provision is required, the Business <strong>proceeds with 8.3.3.4.15: 4.7.15 Prepare provision journal entry.</strong></p>
<p>If no impairment or provision is required, after the impairment review is completed by Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, the process ends here.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="prepare-list-of-assets-for-impairment-with-accounting-treatment">Prepare list of assets for impairment with accounting treatment</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If an impairment is required, the Business prepares the list of fixed assets subject to impairment, together with the accounting treatment.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Prepare fixed asset impairment requests</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Following the receipt of the asset review report created by Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, Business will prepare a list of assets subject to impairment and determine the accounting treatment (value v/s time-based impairment). If required, Business may consult with GFR to determine the correct accounting treatment.</p>
<p><u>Note:</u> Please use Assets Impairment Template for value-based impairments. For time-based impairments leading to an update in useful life of an asset, Assets Master Data Maintenance Template is filled.</p>
<p><strong><u>Case 1: Value related impairment – Unplanned depreciation</u></strong></p>
<p>For value related impairment, Business must complete the Assets Impairment Template by following the steps below.</p>
<p>The information needed for impairment template from Asset Impairment Template is given below:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Asset number</p></li>
<li><p>Asset description</p></li>
<li><p>Asset acquisition date</p></li>
<li><p>Acquisition Value</p></li>
<li><p>Net Book Value</p></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>A.1) <u>Display Data for Single Asset</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Run SAP transaction AW01N in order to display data on asset description and to calculate Net Book Value (NBV):</p>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:2.8544in;height:0.65002in" /></p>
<p>Enter the company code, asset number and subnumber (if applicable) and press enter:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Asset subnumber</p>
<p>Asset number</p>
<p>Company code</p>
</blockquote>
<p>This will open-up the asset in Asset Explorer. Click on the posted values tab</p>
<p>The NBV will be displayed as screenshot below. Fill in the impairment template with this information accordingly. For asset acquisition date, click on “Display Master Data” <img src="media/image4.png" style="width:0.13596in;height:0.14049in" /> to display acquisition date.</p>
<p>Acquisition Value</p>
<p>Click on Display Master Data for acquisition date</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Asset description</p>
<p>Current NBV</p>
</blockquote>
<p>The below screen will appear.</p>
<p>Acquisition date will be displayed here</p>
<p><strong>A.2) <u>Display Data for Multiple Assets</u></strong></p>
<p>If there is more than one asset to impair, use T-code S_ALR_87011963 to check the mandatory fields of the impairment template.</p>
<p>Enter T-code S_ALR_87011963 in SAP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:4.79167in;height:1.83223in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D54302.89351290" /></p>
<p>Fill in the parameters as mentioned below:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code – As per the request</p></li>
<li><p>Asset number – The asset numbers you need to impair</p></li>
<li><p>Report date – Need to follow posting date at month end</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation area – input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Note</strong>: Depreciation Area for book value is different with different SAP instances. Please input according to your SAP instances in which you are operating.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Sort Variant – 0001</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click on the “Execute” button <img src="media/image8.png" style="width:0.23958in;height:0.20833in" /> or press “F8” to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:5.71304in;height:4.79697in" /></p>
<p>Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”</p>
<p>NBV</p>
<p>Acquisition date</p>
<p>Asset description</p>
<p>Acquisition value</p>
<p>Asset number</p>
<p>If the impairment posting date is in a subsequent month, the current NBV must be reduced by the total amount of planned depreciation up to period preceding impairment posting date.</p>
<p>Please note: Based on the selection of request type and impairment type, the template will highlight (in red text) the areas that need to be updated.</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.35556in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Case 2: Time related impairment – Updating asset useful life</u></strong></p>
<p>If the impairment test shows that the useful life of the asset has decreased, then prepare the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template accordingly (Please see <strong>Section 7 References</strong> for the template).</p>
<p>For useful life information, run T-code AS03 to display the asset master.</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:3.17917in;height:1.0142in" /></p>
<p>Enter the Company code, asset number and subnumber and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:3.47482in;height:1.97047in" /></p>
<p>Click on the “Deprec. Areas” tab for useful life details:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Field “UseLife” is the number of years and field “Prd” is the number of months of useful life</p>
<p>If useful life needs to be updated for “Book deprec.” and Local GAAP, update the current values in the template</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Please note: Changes required in useful life from a local GAAP perspective need to be confirmed by the country Finance Controller.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Fill in asset details using SAP</p>
<p>Fill in reason to update useful life as agreed with Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Once completed, please proceed with the next step <strong>4.7.3:</strong> <strong>8.3.3.4.3 Submit for Approval and notify GFR where required.</strong></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>

<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.3</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="submit-for-approval-and-notify-gfr-where-required">Submit for Approval and notify GFR where required</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Business will share the list of assets to be impaired with Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office for review and request for necessary approval. The outcome of an impairment review may be a request to impair the asset for group of assets value (Value Based) or to change the asset’s useful economic life (Time-based). Please refer to step 4<strong>.7.13: 8.3.3.4.13 Impair Asset by Updating asset Useful Life</strong> for time-based impairment.</p>
<p>With reference to <strong>Section</strong> <strong>4.4.4</strong> <strong>AZ Global Capital and Fixed Assets Standard</strong> (Refer <strong>Section 7</strong> <strong>References</strong> for link), value-based impairment should be approved under the appropriate DOA. Impairment charge should be assessed against activity code ‘2003 – CAPITAL EXPENDITURE &amp; DISPOSAL’.</p>
<p>Any impairment greater than $5m should be communicated to GFR. Impairments with unusual, complex or judgemental issues, and / or greater than $10m, will require a formal <a href="https://azusgb01--cms.na42.visual.force.com/apex/Main?sname=Intranet&amp;name=Finance-Processes-Accounting-Issues-Process#/">Accounting Issues Note</a> to be submitted to GFR.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Determine DOA approver</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Use this link to navigate to the global DOA to determine the approver for impairment: <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4">http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DOAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4</a></p>
<p>Click on “search”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image18.png" style="width:6.48592in;height:2.03194in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D3C19E.C0776500" /></p>
<p>Click on the “Country” drop-down in the Search bar for the relevant requester’s country. Next, select the activity code “2003 – CAPITAL EXPENDITURE &amp; DISPOSAL” and click on ‘search”.</p>
<p>A list of approvers will then appear as the screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.075in;height:3.37741in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D36AB0.3CA5BF00" /></p>
<p>Select the appropriate level of approver based on the value of impairment. Note: any approver with authorisation equal to or greater than the impairment value can be requested for DOA approval.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Submit request for approval</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Send request via email to the required DOA approver, with the fixed Assets Impairment Template attached including the fixed assets subject to impairment. Please note that GFR will also need to be notified for assets greater than $5 million threshold.</p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:5.14726in;height:2.2556in" /></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>

</table>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.4</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="review-and-provide-approval-to-asset-impairment-request">Review and provide approval to asset impairment request</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will review the asset impairment request shared by the Business via Email and will determine if the template reflects the correct information from the asset register.</p>
<p><strong>Note</strong>: Please ensure you perform control CPX013 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<p>UK and Sweden Hubs to continue with operating the CPX010 instead of CPX013.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Review impairment request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>At the time of review, check that the accounting treatment is in line with the Group Accounting Manual (Section D1) and the Global Capital standard. Please refer <strong>Section 7 References</strong> for link to the Group Accounting Manual.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify Net Book Value (NBV)</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Please note that checking the NBV is relevant to all types of impairment.</p>
<p>Go to T-code AW01N:</p>
<p>Note: We can also use SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963” to check balance for multiple assets, acquisition date, Asset Class, NBV. Refer <strong>sub step</strong> <strong>4.7.2</strong> <strong>8.3.3.4.2 A.2)</strong> <strong>Display Data for Multiple Assets</strong></p>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:2.51459in;height:1.19023in" /></p>
<p>Open the template and view the asset details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.90091in" /></p>
<p>Enter Company code, Asset number and Asset subnumber (where applicable) as per the template and press “Enter”:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Asset number</p>
<p>Company code</p>
<p>Asset subnumber</p>
</blockquote>
<p>This will open the asset in Asset Explorer:</p>
<p><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:5.49723in;height:3.46492in" /></p>
<p>Click on the “Posted values” tab to view Net Book Value. Please ensure that the depreciation area 01 is selected and the fiscal year is the year for the posting date.</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Fiscal year</p>
<p>Depreciation area 01</p>
<p>Current NBV</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Check that the asset NBV at the time of the impairment posting date matches the Net Book Value on the form. In this case the impairment posting is in February. Since depreciation is posted till January, the current NBV will be the NBV at the impairment posting date.</p>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:5.88154in;height:1.65527in" /></p>
<p>If the impairment posting date is in a subsequent month, instead, the current NBV must be reduced by the total amount of planned depreciation up to period preceding impairment posting date. Check that this value is the same as the Net Book Value mentioned in the form.</p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify asset useful life</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Note: In case the request is for updating useful life of asset, then an additional check is required to ensure that the current useful life is correct as per SAP. Refer to the Asset Master Data Maintenance Template as given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:2.36076in" /><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:5.77303in;height:2.09722in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:6.08333in;height:1.71736in" /></p>
<p>For useful life information, run T-code AS03 to display the asset:</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:2.97118in;height:1.05768in" /></p>
<p>Enter the company code, asset number and subnumber (where applicable) from the template, and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:3.08351in;height:1.95308in" /></p>
<p>Click on the “Deprec. Areas” tab for useful life details:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Field “UseLife” is the number of years and field “Prd” is the number of months of useful life</p>
<p>Check that this matches with the template values</p>
</blockquote>
<p>These details will be verified from the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.49167in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Approve impairment request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once the asset impairment request template is reviewed, if the accounting treatment is not in line with the Group Accounting Manual (Section D) and the Global Capital Standard, or, if the template is not in line with the SAP asset register data, then Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will advise the business to <strong>proceed with Step 4.7.5: 8.3.3.4.5 Amend Request.</strong></p>
<p>If approval is granted, <strong>proceed with Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.4.6 Raise Asset Impairment Request.</strong></p>
<p><img src="media/image25.png" style="width:6.38561in;height:2.77268in" /></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="5">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.5</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="amend-request">Amend Request</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If the request has been rejected by Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, the Business will be informed of the rejection via email, including the reason for rejection. The Business will need to amend the request submitted, based on feedback received from the Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, and repeat the process starting from <strong>Step 4.7.3: 8.3.3.4.3</strong> <strong>Submit for approval</strong> <strong>and notify GFR where required</strong>.</p>
<p><strong><u>Amend Fixed Asset impairment request based on feedback from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</u></strong></p>
<p>Based on feedback / instructions received from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, perform the necessary changes to the fixed asset impairment request template and / or asset report</p>
<p>containing the listing of assets which require impairment. Once completed, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.3: 8.3.3.4.3</strong> <strong>Submit for approval</strong> <strong>and notify GFR where required</strong>.</p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>

<td><strong>8.3.3.4.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="raise-asset-impairment-request">Raise Asset Impairment request</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>On obtaining the approval from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, the Business will raise the request for the fixed asset impairment and submit to GFS Back Office R2R for processing.</p>
<p>If impairment needs to be processed for a large volume of assets at a time, this would be considered a strategic impairment request and the feasibility of processing this before Month-end would need to be checked by GFS Back Office R2R. Please see <strong>step 4.7.7 8.3.3.4.7 Submit major strategic impairment request.</strong></p>
<p>In case of a regular impairment, depending on the type of impairment as per the template produced in <strong>step 4.7.2 8.3.3.4.2 Prepare list of assets for impairment with accounting treatment</strong>, proceed with the impairment request.</p>
<p>Analyse if the request is value-based impairment or time-based impairment.</p>
<p>In case of value related impairments, <strong>proceed to step 4.7.12: 8.3.3.4.12 Impair Asset using unplanned depreciation.</strong> In case of time related impairments, <strong>proceed to step 4.7.13: 8.3.3.4.13 Review financial impact and provide approval for useful life update.</strong></p>
<p>Raise the impairment request via email and attach the template with the relevant supporting documentation (including the calculation of the impairment value or financial impact value) and approval email. Sample mail for impairment request is given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:6.14919in;height:2.66084in" /></p>
<p>Email addresses as below:</p>

<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.7</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="submit-major-strategic-impairment-request">Submit major strategic impairment request</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>

<td>Informed</td>

<td colspan="5">If the request is a major strategic adjustment, the Business will submit a request via email to GFS Back Office R2R to review and determine the feasibility of completion by Month-end close.</td>

<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.8</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="review-request-and-determine-feasibility-to-complete-by-month-end-close">Review request and determine feasibility to complete by month end close</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>GFS Back Office R2R receives a request for major strategic impairment via email from the business. GFS Back Office R2R reviews the impairment request and determines feasibility to complete the request in sub-ledger by month end close.</p>
<p><strong><u>Receive and review major strategic impairment request</u></strong></p>
<p>Once the request has been received, perform a review on the request to determine if the impairment can be accommodated and completed by month end close. The assessment will be undertaken by the GFS Back Office R2R team lead responsible for fixed assets. Assessment is on a case-by-case basis and will consider the volume of fixed assets to be impaired.</p>
<p>If the volume of impairment is feasible to process before month end, GFS Back Office R2R will proceed with the impairment request in sub-ledger.</p>
<p>In addition, if the depreciation for the month is already posted, then the unplanned depreciation can only be posted in the next period. For the current period, a manual journal entry needs to be posted and reversed in subsequent month.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>If the request can be fulfilled before the month end, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.12: 8.3.3.4.12 Impair Asset using unplanned depreciation.</strong></p></li>
<li><p>If the request cannot be fulfilled before month end, notify Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office via email to <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.9: 8.3.3.4.9 Submit request to post one-time Financial Accounting Journal.</strong></p></li>
</ul>
<p>Sample mail is given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:4.74034in;height:1.99565in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td>Informed</td>

<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>

<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If the request cannot be accommodated by GFS Back Office R2R, the request will be forwarded to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office, with the reason why this cannot be completed by the end of the month, and a request will need to be raised with the CFO / Controller for approval to post a one-time FI Journal.</p>
<p><strong><u>Submit request to post one-time FI Journal</u></strong></p>
<p>Raise a request via email to ask for approval for posting a one-time FI Journal to CFO / Controller (Ensure that the business requester remains in cc).</p>
<p><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:6.40368in;height:2.68849in" /></p>
<p>Please proceed to <strong>step 4.7.10 8.3.3.4.10 Review request and confirm feasibility of processing fixed asset changes during month end close</strong>.</p></td>
</tr>

<td colspan="8"><h3 id="review-request-and-confirm-feasibility-of-processing-fixed-asset-changes-during-month-end-close">Review request and confirm feasibility of processing fixed asset changes during month end close</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Responsible</td>
<td colspan="2">Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td colspan="3">Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">CFO / Controller</td>
<td colspan="2">CFO / Controller</td>

<td colspan="3">N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="9"><p>CFO / Controller will be notified of the impairment journal entry request that was routed for approval. CFO / Controller will then review the request and confirm feasibility of completing the request by Month end close, based on response from GFS Back Office R2R.</p>
<p><strong><u>Receive and review request of performing one-time FI Journal</u></strong></p>
<p>CFO / Controller will review response from GFS Back Office R2R to confirm the feasibility of completing the request by MEC.</p>
<p>If approved, proceed to notify the Business and <strong>proceed with Step 4.7.11: 8.3.3.4.11 Prepare Journal Entry Template.</strong></p>
<p>If approval is rejected, proceed to <strong>Step 4.7.12: 8.3.3.4.12 Impair asset using unplanned depreciation,</strong> to impair asset via unplanned depreciation.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="8">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.11</strong></td>
<td colspan="8"><h3 id="prepare-journal-entry-template">Prepare Journal Entry Template</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Responsible</td>
<td colspan="2">Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td colspan="3">Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Business</td>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td colspan="3">N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="9"><p>Once the request has been approved for a one-time FI posting, Business will then collate the necessary information for a journal entry template posting. The journal entry template will be prepared by Business. GFS Back Office R2R will perform processing via <strong>Process 8.3.2.2 Process Manual Journal Entries.</strong></p>
<p><strong><u>Prepare Journal Entry Template along with approvals and supporting documentation</u></strong></p>
<p>Business proceeds to prepare a manual journal entry template for the impairment that cannot be completed in the asset register for the month.</p>
<p>Journal entry to recognise the impairment with below set of impairment GLs group by asset classes.</p>

</table>
<p>Sample journal entry template with the above GLs is given below.</p>
<p>This journal is prepared with auto reversal in the subsequent month due to the impairment request cannot be processed in sub-ledger on time.</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:6.6in;height:2.06736in" /></p>
<p>Note: The screenshot is a sample from APAC journal template. Please use the journal template relevant to the regions you support. Refer <strong>Section 9 Appendices</strong> for the link.</p>
<p><strong>Proceed with process: 8.3.2.2: Process Manual Journal Entries</strong> in order to post the manual journal entry.</p>
<p><img src="media/image30.png" style="width:6.44107in;height:2.79654in" /></p>
<p>GFS Back Office R2R will then confirm when JE has been posted accordingly.</p>
<p>Please note that the steps required to create and post a Manual Journal Entry request can be found in <strong>8.3.2.2: Process Manual Journal Entries.</strong></p>
<p>After the manual journal is posted, this is reversed in the following month through <strong>process 8.3.2.21 Auto Reverse Journal Entry.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="8">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.12</strong></td>
<td colspan="8"><h3 id="impair-asset-using-unplanned-depreciation">Impair Asset using unplanned depreciation</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Responsible</td>
<td colspan="2">Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td colspan="3">Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td colspan="3">N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="9"><p>Unplanned depreciation will have the effect of increasing the depreciation so that the NBV will reflect the recoverable amount. Subsequent month’s depreciation will be posted as per the planned depreciation schedule.</p>
<p>GFS Back Office R2R will receive an impairment request and will review it before further processing. If the request is to update useful life, this will be redirected to GFS Back Office DMT, once the request is reviewed and found to be correct. If the request is to perform impairment through unplanned depreciation, this will be taken forward by GFS Back Office R2R.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Review the value based impairment request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>For intangible assets, goodwill and restructuring costs, please ensure that approval is provided as per the Global Capital Standard.</p>
<p>For other assets, use this link to navigate to the global DOA in order to determine whether the approver is as per DOA: <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4">http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DOAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4</a></p>
<p>Click on “Search”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image18.png" style="width:6.47651in;height:2.03194in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D3C19E.C0776500" /></p>
<p>Click on the ‘Country’ drop-down in the Search bar for the relevant requester’s country. Next, select the activity code ‘2003 – CAPITAL EXPENDITURE &amp; DISPOSAL’ and click on ‘Search’.</p>
<p>A list of approvers will appear as the screenshot below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image31.png" style="width:6.35776in;height:3.57669in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D36AB0.3CA5BF00" /></p>
<p>Check that the DOA approval email in supporting documents matches the appropriate DOA approver:</p>
<p><mark></mark><img src="media/image25.png" style="width:6.21917in;height:2.71345in" /></p>
<p>In addition, GFS Back Office R2R needs to check the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>The information in the template matches the supporting documents provided,</p>
<ul>
<li><p>For value related impairment, the calculation provided in the supporting document tab should match the impairment value.</p></li>
<li><p>The screenshot of the depreciation schedule provided should match the depreciation used in the calculation provided in the supporting document tab.</p></li>
</ul></li>
<li><p>The total impairment value (in case of value related impairment) or financial impact (in case of time related impairment) is less than or equal to the NBV of the asset at the impairment posting date (as provided in the impairment request form).</p></li>
</ul>
<p>In case any of the checks fail, GFS Back Office R2R will communicate with the business so that they can amend the impairment request as per <strong>step 4.7.5: 8.3.3.4.5 Amend request.</strong></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Impair asset using unplanned Depreciation</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Open SAP, input T-code ABAA and click enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image32.png" style="width:3.25787in;height:1.12934in" /></p>
<p>Create asset transactions by entering the following as per the template:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code</p></li>
<li><p>Asset number</p></li>
<li><p>Asset subnumber (if required)</p></li>
<li><p>Document date (Impairment posting date)</p></li>
<li><p>Posting date (Impairment posting date)</p></li>
<li><p>Posting period (Period as per impairment posting date)</p></li>
<li><p>Transaction Type: Select transaction type according to acquisition year</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>640</strong> Unplanned depreciation on prior-year acquisition</p>
<p><strong>650</strong> Unplanned depreciation on current-year acquisition.</p>
<p>Update the details from the template to SAP sreen will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image33.png" style="width:6.26343in;height:2.26074in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image34.png" style="width:6.12073in;height:4.62404in" /></p>
<p>Click on green tick <img src="media/image35.png" style="width:0.1929in;height:0.18085in" /> or press Enter.</p>
<p>Complete the parameters on the next page using the details from the template as mentioned below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image33.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.36042in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the details as given below on the next screen:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Amount posted: Impairment value as per the template</p></li>
<li><p>“Asset Val. Date”: Impairment posting date as per the template</p></li>
<li><p>Text: Impairment justification</p></li>
<li><p>Reference: “R2R_Impairment posting date”. (“DDMMYYYY”)</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Then click on Edit line items <img src="media/image36.png" style="width:0.7094in;height:0.17552in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image39.png" /><img src="media/image41.png" style="width:4.2429in;height:4.93675in" /></p>
<p>On the next page it will display the next depreciation area. Input the amount if it is applicable and click <img src="media/image42.png" style="width:0.12818in;height:0.13331in" /> or press Enter.</p>
<hr />
<p><img src="media/image37.png" style="width:0.84812in" /><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:3.87268in;height:2.06949in" /></p>
<p>Upon completion of each depreciation area, the following screen opens. Click on <img src="media/image44.png" style="width:0.21886in;height:0.19454in" />. Check that the values are in line with the template (Book Area will vary for each region as per SAP instance).</p>
<p><img src="media/image38.png" style="width:0.16458in;height:0.32986in" /> <img src="media/image45.png" style="width:3.53356in;height:3.67393in" /></p>
<p>Note: The number of Depreciation Area are varies for different regions or company codes as per SAP instances</p>
<p>Click on save <img src="media/image46.png" style="width:0.18722in;height:0.20802in" /> and the fixed asset ledger (FA) will capture the amount but this is not yet posted to general ledger (FI).</p>
<p><img src="media/image39.png" /><img src="media/image41.png" style="width:4.25217in;height:4.91131in" /></p>
<p>A success message will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image39.png" /><img src="media/image47.png" style="width:4.74543in;height:2.71971in" /></p>
<p>At this stage, unplanned depreciation is captured in planned values tab but no actual posting in FI yet. Depreciation run (T-code AFAB) needs to be performed in order to post the unplanned depreciation to accounting document.</p>
<p>Please see <strong>process 8.3.3.6 Calculate and Record Depreciation Expense</strong> for posting the depreciation.</p>
<p>After depreciation is posted, on viewing the asset in AW01N, unplanned depreciation will be seen in “changed” column of “Planned Values” tab.</p>
<p>Use the AW01N transaction code:</p>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:2.68014in;height:1.32117in" /></p>
<p>Enter company code, Asset number and subnumber (where applicable) as per the template and press “Enter”:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Asset number</p>
<p>Company code</p>
<p>Asset subnumber</p>
</blockquote>
<p>The following screen will appear:</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:5.31119in;height:3.90955in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Posted values” Tab.</p>
<p>After depreciation is posted, the unplanned depreciation amount will show in “posted values” tab:</p>
<p><img src="media/image49.png" style="width:4.90838in;height:5.05303in" /></p>
<p>Double click on the transaction, posting log will be displayed as below. Click at the reference Doc number to display the FI posting.</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:6.6in;height:1.02917in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Accounting document” on the next pop-up screen.</p>
<p><img src="media/image51.png" style="width:3.35541in;height:2.02017in" /></p>
<p>The posting is in accordance to ABAA mapping by asset class as shown below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image52.png" style="width:6.6in;height:2.46181in" /></p>
<p>Depreciation for subsequent periods are now revised accordingly:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Annual depreciation schedule is changed for subsequent fiscal years</p>
</blockquote>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Reversal Unplanned Depreciation on impaired Asset</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>It should be assessed at each reporting date whether there is any indication that any impairment loss recorded in a prior period may no longer exist.</p>
<p>If factors causing the original impairment reverse, then the impairment loss should be reversed. For example, sales of impaired assets, prior period impairment reversal should be performed before performing sales or scrapping of the assets. The maximum amount of the reversal is limited to the value of the original impairment.</p>
<p>To reverse impairment, follow the same steps of processing impairment with T-code ABAA with different transaction codes given below:</p>
<p><strong>X64</strong> - Debit: Unplanned deprec. on prior-year acquisitions.</p>
<p>(If the impairment is done with transaction type 640 Unplanned depreciation on prior-year acquisitions)</p>
<p><strong>X65</strong> - Debit: Unplanned deprec. on current-year acquisition</p>
<p>(If the impairment is done with transaction type 650 Unplanned depreciation on current-yr acquisitions)</p>
<p>Please refer <strong>steps in activity 4.7.12: 8.3.3.4.12 Impair Asset using unplanned depreciation</strong> for steps using T-code ABAA with transaction type X64 and X65.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="7">TASK NAME</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.4.13</strong></td>
<td colspan="7"><h3 id="review-financial-impact-and-provide-approval-for-useful-life-update">Review financial impact and provide approval for useful life update</h3></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td colspan="7"><p>Update the asset’s life in SAP according to the Assets Master Data Maintenance template. This will trigger a recalculation of the depreciation during the month end depreciation run.</p>
<p><strong><u>Amend useful life</u></strong></p>
<p>Receive request for updating the useful life for impairment from Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office.</p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:2.65092in" /><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.49722in" /></p>
<p>Template screen containing useful life.</p>
<p><img src="media/image56.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.07415in" /></p>
<p>Run T-code AS02 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image57.png" style="width:3.26363in;height:1.33007in" /></p>
<p>Specify asset to be impaired by entering asset number and company code from the form. Press Enter once populated.</p>
<p><img src="media/image58.png" style="width:3.96941in;height:2.59285in" /></p>
<p>Next, go to the tab “Deprec. Areas”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image59.png" style="width:5.55108in;height:4.32069in" /></p>
<p>Amend values under column “UseLife” per below screenshot. Note that the column for “UseLife” represents year, while the column “Prd” represents month. Once your update is complete, click on the Save icon on the top.</p>
<p><img src="media/image56.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.07415in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image60.png" style="width:6.29048in;height:3.90768in" /></p>
<p>The next screen will display a success message at the bottom, where the asset has been changed. The useful life has now been updated and this will be captured during the next depreciation cycle run.</p>
<p><img src="media/image61.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:4.81528in" /></p>
<p>Once change is complete, when depreciation is run for the month (please see <strong>8.3.3.6 Calculate and Record Depreciation Expense</strong>), sub-ledger will recalculate depreciation starting from Jan of the current year. This will result in a big lump sum of depreciation posted for the month as catch-up and then fixed amount in subsequent months. Below is an example of how to check the new depreciation posting.</p>
<p>Using AW01N T-code, the depreciation values of the asset can be checked:</p>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:3.14193in;height:1.22508in" /></p>
<p>Enter company code and Asset number, and subnumber (where applicable) as per the template and hit Enter:</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Asset number</p>
<p>Company code</p>
<p>Asset subnumber</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Go to the posted values tab:</p>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:5.96212in;height:6.125in" /></p>
<p>This shows the change in the depreciation schedule due to useful life update.</p></td>

<td colspan="5"><p>If a provision is required for a specific asset, Business prepares the journal entries for the provision with the details and supporting documents which will be sent to GFS Back Office R2R for processing.</p>
<p><strong><u>Prepare Provision journal entry template</u></strong></p>
<p>Prepare the Manual Journal entry template for a provision entry (please see <strong>sub step 4.7.2 8.3.3.4.2 Case 1 Value related impairment – Unplanned depreciation</strong> for further information on the asset details).</p>
<p><img src="media/image64.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:2.04792in" /></p>
<p>Note: This is a sample APAC template. Please use your respective region’s MJE template. Refer <strong>Section 9 Appendices</strong> for links.</p>
<p>The journal template will be prepared to credit the appropriate impairment GLs (in the case above, this is 11220300 Building Impairment) and to debit the impairment depreciation GL (in the case above, this is: 740310100 Impairments - Land &amp; Buildings). Refer to <strong>Task 4.7.11: 8.3.3.4.11 Prepare Journal Entry Template</strong> for the list of relevant GLs. Impairment provision will need to be reviewed from time to time to ensure it does not exceed asset’s NBV.</p>
<p>Ensure that the completed template is attached to the Manual Journal Entry request, in order to proceed with processing manual journals. Detailed steps can be found in <strong>Process</strong> <strong>8.3.2.2: Process Manual Journal Entries.</strong></p></td>

# RESPONSIBILITIES

## Roles and Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Role / Team Name | Description |
| CFO / Controller | Refers to the CFO / Controller who will confirm feasibility of processing fixed asset changes during MEC |
| Business | Refers to all relevant parties within the business who are responsible for determining the need for impairment and submitting the request for impairment |
| Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office | Refers to the relevant Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office contacts or teams who extract data for impairment review and approve journals provided by the business ensuring that data is captured correctly |
| GFS Back Office DMT | Refers to the GFS Back Office DMT responsible to impair asset by updating asset register with the revised expected useful life |
| GFS Back Office R2R | Refers to GFS Back Office R2R: Fixed Assets team responsible for performing unplanned depreciation and Journal Entry Team / FRO Team, responsible for posting manual journal entries |

# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for processing and recording fixed asset retirements.

Fixed assets can be retired either by transfer (within a legal entity or between legal entities), or through a system-based retirement (with or without an invoice). To initiate the asset retirement process, upon request from the Business, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office will complete the Assets Retirement Request Template and obtain approval from the appropriate approver as per the Global Delegation of Authority (DOA).

Once approved, the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template will either be routed to GFS Back Office DMT for transfers within the same legal entities, or Assets Retirement Request Template and Assets Transfer Request Template to GFS Back Office R2R for all other types of retirement. GFS Back Office DMT and GFS Back Office R2R will access the template for details with regard to the retirement.

GFS Back Office R2R will then perform validation of the request details and check the supporting documents against DOA and SAP. Examples of items to check are the approver, the cost centre and the net book value of the asset. Once the process is completed, GFS Back Office DMT and GFS Back Office R2R will inform the Business via Email.

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Embedded Finance, GFS Middle Office, GFS Back Office R2R and GFS Back Office DMT.

# SCOPE

| Business Process | Description                                   |
| Global           | This process is applicable to all AZ entities |

## Process Detail

The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:

<table>

<td colspan="4"><h3 id="request-for-asset-retirement">Request for asset retirement</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>The process for fixed asset retirement begins when there is a need to decommission / sell / transfer / retire a fixed asset. The Business sends a request via email for asset retirement or transfer and attaches relevant supporting documents required to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office. The request should include the following information:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed Asset Number</p></li>
<li><p>Type of Retirement</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Retirement Effective Date</p></li>
<li><p>New cost centre (in case of a transfer within a legal entity)</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Sample email request for asset retirement:</p>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" /></p></td>
