<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 15%" />
<col style="width: 27%" />
<col style="width: 18%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.2</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="complete-asset-retirement-form">Complete Asset Retirement form</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once the Business has requested an asset retirement, prepare the Asset Retirement Request Template or Assets Master Data Maintenance template (in case of a transfer within a legal entity) and the supporting documents.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create request for asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>There are different requests for different types of retirement:</p>
<p><strong>A.1) <u>For transfer within legal entity (without asset class change)</u></strong></p>
<p>For a fixed asset transfer within a legal entity (without a change in asset class), change the cost centre in the fixed asset master data.</p>
<p>The Assets Master Data Maintenance template needs to be filled with the recipient cost centre with the help of the Business requester when necessary. Maintenance Type should be: “CHANGE”</p>
<p><img src="media/image6.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.10972in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:6.55416in;height:1.28309in" /></p>
<p>DOA approval for an Asset Master Record Change is not required. Once the Assets Master Data Maintenance template is complete, <strong>proceed to sub-step 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 B) Create an Email request for an asset retirement</strong> and send the completed template for approval to the team lead. A sample email request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image8.png" style="width:3.4375in;height:2.05208in" /></p>
<p>A sample email approval is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:1.72844in;height:0.11523in" /><img src="media/image10.png" style="width:3.47917in;height:2.875in" /></p>
<p>Once the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template is approved, <strong>proceed to the</strong> <strong>step 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 Submit or amend request to transfer, decommission or sell asset. Obtain approvals as per DOA</strong> to transfer the asset within a legal entity by changing the asset master record.</p>
<p><strong>A.2) <u>For transfer within legal entity (with asset class change)</u></strong></p>
<p>For a fixed asset transfer within a legal entity with asset class change, the asset's net book value needs to be transferred to a new asset. The Assets Transfer Request Template needs to be filled in with the mandatory fields (highlighted in Red).</p>
<p>If the Receiver Asset Numbers have already been created upon raising a request for asset transfer, please select “Yes” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field. Column L until Column AS will be blacked out as this information is only required for asset creation (where applicable).</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.53819in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.53403in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.50278in" /></p>
<p>There are other mandatory fields in order to create Asset Number in different SAP Instances.</p>
<p>UK – Cost Center/ Evaluation Group 2 (Set Area)/ Evaluation Group 5 (Location) and Depreciation start date</p>
<p>Sweden – Cost Center/ Depreciation start date</p>
<p>NAM – Cost Center/ Responsible Cost Center/ Evaluation Group 1 (State)/ Evaluation Group 2 (Location)/ Evaluation Group 3 (Type of Asset Class)/ Depreciation start date</p>
<p>If the Receiver Asset Numbers need to be created upon request for asset transfer, please select “No” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field.</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.52431in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.53819in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.51042in" /></p>
<p>DOA approval for an Asset Class change is not required. Once the Assets Transfer Request Template is complete, proceed <strong>to sub-step: 8.3.3.10.3 4.7.3 B) Create an Email request for an asset retirement</strong> for an asset retirement to transfer the asset within a legal entity with asset class change.</p>
<p><strong>A.3) <u>For transfer to other legal entities, non-invoice retirements or invoice retirements</u></strong></p>
<p>For a transfer to another legal entity, raise a request to retire the asset in the transferring legal entity. After the asset is retired, invoice it to the receiving entity through an inter-company Non-Trade Invoice (NTI). Please refer to process <strong>8.3.2.12 Post Inter-company Non-Trade Transactions</strong> for this. Add the asset in the Purchasing Entity through the process <strong>8.3.3.3 Process &amp; Record Fixed Asset Additions</strong>.</p>
<p>First, the transferring legal entity needs to complete the Assets Retirement Request Template, including the Net Book Value (NBV) of the retiring asset.</p>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.92153in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Check the NBV of assets</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The SAP report can be generated by executing T-code “AS03” to open single asset balance and T-code “S_ALR_87011963” to review multiple open asset balances information.</p>
<p><strong>B.1) <u>To check Single Asset Balance</u></strong></p>
<p>Login to SAP following the instructions as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image18.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Enter SAP T-code AS03.</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:5.27945in;height:1.84406in" /></p>
<p>Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template, press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:5.02125in;height:1.67777in" /></p>
<p>The below screen appears displaying the Asset Master Data. Verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Asset number</p></li>
<li><p>Asset description</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Capitalization Date</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:0.21909in;height:0.1043in" /><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:4.65744in;height:3.72in" /></p>
<p>Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the asset’s NBV.</p>
<p><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:4.42426in;height:1.7742in" /></p>
<p>Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both the values are same.</p>
<p><img src="media/image25.png" style="width:6.24721in;height:3.65365in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>B.2) <u>To check balance for Multiple Assets</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Enter SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:4.26978in;height:1.66296in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the parameters as mentioned below:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code - As per the request</p></li>
<li><p>Input asset numbers by selecting <img src="media/image27.png" style="width:0.24238in;height:0.18765in" /> and input asset number as per template</p></li>
<li><p>Report date – input the last month end date of the last depreciation run.</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation area – input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation</p></li>
<li><p>Sort variant - 0001</p></li>
<li><p>Select List assets</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click on the “Execute” button <img src="media/image28.png" style="width:0.23958in;height:0.20833in" /> or press “F8” to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:0.73542in;height:0.10417in" /><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:0.24306in;height:0.11528in" /><img src="media/image32.png" /><img src="media/image34.png" style="width:5.86111in;height:3.55139in" /></p>
<p>Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”</p>
<p><img src="media/image35.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.31806in" /></p>
<p>Using the information above, verify on below data with the Assets Retirement Request Template.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Asset number</p></li>
<li><p>Asset description</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Capitalization Date</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Acquisition Value</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all evidence is gathered, the template needs to be authorized by the delegated DOA. Assets Retirement approver must have 2003 DOA Authority (Capital Expenditure and Asset Disposal). Please check DOA Portal through this <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_afrWindowMode=0&amp;_afrLoop=263310020079381&amp;_adf.ctrl-state=y2d8rrhst_4">link</a>. Refer sub-step <strong>8.3.3.10.6 4.7.6 C) Verify approver against Global DOA.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.3</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="submit-or-amend-request-to-transfer-decommission-or-sell-asset.-obtain-approvals-as-per-doa">Submit or amend request to transfer, decommission or sell asset. Obtain approvals as per DOA</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Business / GFS Back Office DMT</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Before an asset retirement can take place, the requester must submit the template with supporting documents to the appropriate approver according to DOA.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Request for approval for asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office requests the review and approval as per Delegations Standard Limits from Global DOA framework. A sample email approval request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.jpeg" /></p>
<p>If the templates have not been completed / filled in correctly:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>If amendment is required, amend the template accordingly and <strong>proceed to the step: 8.3.3.10.3: 4.7.3</strong> <strong>Submit or amend request to transfer, decommission or sell asset</strong>. <strong>Obtain approvals as per DOA.</strong></p></li>
<li><p>When there is no need for asset retirement any more, terminate the request and the process ends.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>If approved, an email approval will be sent by the respective approver, as per DOA 2003, as illustrated below.</p>
<p><img src="media/image45.jpeg" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Create an Email request for an asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once the approval is obtained send an Email request for the asset retirement to</p>
<ul>
<li><p>GFS Back Office DMT team to process the transfer within legal entity request. A sample request for an asset retirement as per the screenshot below:</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image44.png" style="width:4.31863in;height:6.74631in" /></p>
<ul>
<li><p>GFS Back Office R2R FA team to process the other retirement types request. A sample request for an asset retirement as per the screenshot below:</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image45.png" style="width:1.91304in;height:0.16296in" /><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:5.4074in;height:6.15997in" /></p>
<p>There are different types of asset retirements as below:</p>
<p>Requests that need to be sent to GFS Back Office DMT</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset Transfer within legal entity (which is not an update of asset class) – <strong>proceed</strong> <strong>to step 8.3.3.10.4: 4.7.4 Update fixed asset master data</strong>.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Requests that need to be sent to GFS Back Office R2R</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset Transfer within legal entity (which is an update of asset class) – proceed to <strong>step</strong> <strong>8.3.3.10.5: 4.7.5 Transfer the asset within legal entity</strong></p></li>
<li><p>Asset Transfer between legal entities – proceed to <strong>step 8.3.3.10.6: 4.7.6 Execute transactions to retire asset</strong></p></li>
<li><p>Retirement without invoice – proceed to <strong>step 8.3.3.10.7: 4.7.7 Retire partial or entire asset from FA Register</strong></p></li>
<li><p>Retirement with invoice – proceed to <strong>step 8.3.3.10.8: 4.7.8 Retire entire asset for an invoice sale.</strong></p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 0%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="5">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.4</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="update-fixed-asset-master-data">Update fixed asset master data</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td>GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If the transfer will be within the same legal entity (which is not an update of asset class), GFS Back Office DMT will perform an asset master data amendment (e.g. cost centre change).</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retrieve template from Email request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>GFS Back Office DMT will access the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template from the Email request:</p>
<p><img src="media/image44.png" style="width:3.98866in;height:5.35061in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Open Assets Master Data Maintenance template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Open the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the change request (marked with “*”, red, blue and green font colour as per “Instructions” tab in the request template) are complete in the Assets Master Data Maintenance template:</p>
<p><img src="media/image47.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.13819in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Update Cost Centre in SAP</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Log into SAP and select the appropriate SAP instance. Next, enter the user PRID and password to login:</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:6.13889in;height:3.34028in" /></p>
<p>Next, to change asset master data enter SAP T-code “AS02” and press “Enter”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image49.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.67708in" /></p>
<p>Input the “Asset” number, the “Subnumber” (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance template . Press “Enter” to continue:</p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:4.52736in;height:1.71304in" alt="cid:image002.png@01D5416C.28C0E020" /></p>
<p>Change the “Cost Center” field in SAP to reflect the cost centre field in the Assets Master Data Maintenance Template. Save the change once done.</p>
<p><img src="media/image51.png" style="width:2.41667in;height:2.28056in" /><img src="media/image52.png" style="width:4.10709in;height:2.23542in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Close the asset retirement request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once the asset master record is changed, save the Asset template by clicking “Save as”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>The shared folder as per following example: YYYY\Operation\Country code\2. Maintain Asset Master data\MM. MMMM\Change (e.g. 2015\Operation\PH\2. Maintain Asset Master Data\08. August\Change)</p></li>
<li><p>The file name as per the following mask: Request date_R2R-Asset number – Asset Change (e.g.: 06.08.2015_R2R115300000079 – Asset Change)</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Send the completed request for approval to the team lead. A sample email approval request is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image53.png" style="width:5.87437in;height:2.55947in" /></p>
<p>The GFS Back Office DMT Team Lead will check the asset master data maintenance has been performed by GFS Back Office DMT. This is to ensure that the data maintenance is complete and accurate by the end of the day. A sample email approval is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image54.png" style="width:5.03889in;height:3.60272in" /></p>
<p>After that, send a confirmation to the requester on successful Asset Master Record change request completion. A sample email confirmation is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:5.15753in;height:5.44726in" /></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 0%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="5">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.5</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="transfer-the-asset-within-legal-entity">Transfer the asset within legal entity</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If the transfer will be within the same legal entity (which is an update of asset class), GFS Back Office R2R will perform the asset transfer request as per the Asset Transfer Request Template.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retrieve template from Email request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>GFS Back Office R2R FA team will access the Assets Transfer Request Template from the Email request:</p>
<p><img src="media/image56.png" style="width:4.8526in;height:5.22207in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Open the Assets Transfer Request Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Open the Assets Transfer Request Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the change request are complete in the template.</p>
<p>If the requestor selects “Yes” from the dropdown list in the “Receiver Asset Number Available?” field.</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.53819in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.53403in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.50278in" /></p>
<p>If the Receiver Asset Numbers need to be created upon request for asset transfer, please select “No” from the dropdown list in the “Receiver Asset Number Available?” field.</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.52431in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.53819in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.51042in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>C) <u>Validate information in the Assets Transfer Request Template</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Log into SAP system to verify that data in the Assets Transfer Request Template is complete and accurate.</p>
<p>Next, to display the asset master data of sender data, execute SAP T-code AS03 and press “Enter”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:5.9909in;height:1.93472in" /></p>
<p>Insert the asset number, the Subnumber (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Transfer Request Template's sender data, and then press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image57.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.07917in" /></p>
<p>Next, verify that the Asset Class and Asset’s Description match with the details in the template.</p>
<p><img src="media/image58.png" style="width:6.41507in;height:5.01449in" /></p>
<p>Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the asset’s NBV.</p>
<p><img src="media/image59.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.86875in" /></p>
<p>Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both the values are same.</p>
<p><img src="media/image60.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.11806in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image61.png" style="width:4.10347in;height:0.58264in" /></p>
<p>In case of any discrepancy, send a query to the requester as per the below steps:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>If the template received with requestor selecting “Yes” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field, please proceed to sub-step <strong>D) Perform transfer in system</strong>.</p></li>
<li><p>If the template received with requestor selecting “No” from the dropdown list in the Receiver Asset Number Available? field, email the template to GFS Back Office DMT to request for Receiver Asset Number creations before they can perform asset transfer process.</p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image62.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:3.42639in" /></p>
<p>GFS Back Office DMT will email back the revised template once they have created the Receiver Asset Numbers.</p>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:5.19227in;height:4.37128in" /></p>
<p>GFS Back Office DMT will input the created Receiver Asset Number here</p>
<p><strong>D) <u>Perform transfer in system</u></strong></p>
<p>Once all information has been verified, proceed to transfer the asset via SAP T-code ABUMN and press “Enter”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image65.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.90903in" /></p>
<p>Input details to transfer asset.</p>
<p>Input the following fields and press “Enter” to complete:</p>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><ul>
<li><p>"Asset" - input the Sender data's asset number and sub-number (if provided)</p></li>
</ul></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><ul>
<li><p>“Document Date”, “Posting Date” and "Asset Value Date" – input the current date</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><ul>
<li><p>“Text” – Company code and "Asset Retirement" text</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><ul>
<li><p>“Existing Asset” – Select this option and input the Receiving Asset Number and sub-number (if applicable)</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>If there are other fields input to create the Receiver data's asset other than "Description", "Asset Class" and "Cost Center", click on "Master Data" for more fields to input.</p>
<p>If not, proceed to the next "Additional Details" tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image66.png" style="width:6.40625in;height:4.64583in" /></p>
<p>In the “Additional Details” tab, key in the following.</p>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>- “Posting Period” – input the month, in numeric value, e.g. “5”</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>- “Document Type” – input the type “AA”</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><img src="media/image67.png" style="width:6.23275in;height:4.37417in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:0.99306in;height:0.14161in" /></p>
<p>If requestor only wants to perform partial transfer, go to Partial Transfer tab in SAP to input the partial amount to be transferred. </p>
<p>Please note that for performing a partial transfer, there can be two scenarios as given below:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Asset transfer to more than one asset: If the request specifies the transfer to more than one asset, then the total amount would be split accordingly. For e.g. The above asset with total value as 987.50 can be transferred to one asset with value 300 and another asset with value 687.5</p></li>
<li><p>Partial transfer: If the request specifies the asset to be transferred partially, then the Amount Posted field should reflect the partial amount only. For e.g. Only 300 out of 987.50 to be transferred to the correct asset class (also shown in the screenshot below) </p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image69.png" style="width:6.4367in;height:3.94046in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Post asset transfer</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image70.png" style="width:6.31299in;height:4.28722in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:0.99306in;height:0.14161in" /></p>
<p>Once done, click on Save.</p>
<p><img src="media/image71.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:4.10625in" /></p>
<p>If the asset transfer has been posted successfully, a notification will appear to inform the posting document and newly created asset.</p>
<p><img src="media/image72.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.13403in" /></p>
<ol start="6" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify that asset transfer is being posted</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check if the asset transfer is posted successfully in the system by going back to SAP T-code AS03 to display the Sender data asset master data. If successful, the Sender data asset will be updated with a Deactivation Date.</p>
<p><img src="media/image73.png" style="width:4.42423in;height:3.81806in" /></p>
<p>As for Asset Values, the NBV will now be blank to show that the asset no longer has any value. There will also be a new transaction below showing the retirement.</p>
<p><img src="media/image74.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.825in" /></p>
<p>Note that after transferring the full NBV over to the receiving asset, the sender asset will be automatically deactivated.</p>
<p>To display the document details access SAP with the T-code FB03. Then key in the following fields and press “Enter”:</p>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>- “Document Number” – input the posting document number</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>- “Company Code” – input the relevant company code</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>- “Fiscal Year” – input the current year</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><img src="media/image75.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.85069in" /></p>
<p>If the transfer posting exists, the data entry view for that document will open as pictured below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:0.82629in;height:0.11782in" /><img src="media/image76.png" style="width:6.30651in;height:2.78706in" /></p>
<p>To display the Receiver data asset master data access SAP with the T-code AS03. Then key in the following fields and press “Enter”.</p>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><ul>
<li><p>“Document Number” – input the posting document number</p></li>
</ul></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><ul>
<li><p>“Company Code” – input the relevant company code</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><ul>
<li><p>“Fiscal Year” – input the current year</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><img src="media/image77.png" style="width:5.02083in;height:4.77111in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Asset Values” to check NBV.</p>
<p><img src="media/image78.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:3.01458in" /></p>
<ol start="7" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Notify the requester on request completion</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Send email to inform the requester about the successful asset transfer transaction.</p>
<p>Below is the sample email:</p>
<p><img src="media/image79.png" style="width:5.63087in;height:5.83569in" /></p>
<p><strong>Proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.10: 4.7.10 Receive confirmation that asset has been retired.</strong></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 0%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="5">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="execute-transactions-to-retire-asset">Execute transactions to retire asset</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If the transfer is between legal entities, GFS Back Office R2R will execute the transaction to retire the asset in the transferring entity. For regulatory requirements, the financial transfer must be processed at the time the physical transfer occurs.</p>
<p>This step is to transfer asset between legal entities in AZ, so we need to follow the NTI process:</p>
<p>From selling entity perspective, two steps are needed:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Issue an NTI to receiving party (Refer process <strong>8.3.2.12 Post Intercompany Non-Trade Transactions</strong> for details)</p></li>
<li><p>Retire the assets</p></li>
</ol>
<p>The asset of selling party will be retired from the FA register to gain / loss account. Then the respective GFS Back Office C2C or GFS Back Office P2P will post to the relevant customer / vendor account during NTI posting. Also note that the gain/loss account is auto-populated by the system.</p>
<p>From receiving entity perspective,</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Post the NTI in a project</p></li>
<li><p>Capitalise the assets via <strong>process 8.3.3.3 Process and Record Fixed Asset Additions</strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Please ensure that you perform control CPX008 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retrieve template from Email request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The GFS Back Office R2R FA team will access the Assets Retirement Request Template from the Email request:</p>
<p><img src="media/image80.png" style="width:3.5in;height:4.39583in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Open Assets Retirement Request Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Open the Assets Retirement Request Template and ensure all mandatory fields for the request (marked with “*”, and red font colour as per “Instructions” tab in the request Template) are complete.</p>
<p>The Assets Retirement Request Template is pictured below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image81.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.90139in" /></p>
<p>(same as example given in <strong>8.3.3.10.2 4.7.2 C) For transfer to other legal entities, non-invoice retirements or invoice retirements</strong>)</p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify approver against Global DOA</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Verify that there is email approval by the respective approver, as per DOA 2003, for the retirement of asset as illustrated below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image82.png" style="width:4.89771in;height:3.14819in" /></p>
<p>Ensure that the retirement is approved by the appropriate DOA. Please access Global DOA by using this <a href="http://entprdappenta.emea.astrazeneca.net/DoAProd/faces/Home.jspx?_adf.ctrl-state=147ow55mve_4">link</a>.</p>
<p>Click on the “Country” drop-down in the Search bar for the relevant requester’s country. Next, select the activity code “2003 – CAPITAL EXPENDITURE &amp; DISPOSAL” and click on “Search”.</p>
<p>A list of approvers will then appear as the screenshot below. From the list, verify the name of the expected approver against the above approver’s email screenshot. In addition, also verify that the Asset’s amount is with the approver’s authority.</p>
<p><img src="media/image83.png" style="width:6.18194in;height:4.31319in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D36AB0.3CA5BF00" /></p>
<p>If the approval is not given by the appropriate approver / invalid approval, query back to the requester. A sample email query is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image84.png" style="width:3.51042in;height:4.39583in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Validate information in the Assets Retirement Request Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Log into SAP system to verify that data in the Assets Retirement Request Template is complete and accurate.</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Use SAP T-code “AS03” to display Asset master data for single Asset and T-code “S_ALR_87011963” for displaying master data for multiple assets.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>D.1) <u>Display Single Asset Master Data</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>To display the asset master data, execute SAP T-code AS03 and press “Enter”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.27204in;height:2.13103in" /></p>
<p>Insert the asset number, the sub number (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective company code as per the Assets Master Data Maintenance, press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:5.02125in;height:1.67777in" /></p>
<p>The below screen appears displaying the Asset details: -</p>
<p><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:4.65744in;height:3.72in" /></p>
<p>Under the tab “General” and in the “Capitalized on” field, the Capitalized Date can be found.</p>
<p>Ensure that asset has not already been retired by making sure that the “Deactivated on” field has been left blank.</p>
<p><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:4.65744in;height:3.72in" /></p>
<p>Verify the asset cost centre by clicking on the “Time-dependent” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image85.png" style="width:6.23958in;height:5.38542in" /></p>
<p>Then, click on “Asset Values” and verify the Asset’s NBV:</p>
<p><img src="media/image86.png" style="width:6.21254in;height:3.14882in" /></p>
<p>Then, go to the “Posted Values” tab. Compare the NBV there with the NBV in the template and ensure that both values are the same:</p>
<p><img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.92454in" /><img src="media/image89.jpg" style="width:6.22255in;height:3.63093in" /></p>
<p><strong>D.2) <u>Display Master Data for Multiple Assets</u></strong></p>
<p>Enter SAP T-code “S_ALR_87011963”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image90.png" style="width:5.32137in;height:2.03478in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D54302.89351290" /></p>
<p>Fill in the parameters including:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Input asset numbers by selecting <img src="media/image27.png" style="width:0.24238in;height:0.18765in" /> and input asset number as per template</p></li>
<li><p>Report date – input the last month end date of the last depreciation run</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation area – input a value of “01” which indicates for book depreciation</p></li>
<li><p>Sort variant - 0001</p></li>
<li><p>Select List assets</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Click on the “Execute” button or press “F8” to proceed.</p>
<p><img src="media/image91.png" style="width:4.83119in;height:3.68164in" /></p>
<p>Look for the asset number(s) from the request in the column “Asset” to identify the NBV in column “Book val.”</p>
<p><img src="media/image35.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.31806in" /></p>
<p>Click on the requisite asset / assets to view the asset details. Choose the asset and double click on the Asset number to view details.</p>
<p>Next, verify that the Asset Class and Asset’s Description match the details in the template.</p>
<p>In case of any discrepancy, send a query to the requester. Sample email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image92.png" style="width:5.125in;height:2.96875in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Send retirement request for approval</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Send the request for approval to the GFS Back Office R2R FA Team Lead. A sample email approval request as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image97.png" /></p>
<p>The GFS Back Office R2R FA Team Lead will ensure the asset retirement request has been checked by GFS Back Office R2R FA Team. This is to ensure that the transaction is complete and accurate. A sample email approval is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image100.jpeg" /></p>
<ol start="6" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retire asset in system</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all the necessary information has been verified, proceed to retire the asset via SAP T-code ABAVN:</p>
<p><img src="media/image96.png" style="width:4.6208in;height:1.62835in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.1) <u>Enter company code in system</u></strong></p>
<p>SAP automatically populates the Company Code. If it is incorrect, click on the “Change company code” button <img src="media/image99.png" style="width:1.56528in;height:0.2in" /> to change it in the pop-up window.</p>
<p><img src="media/image100.png" style="width:6.21736in;height:3.95625in" /></p>
<p>It is important to ensure that the Company Code is correct as the system allows the same asset number to be created under different company codes.</p>
<p><strong>F.2) <u>Key in Asset number</u></strong></p>
<p>For single asset retirement, key in the Asset number into the “Asset” field:</p>
<p><img src="media/image101.png" style="width:6.17361in;height:2.63472in" /></p>
<p>For multiple asset retirements, click on “Multiple Assets”. Note: This step is to be performed only in case of multiple asset retirements and below screenshot details does not match with template given above. If there are no multiple asset retirements, please move on to <strong>F.3) Key in details relating to Asset Date</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:6.19097in;height:1.59097in" /></p>
<p>There will be a place under the “List of Assets” section for the user to fill in the list of assets to be retired. After keying in the list of assets, press Enter. The assets’ descriptions will automatically populate into the table.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:6.20329in;height:4.65in" /></p>
<p>Only six assets can be keyed in at a time. After the first six assets’ descriptions have been auto-populated (by pressing Enter), scroll down to key in the next six asset numbers, if any.</p>
<p><strong>F.3) <u>Key in details relating to Asset Date</u></strong></p>
<p>In the “Transaction Data” tab, key in the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Document Date” – input the date when the item is processed</p></li>
<li><p>“Posting Date” – input the date when the item is processed</p></li>
<li><p>“Asset Value Date” – input the Asset Retirement Effective Date as per the workitem</p></li>
<li><p>“Text” – input “Asset Retirement”.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image104.png" style="width:6.17727in;height:2.78in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.4) <u>Fill in additional details</u></strong></p>
<p>In the “Additional Details” tab, key in the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Posting Period” – input the month, in numeric value, e.g. “5”</p></li>
<li><p>“Document Type” – input the type “AA”</p></li>
<li><p>“Reference” – input “company code and the date of the request”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:5.52083in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.5) <u>Simulate the posting</u></strong></p>
<p>Next, click on the Simulate button <img src="media/image106.png" style="width:0.15625in;height:0.15625in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image107.png" style="width:6.16589in;height:2.42in" /></p>
<p>After clicking on Simulate, a list of double entries will appear. Review the GL account and the amount to ensure that the simulated posting is correct:</p>
<p><img src="media/image108.png" style="width:6.30778in;height:3.77918in" /></p>
<p><strong>F.6) <u>Successful posting of the asset retirement</u></strong></p>
<p>Once posted, a notification will be shown at the bottom of the screen, e.g. “Asset transaction posted with document no. CN20 0100007120”. This indicates that the asset has been successfully retired.</p>
<p><img src="media/image109.png" style="width:6.50811in;height:4.94in" /></p>
<ol start="7" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify that asset retirement is being posted</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check if the asset is posted successfully in the system by going back to SAP T-code AS03 to display the asset master data. If successful, the asset will be updated with a Deactivation Date:</p>
<p><img src="media/image110.png" style="width:4.82293in;height:3.84751in" /></p>
<p>As for Asset Values, the NBV will now be blank to show that the asset no longer has any value. There will also be a new transaction below showing the retirement.</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:6.03396in;height:3in" /></p>
<p>To display the document details, access the SAP with the T-code FB03. Then key in the following fields and press “Enter”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Document Number – input the posting document number</p></li>
<li><p>Company Code – input the relevant company code</p></li>
<li><p>Fiscal Year – input the current year</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image112.png" style="width:6.0861in;height:2.21025in" /></p>
<p>If the retirement posting exists, the data entry view for that particular document will open as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image113.png" style="width:6.0023in;height:2.09in" /></p>
<ol start="8" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Notify the requester on request completion</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To inform the requester about the successful asset retirement transaction, send to the requester a confirmation on the successful asset retirement. A sample email confirmation is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image114.png" style="width:3.38187in;height:3.26389in" /></p>
<p><strong>Proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.10: 4.7.10 Receive confirmation that asset has been retired.</strong></p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="5">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.7</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="retire-partial-or-entire-asset-from-fixed-assets-register">Retire partial or entire asset from Fixed Assets Register</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>The process for fixed asset retirement begins when there is a need to decommission / sell / transfer / retire a fixed asset. The Business sends a request via email for asset retirement and relevant supporting documents required to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office. The request should include the following information:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company code</p></li>
<li><p>Fixed Asset Number</p></li>
<li><p>Type of Retirement</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Retirement Effective Date</p></li>
<li><p>Cost Centre as maintained in SAP</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Sample email request for asset retirement:</p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:4.85417in;height:3.88542in" /></p>
<p>GFS Back Office R2R Team will process the asset retirement in SAP by using T-code ABAVN for Scrapping and F-92 for Non-invoice retirements with Sales Proceeds.</p>
<p>Please ensure that you perform control CPX008 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<p>In case of the asset retirement by:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Scrapping, <strong>proceed to next sub-step: 8.3.3.10.7 4.7.7 A) Perform asset retirement by scrapping</strong></p></li>
<li><p>Non-invoice retirements with sales proceeds, <strong>proceed to sub-step: 8.3.3.10.7 4.7.7 B) Perform asset retirement with sales proceeds</strong></p></li>
</ul>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Perform asset retirement by scrapping</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<ol type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Retire asset in system</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all the necessary information has been verified, proceed to retire the asset via SAP T-code ABAVN:</p>
<p><img src="media/image96.png" style="width:4.6208in;height:1.62835in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Enter company code in system</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>SAP automatically populates the Company Code. If it is incorrect, click on the “Change company code” button <img src="media/image99.png" style="width:1.56528in;height:0.2in" /> to change it in the pop-up window.</p>
<p><img src="media/image100.png" style="width:6.21736in;height:3.95625in" /></p>
<p>It is important to ensure that the Company Code is correct as the system allows the same asset number to be created under different company codes.</p>
<ol start="3" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Key in Asset number</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>For single asset retirement, key in the Asset number into the “Asset” field:</p>
<p><img src="media/image101.png" style="width:6.17361in;height:2.63472in" /></p>
<p>For multiple asset retirements, click on “Multiple Assets”. Note: This step is to be performed only in case of multiple asset retirements and below screenshot details does not match with template given above. If there are no multiple asset retirements, please move on to <strong>4. Key in details relating to Asset Date</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:6.19097in;height:1.59097in" /></p>
<p>There will be a place under the “List of Assets” section for the user to fill in the list of assets to be retired. After keying in the list of assets, press Enter. The assets’ descriptions will automatically populate into the table.</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:6.20329in;height:4.65in" /></p>
<p>Only six assets can be keyed in at a time. After the first six assets’ descriptions have been auto-populated (by pressing Enter), scroll down to key in the next six asset numbers, if any.</p>
<ol start="4" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Key in details relating to Asset Date</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>In the “Transaction Data” tab, key in the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Document Date” – input the date when the item is processed</p></li>
<li><p>“Posting Date” – input the date when the item is processed</p></li>
<li><p>“Asset Value Date” – input the Asset Retirement Effective Date as per the workitem</p></li>
<li><p>“Text” – input “Asset Retirement”.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image104.png" style="width:6.17727in;height:2.78in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Fill in additional details</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>In the “Additional Details” tab, key in the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Posting Period” – input the month, in numeric value, e.g. “5”</p></li>
<li><p>“Document Type” – input the type “AA”</p></li>
<li><p>“Reference” – input “company code and the date of the request”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:5.52083in" /></p>
<p>If requestor fills up ‘Amount of Retirement’ or ‘% of Retirement’ fields in the template, go to Partial retirement tab in SAP to input the partial amount posted or percentage rate.</p>
<p>Note: This step is to be performed only in case of partial retirement. Also, the below screenshot amount does not match with the template given above.</p>
<p><img src="media/image116.png" style="width:6.192in;height:4.08in" /></p>
<ol start="6" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Simulate the posting</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Next, click on the Simulate button <img src="media/image106.png" style="width:0.15625in;height:0.15625in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image107.png" style="width:6.16589in;height:2.42in" /></p>
<p>After clicking on Simulate, a list of double entries will appear. Review the GL account and the amount to ensure that the simulated posting is correct:</p>
<p><img src="media/image108.png" style="width:6.57297in;height:3.93806in" /></p>
<p><strong>Note </strong>that in case of partial retirement, the values will change and will sync with the partial retirement values. Once satisfied with the double entries, click on the “Save” icon to post the transaction.</p>
<ol start="7" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Successful posting of the asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once posted, a notification will be shown at the bottom of the screen, e.g. “Asset transaction posted with document no. CN20 0100007120”. This indicates that the asset has been successfully retired.</p>
<p><img src="media/image109.png" style="width:6.50811in;height:4.94in" /></p>
<p>Similar process needs to be followed for other asset retirements (e.g. 1600642 in the steps above) under same category of retirement.</p>
<ol start="8" type="1">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify that asset retirement is posted successfully</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check if the asset is posted successfully by going back to SAP T-code AS03 to display the asset master data. If successful, the asset will have been updated with a Deactivation Date. Click on the “Asset values” button:</p>
<p><img src="media/image110.png" style="width:4.82293in;height:3.84751in" /></p>
<p>The “Net book value” will now show as blank, indicating that the asset no longer has any value. There will also be a new transaction below showing the retirement.</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:6.61083in;height:3.28681in" /></p>
<p>To display the document details access T-code FB03.</p>
<p><img src="media/image117.png" style="width:5.23611in;height:1.53467in" /></p>
<p>Key in the Document Number, Company Code and Fiscal Year, then press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image112.png" style="width:6.50417in;height:2.06944in" /></p>
<p>The document will be shown as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image113.png" style="width:6.0023in;height:2.09in" /></p>
<p>Proceed to <strong>sub step C) Notify the requester on request completion</strong></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Perform asset retirement with sales proceeds</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all information has been verified, proceed to retire the asset via SAP T-code F-92:</p>
<p><img src="media/image118.png" style="width:6.13889in;height:1.62639in" /></p>
<p>Key in the following details to retire the asset:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Document Date” – input the current date</p></li>
<li><p>“Posting Date” – input the current date</p></li>
<li><p>“Type” – input type “AA”</p></li>
<li><p>“Period” – input the current month in numeric value, e.g. “5”</p></li>
<li><p>“Company Code” – input the relevant Company Code</p></li>
<li><p>“Currency/Rate” – input the currency relevant to the request</p></li>
<li><p>“Reference” – input company code and the date of the request</p></li>
<li><p>“Doc.Header Text” – input the company code, followed by the text “Asset Retirement”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image120.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:3.46111in" /></p>
<p>The posting key for debiting GL Account is “40”. Hence in the “Next Line Item” section, enter the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“PstKy” – input “40”</p></li>
<li><p>“Account” – input the GL Account. The GL number should be provided by the requester in the NewGen workitem. Alternatively, access the appropriate number through the Single Chart of Account (SCOA) by following this <a href="https://apps.azcollaboration.com/finance/Finance/Scoagle/SitePages/Home.aspx">link</a>. Note: Please only use Internet Explorer for accessing the link.</p></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>Alternatively, check with the GFS Back Office C2C Cash and Banking Team if the amount has been paid in, and which bank’s clearing account to debit from.</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="media/image121.png" style="width:6.17361in;height:1.06944in" /></p>
<p>There are instances where the sales proceeds from the asset retirements are not paid by a customer, but instead deducted from the employee(s) salary and wages account, or vendor account:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Deduction from employee(s) salary and wages account happens when the asset in question is being retired due to it being lost/damaged by an employee. As such, it is then the employee’s responsibility to bear the cost of the unusable asset. Hence, the “Account” field should be the GL code of the “Employee Salary and Wages” account or the “SAP Customer field” could be the “Employee code”.</p></li>
<li><p>If it is a deduction from a vendor account, the posting key of “21” would be used to debit the respective Vendor code. The “SAP Customer” field should be the vendor code as per template input.</p></li>
</ul>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Notify the requester on request completion</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Refer to the <strong>sub-step 8.3.3.10.6: 4.7.6 G) Notify the requester on request completion</strong> for steps on how to notify the requester on request completion.</p>
<p><strong>Proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.10: 4.7.10 Receive confirmation that asset has been retired</strong>.</p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Perform Mass Asset retirement (by preparing and releasing worklist)</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>D.1) <u>Create Worklist for assets to be retired</u></strong></p>
<p>Enter T-code “S_ALR_87011990” in SAP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image122.png" style="width:5.09514in;height:2.3913in" alt="cid:image001.png@01D547B6.D9F72390" /></p>
<p>Enter the following fields in the below screen:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Company Code: Company code of company for which Asset is to be retired</p></li>
<li><p>Asset Number: Assets to be retired</p></li>
<li><p>Report Date: Date of period close</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation Area: As mentioned in Asset details</p></li>
<li><p>Sort Variant: As mentioned in Asset details</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Choose List Assets in the below screenshot and click on Execute <img src="media/image28.png" style="width:0.23958in;height:0.20833in" />:</p>
<p>Please note that the example below is for illustrative purpose only and doesn’t match with the templates above.</p>
<p><img src="media/image123.png" style="width:5.65545in;height:4.43586in" /></p>
<p>Go to Edit&gt; Worklist&gt; Create to create a worklist of the Asset details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image124.png" style="width:6.15549in;height:3.69565in" /></p>
<p>A dialogue box will appear to create worklist. Name the worklist and select “Retirement without Revenue” in Task Selection as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image125.png" style="width:5.89565in;height:3.67778in" /></p>
<p>Another dialogue box will appear to fill in the details for retirement. Fill in the details and click on green tick as shown below:</p>
<p>Posting Date: input current date</p>
<p>Document date: input current date</p>
<p>Transaction type: 200 Retirement without revenue</p>
<p>Asset Value date: Please input the retirement effective date as stated in the form</p>
<p><img src="media/image126.png" style="width:6.09565in;height:3.70435in" /></p>
<p>Message of Successful creation of Work Queue will pop up. Make a note of the Worklist Number:</p>
<p><img src="media/image127.png" style="width:5.97361in;height:3.16503in" /></p>
<p><strong>D.2) <u>Release the worklist</u></strong></p>
<p>Enter T-code “AR31” in SAP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image128.png" style="width:4.66944in;height:3.29565in" alt="cid:image002.png@01D546E6.30D05640" /></p>
<p>Press Enter and fill in the details as mentioned below and press execute <img src="media/image129.png" style="width:0.26042in;height:0.27083in" /> button:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Date: Date up to which the report needs to be extracted</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation Area: Report Basis of depreciation required in report</p></li>
<li><p>Sort Variant: Will vary as per worklist</p></li>
<li></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image130.png" style="width:5.09434in;height:2.26458in" /></p>
<p>The below screen will appear showing retirement details. Please cross check and ensure that the NBV and the number of assets with the Assets Retirement Request Template are correct. Click on “Release” to release the worklist:</p>
<p><img src="media/image131.png" style="width:5.34783in;height:2.6087in" /></p>
<p>The below dialogue box will appear confirming retirement has been released:</p>
<p><img src="media/image132.png" style="width:6.24306in;height:3.73913in" /></p>
<p>The assets have been retired on releasing the work queue.</p>
<p><strong>Proceed to step 8.3.3.10.10: 4.7.10 Receive confirmation that asset has been retired</strong>.</p></td>
<td></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.8</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="retire-entire-asset-for-an-invoice-sale">Retire entire asset for an invoice sale</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>GFS Back Office R2R will be notified once the sale of asset has been completed and will then account for the profit &amp; loss on the disposal of the asset. Sales proceeds must be entered into an asset disposal transaction. If the proceeds from the sale relate to more than one asset, the proceeds will be distributed across each of the individual assets in the sale. If the disposed asset does not exist in the asset register, the asset cannot be retired. The entire asset will now be retired from FA register. The purchase and sale of fixed assets is executed at fair market valuation.</p>
<p>Please ensure that you perform control CPX008 as per the FCAS framework for your unit.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retrieve template from Email request</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Refer to the <strong>step 8.3.3.10.6: 4.7.6 A) Retrieve template from Email request</strong> for steps on how to retrieve the request.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify approver against Global DOA</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Refer to the <strong>step 8.3.3.10.6: 4.7.6 C) Verify approver against Global DOA</strong> for guidelines on the checks to be performed.</p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Validate information in the Assets Retirement Request Template</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Refer to the <strong>step 8.3.3.10.6: 4.7.6 D) Validate information in the Assets Retirement Request Template</strong> for steps on how to perform the validation.</p>
<p>Please note the below example is just for illustrative purpose. It doesn’t tie back to templates given in Step 4.7.2 Complete Asset Retirement Form.</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.15069in" /><img src="media/image134.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:1.69097in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image135.png" style="width:6.17718in;height:1.59212in" /></p>
<p>Additionally, verify the customer information using SAP T-code XD03 to display the customer details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image136.png" style="width:6.20138in;height:1.47533in" /></p>
<p>Enter the relevant “Customer” code and the “Company code”. Click on the green check icon to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image137.png" style="width:4.73803in;height:3.04571in" /></p>
<p>Check the Customer Name and details:</p>
<p><img src="media/image138.png" style="width:6.12566in;height:4.02544in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Retire the asset</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once all information has been verified, proceed to retire the asset via SAP T-code F-92:</p>
<p><img src="media/image118.png" style="width:6.14237in;height:1.62519in" /></p>
<p>In the “Transaction Data” tab, key in the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Document Date” – input the current date</p></li>
<li><p>“Posting Date” – input the current date</p></li>
<li><p>“Type” – input the value “AA”</p></li>
<li><p>“Period” – input the current month in numeric value, e.g. “5”</p></li>
<li><p>“Company Code” – input the relevant company code</p></li>
<li><p>“Currency/Rate” – input the currency relevant to the request.</p></li>
<li><p>“Reference” – input the company code and the date of the request</p></li>
<li><p>“Doc.Header Text” – input th e Company code, followed by the text “Asset Retirement”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.26712in;height:0.12848in" /><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.26804in;height:0.12866in" /><img src="media/image139.png" style="width:0.90506in;height:0.13256in" /><img src="media/image140.png" style="width:6.54167in;height:2.60625in" /></p>
<p>The posting key for debiting the customer code is “01”. Hence in the “First Line Item” section, enter the following:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“PstKy” – input “01”</p></li>
<li><p>“Account” – input the relevant Customer code</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Press “Enter” to continue:</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.18307in" /><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.18307in" /><img src="media/image141.png" style="width:6.09725in;height:3.44233in" /></p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Input details of sales proceed</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Key in the following details according to the Assets Retirement Request Template:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Amount” – input the sales proceed amount, as per the request.</p></li>
<li><p>Check the “Calculate Tax” box if applicable</p></li>
<li><p>“Tax Code” – input the relevant tax code if applicable</p></li>
<li><p>“Payt Terms” – input the relevant payment terms</p></li>
<li><p>“Bline Date” – input posting date</p></li>
<li><p>“Assignment” – input the company code and the date of the request</p></li>
<li><p>“Text” – input the Company Code followed by the text “Asset Retirement with Revenue”</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image142.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:4.62292in" /></p>
<p>For the double entry line items, input the necessary:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“PstKy” – input either “40” for debit and “50” for credit</p></li>
<li><p>“Account” – input the relevant Account GL number</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image143.png" style="width:6.37118in;height:1.07783in" /></p>
<ol start="6" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Input details of next line item</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Key in the following fields and press “Enter”:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>“Amount” – input the sales proceed amount</p></li>
<li><p>“Tax Code” – this field will auto-populate with tax code details from Line Item 1</p></li>
<li><p>“Cost Center” – input the relevant cost centre code</p></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><p>“Assignment” – input the company code and the date of the request</p></li>
<li><p>“Text” – input the Company Code followed by the text “Asset Retirement with Revenue”</p></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><p>Check the “Asst retirement” checkbox</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image144.png" style="width:6.54375in;height:4.28611in" /></p>
<ol start="7" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Complete asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>A “Create Asset Retirement” pop-up window will appear as pictured below.</p>
<p>Enter the asset number to be retired in the “Asset” field. Check that in the “Transaction Type” field contains a value of “210” and that the “Asset Value Date” field reflects the Asset Retirement Effective date as per the request template.</p>
<p>Once done, tick the field “Complete retirement” and click on the green tick to continue.</p>
<p><img src="media/image145.png" style="width:0.89583in;height:0.16667in" /><img src="media/image146.png" style="width:6.33972in;height:3.46824in" /></p>
<ol start="8" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Go back to the posting page shown below. On the top left of the page, select “Document” and click “Simulate” (or Shift +F9).</p>
<p><img src="media/image147.jpg" style="width:5.74095in;height:1.79167in" /></p>
<ol start="9" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify and agree entries</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Ensure that both debit and credit entries are equal and have zero variance.</p>
<p><img src="media/image148.png" style="width:0.88503in;height:0.11944in" /><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.22152in;height:0.10633in" /><img src="media/image149.png" style="width:4.57467in;height:3.88in" /></p>
<ol start="10" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Post document</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Once complete, click the “Save” icon located at the top of the page to post the document.</p>
<p><img src="media/image148.png" style="width:0.88503in;height:0.11944in" /><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.22152in;height:0.10633in" /><img src="media/image150.png" style="width:4.75469in;height:4.52in" /></p>
<p>If the asset retirement has been posted successfully, a notification will appear at the bottom of the page, e.g. “Document 100000079 was posted in company code CN20”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image151.png" style="width:0.20139in" /><img src="media/image151.png" style="width:0.20139in" /><img src="media/image152.png" style="width:6.13958in;height:5.27222in" /></p>
<ol start="11" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify that the system has captured the asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To ensure that system has been updated with the asset retirement, go back to SAP T-code AS03 to verify in the asset master data display that field “Deactivation Date” is populated with the posting date.</p>
<p><img src="media/image153.png" style="width:6.449in;height:3.68974in" /></p>
<ol start="12" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify Net Book Value</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Click on the “Asset Values” button to verify the net book value:</p>
<p><img src="media/image154.png" style="width:4.17708in;height:1.66667in" /></p>
<p>The “Net Book Value” field should be empty and there should be a new transaction line item to reflect the retirement as pictured below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.18308in" /><img src="media/image155.png" style="width:6.48109in;height:3.06in" /></p>
<ol start="13" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Verify posting</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>To display the document details, access the T-code FB03, by entering the relevant information in the fields “Document Number”, “Company Code” and “Fiscal Year”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.26736in;height:0.12833in" /><img src="media/image156.png" style="width:6.36458in;height:3in" /></p>
<p>Once entered, the document will be shown as follows:</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.18308in" /><img src="media/image157.png" style="width:6.49862in;height:3.02in" /></p>
<p>Another alternative way to verify the asset retirement posting is to double click on the transaction when displaying the asset value. The same result as above screenshot can be displayed.</p>
<ol start="14" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Notify the requester on request completion</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Refer to the <strong>step 8.3.3.10.6: 4.7.6 G) Notify the requester on request completion</strong> for steps on how to notify the requester on request completion.</p>
<p>Send a request for invoice creation to the GFS Back Office C2C Cash and Banking Team<strong>. Proceed to the step 8.3.3.10.9: 4.7.9 Create and transmit customer invoice</strong> for the relevant steps.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.9</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="create-and-transmit-customer-invoice">Create and transmit customer invoice</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>GFS Back Office R2R will be notified once the sale of asset has been completed and the profit &amp; loss on the disposal of the asset has been posted. If GFS Middle Office submitted the request on behalf of Embedded Finance, then GFS Middle Office needs to be notified once the sale of asset</p>
<p>has been completed. Once notified, GFS Back Office R2R will create a customer invoice and email to their Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office directly.</p>
<p><strong>Note</strong> that this activity is performed by Embedded Finance for India GTC (Global Technology Centre) and the Logistics team for India Commercial and Operations.</p>
<p><strong><u>Manual invoice to be created for asset sale</u></strong></p>
<p>GFS Back Office R2R proceeds to create and transmit customer invoice.</p>
<p>Sample invoice is given below for reference:</p>
<p><img src="media/image158.png" style="width:4.28008in;height:2.17978in" /></p>
<p>GFS Back office R2R notifies the requestor by email that the request is complete on creation of the invoice and invoice is shared in PDF format.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 14%" />
<col style="width: 9%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.10.10</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="receive-confirmation-that-asset-has-been-retired">Receive confirmation that asset has been retired</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Once the request is complete, notify Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office that the asset master data amendment by GFS Back Office DMT or the retirement of the asset by GFS Back Office R2R is complete.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Receive asset retirement notification</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>An email confirmation of the asset retirement will be sent to the requester once GFS Back Office DMT or GFS Back Office R2R close the request.</p>
<p><img src="media/image159.jpeg" style="width:6.54375in;height:2.73264in" alt="cid:image003.jpg@01D5A8FD.C798CD90" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Confirm asset retirement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Check in SAP to see if the retirement is complete. To display the asset master data log into SAP and execute SAP T-code “AS03”. Next, fill in the ‘Asset’ number, the “Subnumber” (enter “0” if not applicable) and the respective “Company Code”.</p>
<p>Then, click on “Asset values”:</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.42969in;height:0.19359in" /><img src="media/image145.png" style="width:1.29523in;height:0.17089in" /><img src="media/image160.png" style="width:5.01042in;height:3.09375in" /></p>
<p>The following screen will appear. An asset retirement will be indicated there.</p>
<p><img src="media/image133.png" style="width:0.16643in" /><img src="media/image155.png" style="width:6.48109in;height:3.06in" /></p>
<p>Upon confirmation of the asset retirement in SAP, inform the Business via email.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

# RESPONSIBILITIES

## Roles and Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Role / Team Name | Description |
| Business | Refers to the respective Business end users who are responsible for requesting for asset retirements |
| Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office | Refers to the relevant in-country/in-unit contacts or Middle Office teams who are involved in asset retirements and facilitate / approve a retirement request |
| GFS Back Office R2R | Refers to the GFS Back Office R2R Fixed Assets team that would process an asset retirement and transfers within the same legal entities with asset class change |
| GFS Back Office DMT | Refers to the GFS Back Office DMT team that would process transfers within the same legal entities without asset class change |

# GLOSSARY

The table below contains the definition of all terms, acronyms and abbreviations required to properly interpret this document:

| **Terms** | **Definition**                                             |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| ABAON     | SAP T-code to record multiple Asset retirement             |
| ABUMN     | SAP T-code for transfer of fixed asset within legal entity |
| ABAVN     | SAP T-code to retire Asset                                 |
| AB08      | SAP T-code to reverse line items                           |
| AR31      | SAP T-code to edit worklist                                |
| AS02      | SAP T-code to change asset master data                     |
| AS03      | SAP T-code to display asset master data                    |
| AUC       | Assets Under Construction                                  |

| **Terms** | **Definition** |
|----|----|
| AZ | AstraZeneca |
| DMT | Data Management Team |
| DOA | Delegation of Authority |
| FA | Fixed Asset |
| F-22 | SAP T-code to create customer invoice |
| F-92 | SAP T-code to retire asset from sale |
| FB03 | SAP T-code to display document initial screen |
| FCAS | Financial Controls and Assurance System |
| FCF | Financial Controlling Framework |
| GFS | Global Finance Services |
| GUI | Graphical User Interface |
| ISR | Internal Service Request |
| N/A | Not applicable |
| NBV | Net Book Value |
| NTI | Non-Trade Invoice |
| R2R | Record to Report |

# Appendices

## **SAP T-code ABAON**

SAP T-code ABAON has the option to perform multiple asset retirement for asset sale without customer.

**ABAON** – The posting is mapped to a Balance Sheet GL when “Rev. from NBV” is selected, however when “Manual Revenue” selected, then the amount gets posted into the Balance sheet GL and the balance amount into P&L.

- Select “Rev. from NBV” as shown in below screenshot:

<img src="media/image161.jpeg" style="width:5.45198in;height:2.64873in" alt="cid:image015.jpg@01D50AB5.AF3CBF90" />

Below screen pops up on selecting “Rev. from NBV” and posting gets mapped to a Balance Sheet GL:

<img src="media/image162.jpeg" style="width:5.64873in;height:2.50749in" alt="cid:image016.jpg@01D50AB5.AF3CBF90" />

- Select “Manual Revenue” as shown in below screen shot:

<img src="media/image163.jpeg" style="width:5.70176in;height:3.12699in" alt="cid:image017.jpg@01D50AB5.AF3CBF90" />

Below Screen pops up on selecting “When “Manual Revenue” and the amount gets posted into Balance Sheet GL and balance amount is posted into P&L:

<img src="media/image164.jpeg" style="width:6.69086in;height:3.28351in" alt="cid:image018.jpg@01D50AB5.AF3CBF90" />

<p>Embedded Finance will be notified once the sale of asset has been completed and the profit &amp; loss on the disposal of the asset has been posted. If GFS Middle Office submitted the request on behalf of Embedded Finance, then GFS Middle Office needs to be notified once the sale of asset has been completed. Upon request, if a customer invoice is needed, GFS Back Office R2R will create a customer invoice and email to their Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office directly.</p>

- GFS Back Office R2R will be notified once the sale of asset has been completed and will then account for the profit & loss on the disposal of the asset. Sales proceeds must be entered into an asset disposal transaction. If the proceeds from the sale relate to more than one asset, the proceeds will be distributed across each of the individual assets in the sale. If the disposed asset does not exist in the asset register, the asset cannot be retired. The entire asset will now be retired from FA register. The purchase and sale of fixed assets is executed at fair market valuation.

# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for the expenses and transactions (such as PO, T&E, Materials, etc.) booked against project codes by the business once the project has been set up. This process also covers the updating of the CAPEX report which is used to track all open projects both major and minor in terms of authorisation and spending amount.

The report also tracks the AUC status of projects pending capitalisation which require inputs from Embedded Finance.

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Business, GFS Middle Office, GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets) and Embedded Finance.

# SCOPE

The table indicates the scope of this SOP a summary of the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded:

|                  |                                               |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
| Business Process | Description                                   |
| Global           | This process is applicable to all AZ entities |

Note: Steps **4.7.7 and 4.7.8** are not applicable to Brazil as it will continue to follow the current process until the configuration activities are completed by SAP IT team.

- This transition will be managed internally by **Mayra Silva (Genpact)** for both organizations (GFS Back Office DMT and GFS Back Office R2R)

- The Documentation Team will be performing the updates on receipt of information

## 4.2 Assumptions and Prerequisites

The table below contains a summary of the assumptions and pre-requisites required for the process this operating procedure relates to:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Assumption / Prerequisite | Description |
| Relevant transactions for the month have been posted | Transactions related to respective project codes have been posted in SAP |

## Frequency

This process is performed on ad-hoc basis and when project related transactions happen, however the month–end reporting happens on a monthly basis.

## Controls

| Control Id / Name | Control Type | Control Objective | Control Owner |
| CPX003 | FCF | What controls exist to ensure that cost overruns (exceeding 110%) are appropriately approved (before expenditure is incurred)? | Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office |
| CPX004 | FCF | What controls exist to ensure only valid expenses are capitalised, and that capex is completely and accurately recorded? (also known as CAPEX3) | Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office |

<u>Note:</u> The control objective defines the risk that needs to be addressed by the control. For the definition and for detailed information on the control operated for your unit, please refer to [FCAS](http://seskwfcswbp01.emea.astrazeneca.net/) for your unit.

For NAM, both control CPX003 and CPX004 are operated by GFS Back Office R2R team, on behalf of Embedded Finance and GFS Middle Office (Capital Team).

<td colspan="5">Direct materials used for project related activities must be monitored and recorded to the specific project. For example, for R&amp;D projects, materials could be issued as part of R&amp;D work.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td><strong>8.4.2.2.3</strong></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>

<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>

<td colspan="5">Time expenses related to the execution of project are recorded in Cross Application Time Sheet (CATS) in UK and Sweden only and through normal payroll in other regions.</td>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />

<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />

<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.2.4</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="post-te-expenses">Post T&amp;E expenses</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>T&amp;E expenses linked to projects must be recorded to underlying project.</p>
<p>(Note: T&amp;E expenses come via concur and can be posted as long as the postings come with the WBSE code)</p></td>
</tr>
