<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.2.5</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="review-expenses-posted-to-the-project">Review expenses posted to the project</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office reviews and validates the expenses for completeness, accuracy and propriety, if applicable, to ensure all project expenditures are captured:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Salary expenses related to the execution of project</p></li>
<li><p>Time expenses recorded</p></li>
<li><p>Material costs and quantity</p></li>
<li><p>T&amp;E report is validated and analysed to determine completeness, accuracy and propriety of expenses</p></li>
</ul>
<p>After the review and validation, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office sends review request to the project managers. The Project Manager reviews to ensure that all expenses posted to the project are valid. Costs that are not directly associated with the project should not be posted to the project code. For capital projects, all expenses will be capitalised monthly and whenever the asset is ready to be brought into service.</p>
<p>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office must determine if adjustments will be required in the recorded project related transactions.</p>
<p>Please ensure to perform control CPX004 as per the FCAS framework for the respective unit.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Review expenses posted to the project</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Pre-month end closing activities may identify project related costs that are incorrectly posted to site costs. This should be picked up during site cost review performed in Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office and is later queried with the local site finance team or capital projects team. Sample query:</p>
<p><img src="media/image2.png" style="width:6.43282in;height:1.79275in" /></p>
<p>Sample query is shown below (PO 4800059428):</p>
<p><img src="media/image3.png" style="width:6.36603in;height:1.2996in" /></p>
<p>Sample query is shown below (PO 4800059823):</p>
<p><img src="media/image4.png" style="width:6.31353in;height:1.38009in" /></p>
<p>Embedded finance and the Project Manager review these queries and confirm back to GFS Middle Office, if any adjustment is required.</p>
<p><img src="media/image5.png" style="width:6.33374in;height:1.83345in" /></p>
<p><strong><u>Representative Offices</u></strong></p>
<p>Representative offices located in MEA and Europe will need to follow below steps to record Fixed Asset posting in UK or Sweden Hubs book.</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Request a capital project via CAS, please proceed to <strong>8.4.1.3 Review and approve capital projects</strong> for details.</p></li>
<li><p>Upon invoice on purchase of Fixed Asset posted, a journal entry will need to be passed in Hubs book. Please proceed to <strong>Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.2.6 Prepare manual adjustments.</strong></p></li>
<li><p>For Sweden, journal entry will need to be posted with GL 99100010 with WBSE and subsequently settle into AUC via 99101090 (For UK – Accounts are 70770150 and 70770160 respectively)</p></li>
<li><p>Subsequent to settlement, Middle Office Finance will need to send in Notice of Project Closure Template (NPC) to capitalise the Fixed Asset in UK or Sweden Hubs book. Please proceed to <strong>Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.4 Close and capitalise projects</strong> for details.</p></li>
</ol>
<p><strong><u>Possible outcomes:</u></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p>In case adjustment is required, then <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.2.6 Prepare manual adjustments</strong></p></li>
<li><p>In case adjustment is not required, and</p>
<ul>
<li><p>WBSE is not statistical, then <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.7: 8.4.2.2.7 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)</strong></p></li>
<li><p>WBSE is statistical, then go <strong>proceed Step 4.7.8: 8.4.2.2.8 Prepare month-end reports</strong></p></li>
</ul></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.2.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="prepare-manual-adjustments">Prepare manual adjustments</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Business, GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>If adjustment is required, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office prepare the related manual journal templates for processing and raise them in their workflow tool.</p>
<p><strong>Prepare manual adjustments</strong></p>
<p>The adjustment for costs can be various. Among the examples (list is not exhaustive) are:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Accruing capital costs</p></li>
<li><p>Adjusting from site costs to AUC cost line</p></li>
<li><p>Reclassifying costs from one project to another</p></li>
<li><p>Recharging payroll costs to the project where individuals are part / full-time on a project</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Please proceed to 8.3.2.2 Process Manual Journal Entries</strong> for further details on how the journal entry is submitted, approved and posted.</p>
<p>Once the adjustment review is complete, please <strong>proceed to step 4.7.7:8.4.2.2.7 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)</strong> for a non-statistical WBSE. For a statistical WBSE, please <strong>proceed to step 4.7.8:8.4.2.2.8 Prepare month-end reports</strong>.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.2.7</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="perform-monthly-settlement-clearing-wbse-to-auc">Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets)</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets)</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p><strong>Note:</strong> This step is not applicable to Brazil as it will continue to follow the current process until the configuration activities are completed by SAP IT team.</p>
<p>Once all project related transactions are raised, validated and posted, GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets) proceeds with the monthly settlement clearing for capital project WBSE to transfer charges against WBSE to the AUC accounts. This occurs via a settlement rule created against the WBSE in the project structure. This is an important control point as costs on all capital projects are zeroed at month-end.</p>
<p>Prior to the fixed asset module closing at each month end, run T-code CJ88 (Individual WBS Settlement) / CJ8G (Mass month end WBS settlement) to settle (transfer) WBSE element costs into the corresponding AUC.</p>
<p>Please note that for NAM, due to large WBSE transaction volumes to AUC, a settlement background job is scheduled on daily basis at 23:00 US time with additional manual settlement during month-end.</p>
<p>Please find below process steps to run CJ88 for individual WBS settlement and CJ8G for mass month-end settlement.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Individual WBS settlement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image6.png" style="width:6.32292in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p><strong>A.1) <u>Test run monthly settlement</u></strong></p>
<p>To run settlement of actual WBSE costs enter T-code CJ88 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image7.png" style="width:5.18441in;height:2.45982in" /></p>
<p>Key in WBS Element Number and execute in the present period.</p>
<p>Execute <img src="media/image8.png" style="width:0.20833in;height:0.22917in" /> as Test Run to check for any error.</p>
<p><img src="media/image9.png" style="width:4.10357in;height:3.68312in" /></p>
<p>The Settlement screen will appear as below.</p>
<p>Click on detail list icon on the left corner to see the settled cost for AUC and asset number.</p>
<p><img src="media/image10.png" style="width:5.5339in;height:4.10211in" /></p>
<p>Ensure processing is complete without any errors and there is settlement executed, which reflects in the above screenshot as highlighted.</p>
<p>After clicking on the detail list, the screen will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image11.png" style="width:4.85808in;height:1.53704in" /></p>
<p>In case the processing remains incomplete due to errors, a screen like below will appear. Double click on the error message to display the error messages.</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:4.51304in;height:3.26956in" /></p>
<p>Below is an indicative list of errors commonly observed in CJ88 (list is not exhaustive) and the actions to be taken to resolve them:</p>
<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 18%" />
<col style="width: 27%" />
<col style="width: 54%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center;"><strong>Error Type</strong></th>
<th style="text-align: center;"><strong>Reason</strong></th>
<th style="text-align: center;"><strong>Action</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">Yellow</td>
<td>There are remaining balances in AUC</td>
<td>No action is needed. This error will reflect in partial completion of Capitalisation. It can be processed as usual.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;">Red</td>
<td>The settlement amount exceeds the AUC Balances</td>
<td>Check the AUC amount in CJI3 with the capitalisation amount. If there is a variance, check the errors and rectify the same.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Re-run the processing until all errors are resolved and processing is successful.</p>
<p><strong>A.2) <u>Run actual monthly settlement</u></strong></p>
<p>After ensuring the settlement runs correctly without errors, go back to the previous page (Press F3). This time untick Test Run and proceed to Execute <img src="media/image8.png" style="width:0.20833in;height:0.22917in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:4.52938in;height:4.09226in" /></p>
<p>The result after the actual run will be as follows:</p>
<p><img src="media/image14.png" style="width:5.63141in;height:4.17305in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>A.3) <u>Check settlement run results</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>CJ88 will move costs from WBSE to AUC by triggering the following entry:</p>
<p>Debit AUC GL Asset Under Construction / AICC / AUC</p>
<p>Credit Capital project settlement</p>
<p>After settlement, check that 99101090 and 99100010 combination nets off to zero. This can be examined via CJI3 or F.01</p>
<p><strong>Note</strong>: Instead of the above GLs, ICON UK2 uses group of GLs / 70390120.</p>
<p><u>Option 1</u>: CJI3 – Display the WBSE actual costs by line items.</p>
<p>For steps to use CJI3, refer to <strong>Step 8.4.2.2.8: 4.7.8 Prepare month end reports</strong>.</p>
<p><img src="media/image15.png" style="width:5.54981in;height:1.90315in" /></p>
<p><u>Option 2:</u> F.01 – Display Financial Statement.</p>
<p>Enter SAP T-code F.01 and press Enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:3.97228in;height:1.87289in" /></p>
<p>The below screen appears. Fill in the required details as mentioned below and press <img src="media/image17.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /> execute.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Chart of Accounts: “SCOA”</p></li>
<li><p>G/L Account: “99100010 to 99101090”</p></li>
<li><p>Company Code: Relevant Company code for which report is being extracted</p></li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>Click on further selections tab and enter the details for which report is required, comparison periods.</p>
</blockquote>
<p>Click on “ALV grid control” in List output and click on execute <img src="media/image17.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /> button.</p>
<p><img src="media/image18.png" style="width:6.25in;height:4.51042in" /></p>
<p>This will generate the report, as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.23043in;height:2.22054in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>A.4) <u>Check settlement posting to GL</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Note: This option is not applicable for UK, as UK has more than 20 cost elements where other posting without WBSE is possible, hence F.01 will not net off to zero.</p>
<p>Also, check that settlement is posted into correct AUC GL. This can be examined via T-code FBL3N displaying G/L Account Line Items:</p>
<p>Enter T-code FBL3N in SAP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:5.8in;height:2.12153in" alt="cid:image003.png@01D54D36.A94DD240" /></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Enter the following fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Key in Company Code</p></li>
<li><p>Key in G/L account: 99100010 and 99101090</p></li>
<li><p>Click on green tick and then execute by clicking on execute icon or press F8.</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image21.png" style="width:6.27014in;height:4.01597in" /></p>
<p>Check “Offset.acct” column to ensure the settlement has been posted into AUC GL – 12XXXXXX.</p>
<p><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:6.27014in;height:1.31111in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Mass month end WBS settlement</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter SAP T-code CJ8G in below screen:</p>
<p><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:3.51304in;height:1.18261in" /></p>
<p>Below screen will appear:</p>
<p><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:6.0709in;height:4.58378in" /></p>
<p>To change the Controlling Area, click on “Extras” in the Menu Bar and select Set Controlling Area as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image25.png" style="width:5.72627in;height:3.1427in" /></p>
<p>Below screen will appear. Click the icon as shown below to get the list of controlling areas as per the relevant country.</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:4.70265in;height:3.47706in" /></p>
<p>Select the controlling area as required.</p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:4.46847in;height:3.46223in" /></p>
<p>Click the green tick button <img src="media/image28.png" style="width:0.2087in;height:0.21875in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:5.67708in;height:3.07844in" /></p>
<p>Click on Selection Variant icon as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image30.png" style="width:5.43481in;height:3.55149in" /></p>
<p>Choose the required variant from the list as shown below:</p>
<p>For APAC, UK and Sweden : Choose Variant “Projects-all projects”</p>
<p>For NAM : Choose Variant “PS.CPRJSE.ALL-ALL Co Codes C Proj settlement”</p>
<p>For LATAM : Choose Variant “ALL MEXICO” and “ALL ARGENTINA”</p>
<p>For Europe Science and Operations : “ALL INDIA” and “ALL EGYPT”</p>
<p>NAM</p>
<p>APAC, UK &amp; SE</p>
<p>EU Science &amp; Operations</p>
<p>LATAM</p>
<p>Key in the Settlement and posting period, fiscal year and choose processing type “automatic type”. Please ensure “Test run”, “Detail list” &amp; “Check. Trans data” should be ticked in Processing Options box. Then click the pencil icon to check the variant parameter.</p>
<p>If need to run in background, then tick “Background Processing”, then click the pencil icon to check the variant parameter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image35.png" style="width:5.92708in;height:3.05208in" /></p>
<p>For single project selection, click on the “pencil icon” and input specific WBS element under “Select Single Values”.</p>
<p>Further on the same screen, select single value E* (all E capital projects) and C* (old C project) click on “Select Ranges” tab and key in “00000 to 29999” (old projects) and click execute <img src="media/image17.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /> button.</p>
<p><img src="media/image36.png" style="width:3.57051in;height:1.70151in" /><img src="media/image37.png" style="width:4.59186in;height:2.29398in" /></p>
<p>The screen below will appear, now click on dynamic icon on the left of the screen as highlighted below and input the Project number:</p>
<p>Key in company code which needs to be included or excluded, if any.</p>
<p><img src="media/image38.png" style="width:5.83543in;height:2.95859in" /></p>
<p><u>Note:</u> If extracting the data for UK only, exclude the data for UK40, UK46 and UK47 as these company codes are for UK MEDI. To exclude multiple company codes, click on the right arrow icon in above screen and enter the company codes in “Exclude Single Values tab”. Eg. For UK key in UK40,UK46 and UK47 and click on execute <img src="media/image39.png" style="width:0.16662in;height:0.17704in" /> icon.</p>
<p><img src="media/image40.png" style="width:4.42693in;height:2.27921in" /></p>
<p>Click F9 to check CJ8G in “Background Processing”.</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Key in “LOCL Generic Frontend Printing” in the output device field.</p></li>
<li><p>Key in Page 1 until 10000000 in page icon.</p></li>
<li><p>Choose “Immediately” in Print time drop-down.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Then click on green tick. SAP will run in background.</p>
<p><img src="media/image41.png" style="width:2.98261in;height:2.7913in" /></p>
<p><strong>B.1) <u>Check background-SMX</u></strong></p>
<p>Go to SAP T-code SMX.</p>
<p><img src="media/image42.png" style="width:3.19097in;height:1.8in" alt="cid:image006.png@01D5A5D1.37B89810" /></p>
<p>Check the status as “Finished” means the file is finished and executed. Double click the spool icon as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image43.png" style="width:4.06087in;height:1.75652in" /></p>
<p>After clicking on the Spool icon in above screen, below screen will appear,double click on ABAP list:</p>
<p><img src="media/image44.png" style="width:4.13043in;height:0.84348in" /></p>
<p>Key in the settings from “page 1 to 100000” in the pop-up box which comes on clicking on “Settings”.</p>
<p>Click on the green tick in below screen <img src="media/image28.png" style="width:0.26042in;height:0.21875in" /> :</p>
<p><img src="media/image45.png" style="width:3.6in;height:3.25217in" /></p>
<p>File will be executed. If there is no error, run CJ8G by deselecting the test run option. If there is any error, please rectify those errors and run CJ8G by deselecting the test run. Refer <strong>Sub</strong> <strong>step 4.7.8: 8.4.2.2.8 A) Prepare Month-end reports.</strong></p>
<p>If there is no error, screen will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image46.png" style="width:4.99463in;height:3.30042in" /></p>
<p>If there are errors, screen will show as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image47.png" style="width:4.97917in;height:2.87191in" /></p>
<p>A few examples of errors are given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image48.png" style="width:5.34375in;height:0.11532in" /><img src="media/image49.png" style="width:5.33333in;height:1.36042in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image50.png" style="width:5.33333in;height:0.23352in" /></p>
<p>Steps to rectify if the error is about the settlement rule. List of general error messages received<strong>:</strong></p>
<p><img src="media/image51.png" style="width:4.45217in;height:2.63478in" /></p>
<hr />
<p>To resolve error of Settlement rule, please enter T-code CJ02 in SAP:</p>
<p><img src="media/image52.png" style="width:2.73808in;height:1.45794in" /></p>
<p>Below screen will appear, key in WBS element and press Enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image53.png" style="width:4.82443in;height:1.8121in" /></p>
<p>Update the below fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Cat (category): AUC number</p></li>
<li><p>%: 100</p></li>
<li><p>Settlement Type: FUL</p></li>
<li><p>From period and year: Current period and year</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Update other fields as required and click “Ctrl+S” to save the changes made.</p>
<p><img src="media/image54.png" style="width:5.18441in;height:2.50306in" /></p>
<p>Run the above project number in T-code CJ88 again, WBS will be executed.</p>
<p>Verify in T-code CJI3 again to check amount is zero. That means the unsettled amount is fully settled.</p>
<p><u>Note:</u> In case the error pertains to one WBS, use SAP T-code CJ88 to settle errors. In other cases where errors occur in more than one WBS, use T-code CJ8G.</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>B.2) <u>Final CJ8G run</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>After rectifying all the errors, re-run CJ8G and if the report is executed successfully with no errors, un-tick the test run and run back again the CJ8G for an actual production run.</p>
<p>Please enter T-code CJ8G in SAP:</p>
<p><img src="media/image55.png" style="width:3.41375in;height:1.22946in" /></p>
<p>Below screen appears when settlement run completes without error:</p>
<p>If error occurs, follow the steps mentioned in <strong>Step 4.7.7: 8.4.2.2.7 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)</strong> to run CJ8G to resolve errors.</p>
<p><img src="media/image56.png" style="width:5.38542in;height:4.33194in" /></p>
<p>Click on the detail list icon <img src="media/image57.png" style="width:0.34132in;height:0.26928in" /> as highlighted in above screen and check whether the amount has been executed / settled.</p>
<p><img src="media/image58.png" style="width:5.82292in;height:2.56944in" /></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>B.3) <u>Check completeness of projects settlement:</u></strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>Enter T-code CJI3.</p>
<p><img src="media/image59.png" style="width:3.9913in;height:1.95652in" /></p>
<p>The below screen will appear when you press Enter.</p>
<p>Enter the Controlling Area and click on the green tick<img src="media/image60.png" style="width:0.17387in;height:0.17389in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image61.png" style="width:4.49897in;height:4.24924in" /></p>
<p>Enter Database prof. as shown below and click on green tick <img src="media/image60.png" style="width:0.17387in;height:0.17389in" />:</p>
<p><img src="media/image62.png" style="width:5.60996in;height:1.60701in" /></p>
<p>Enter Project number and Posting date and click on execute<img src="media/image17.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /> icon.</p>
<p><img src="media/image63.png" style="width:5.88991in;height:3.97391in" /></p>
<p>The report will appear as below. Check the Val/co Area Crcy is zero. This indicates that the settlement can be offset to zero as on month end.</p>
<p><img src="media/image64.png" style="width:5.75in;height:3.99792in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.4.2.2.8</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="prepare-month-end-reports">Prepare month-end reports</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets)</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets)</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p><strong>Note:</strong> This step is not applicable to Brazil as it will continue to follow the current process until the configuration activities are completed by SAP IT Team.</p>
<p>Open project reports are generated to keep track of open projects which might be subject for project closure. Submit these reports to Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office for review.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Prepare month-end report file for capital projects</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The purpose of month - end report for capital projects is to monitor the current open capital projects, budgeted amount against actual spend.</p>
<p>Please note that below steps are not applicable for NAM, there is a customised report “ZRF11N - Capital Investment Report” used as a month-end report.</p>
<p>Log in to SAP system.</p>
<p><img src="media/image6.png" style="width:6.31944in;height:4.25in" /></p>
<p>Enter T-code CN41N to extract open projects actual cost and budget.</p>
<p><img src="media/image65.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.90833in" /></p>
<p>Below screen will be displayed:</p>
<p><img src="media/image66.png" style="width:6.33671in;height:2.5393in" /></p>
<p>Select the PS Info Profile in the screen which appears and click the “Green tick” <img src="media/image60.png" style="width:0.17387in;height:0.17389in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image67.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:4.21319in" /></p>
<p>At the Parameter Screen select Dynamic selections, double click on Company Code and input accordingly.</p>
<p><img src="media/image68.png" style="width:6.33787in;height:1.02098in" /></p>
<p>At Project field, input multiple selection: E* to include all projects.</p>
<p>Please note: For countries with some old project codes other than E, details are given below:</p>
<p>- For UK, some old projects start with “C” and numerical 5 digits project numbers.</p>
<p>- For Sweden, some old projects start with “C” and “S”, and</p>
<p>- For NAM, old projects start with “C”</p>
<p><img src="media/image69.png" style="width:5.63624in;height:4.12321in" /></p>
<p>Click F8 or press <img src="media/image17.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /> to Execute.</p>
<p>Report output is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image70.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.44722in" /></p>
<p>Click on Extract and then on “MS Excel (xls)” to export the report into excel:</p>
<p><img src="media/image71.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.28125in" /></p>
<p>Select “Table” in the pop-up box and click on green tick <img src="media/image72.png" style="width:0.14746in;height:0.13533in" /> to proceed as displayed below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image73.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.24873in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Microsoft Excel” and then on green tick <img src="media/image72.png" style="width:0.14746in;height:0.13533in" />to extract the report in excel:</p>
<p><img src="media/image74.png" style="width:5.7096in;height:3.19626in" /></p>
<p>Copy this data and place it in “Data ALL” tab in the monthly main file.</p>
<p><img src="media/image75.png" style="width:6.27173in;height:4.48748in" /></p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Extract AUC asset balances and match AUC asset number against WBSE</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The next step is to extract AUC asset balances and match AUC asset number against WBSE</p>
<p>Enter T-code AR02 (Asset History Sheet) or T-code is S_ALR_87011990 (Asset History Sheet) to extract AUC number and amounts. Fill in the Parameter using below:</p>
<ol type="1">
<li><p>Company code: Enter relevant company code</p></li>
<li><p>Asset class: Enter your company code AUC asset classes</p></li>
<li><p>Report date: Current month-end</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation Area: 20 (please refer Local Book for respective SAP instances)</p></li>
<li><p>Sort variant: Please select Sort Variant with WBSE Reference.</p></li>
<li><p>If sort variant with WBSE is not available in your SAP instance, please run t-code S_ALR_87012058 (List of Origins of Asset Charges) to retrieve AUC with WBSE reference. Refer to <strong>Step 4.7.8: 8.4.2.2.8 Prepare month-end reports</strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Below is a screenshot sample of AR02 parameter for Sweden with sort variant: 0007 without WBSE.</p>
<p><img src="media/image76.png" style="width:5.94374in;height:3.21486in" /></p>
<p>Click Select Layout button <img src="media/image77.png" style="width:0.20833in;height:0.1875in" /> to change the Layout to “/MEO”, which will display a summary of asset movement during the year by asset class.</p>
<p>Choose Layout - “/MEO” as mentioned above and click on green tick<img src="media/image72.png" style="width:0.14746in;height:0.13533in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image78.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:3.19656in" /></p>
<p>Press F8 to Execute and it will generate the report with asset class.</p>
<p>It will be displayed as below and export it in excel.</p>
<p><img src="media/image79.png" style="width:6.02689in;height:3.55106in" /></p>
<p>To export in excel click <img src="media/image80.png" style="width:0.32292in;height:0.36458in" /> icon.</p>
<p>Choose the option “Text with Tabs” and click the green tick button <img src="media/image81.png" style="width:0.32292in;height:0.22917in" />.</p>
<p><img src="media/image82.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:5.18403in" /></p>
<p>Select the location to save the file.</p>
<p><img src="media/image83.png" style="width:4.02747in;height:1.31973in" /></p>
<p>Change the save as type from “txt” to “xls” and hit Save button:</p>
<p><img src="media/image84.png" style="width:5.04041in;height:1.74928in" /></p>
<p>Below is the data in Excel:</p>
<p><img src="media/image85.png" style="width:5.5887in;height:3.00735in" /></p>
<ol start="3" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Extract the report for AUC with WBSE reference</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Enter T-code S_ALR_87012058 (List of Origins of Asset Charges) to extract AUC assets with WBSE number.</p>
<p><img src="media/image86.png" style="width:5.14187in;height:3.43429in" /></p>
<p>Copy all the AUC assets from AR02 List (as shown below) and paste <img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.26351in;height:0.23423in" /> the list in asset number field in SAP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image85.png" style="width:5.82078in;height:3.13223in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the below details:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Asset number: copy all the AUC assets from AR02 List and paste values <img src="media/image87.png" style="width:0.26351in;height:0.23423in" /> the list at asset number in SAP by clicking on Multiple selection icon. Click green tick button <img src="media/image88.png" style="width:0.28554in;height:0.20118in" /> to save the data.</p></li>
<li><p>Report date: current month-end</p></li>
<li><p>Depreciation Area: (please refer Local Book for respective SAP instances)</p></li>
<li><p>Sort Variant: 0003</p></li>
<li><p>Press F8 or click Execute Button <img src="media/image17.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.17708in" /></p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image89.png" style="width:6.07252in;height:3.40764in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image90.png" style="width:3.54583in;height:0.80556in" /><img src="media/image91.png" style="width:1.27083in;height:1.13889in" /><strong>Extract the report in excel</strong>: Upon extracted report displayed, click at System at menu bar &gt; List &gt; Save &gt; Local File. Then select the designated folder to save the file.</p>
<p><img src="media/image92.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.33542in" /></p>
<p>Using the report from S_ALR_87012058, VLOOKUP the WBSE element number at Column I to the AR02 report’s (Column D) with AUC asset numbers.</p>
<p>Use the formula in O6 in AR02 report “=VLOOKUP(B6,[Report] S_ALR_87012058_SE10!A:M,10,0)”</p>
<p>(e.g. E.012641.05.01 to E.012641)</p>
<p><img src="media/image93.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:3.17361in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image94.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.85486in" /></p>
<p>Going back to CN41N report, refer <strong>Step 8.4.2.2.8:4.6.8 A) Prepare month-end reports,</strong> filter only level “00” and VLOOKUP the AUC balances from AR02 report with project ID.</p>
<p>Create a new column (Column O) in AR02 report to capture the project definition (e.g. E.012641.05.01 to E.012641). Use the formula “=VLOOKUP(O6,[Report] AR02!A:M,12,0)”</p>
<p><img src="media/image95.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.80556in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image96.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.87361in" /></p>
<ol start="4" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>The final Open Project Report with “Actual Cost” and “Budget”</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p><img src="media/image97.png" style="width:6.26806in;height:2.87014in" /></p>
<p>To support CAPEX 3 reporting, T-code CN41N displays cumulative authorised budget of all projects against the project’s life.</p>
<p>To match sub-ledger AR02 AUC balance with General Ledger, use T-code F.01.</p>
<p><img src="media/image98.png" style="width:3.43556in;height:3.15779in" /></p>
<p>Fill in the below fields:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Chart of Accounts: SCOA</p></li>
<li><p>G/L Account: Input the G/L accounts for which AUC balance is to be verified by clicking on the highlighted icon, inputting the AUC G/L Numbers and then click on execute icon <img src="media/image99.png" style="width:0.21875in;height:0.1875in" /></p></li>
<li><p>Reporting Year: Current Year</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image100.png" style="width:6.00353in;height:4.19552in" /></p>
<p>Click on green tick <img src="media/image88.png" style="width:0.45833in;height:0.32292in" />. Once all the details are entered press F8 or <img src="media/image101.png" style="width:0.32292in;height:0.28125in" /> to Execute.</p>
<p>Below screen shows the output generated:</p>
<p><img src="media/image102.png" style="width:6.04208in;height:4.20164in" /></p>
<p>Verify the AUC balance in F.01 from AR02 and prepare a working as shown below keeping the screenshots of balances verified as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image103.png" style="width:5.94411in;height:2.7679in" /></p>
<p>AR02 excel extract is given below to verify the balance:</p>
<p><img src="media/image104.png" style="width:6.27415in;height:1.94355in" /></p>
<p>The reason for balance mismatch, if any, is the manual posting to AUC GL 12100901, supporting will need to be provided in the report at Manual Posting” tab.</p>
<p><img src="media/image105.png" style="width:4.3874in;height:2.38992in" /></p>
<p>Save a copy of the Open Capital Project Report by pasting the data as values in the report and share the file with GFS Middle Office and respective project managers.</p>
<ol start="5" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Capture the authorised budget of projects</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>T-code CJI8 is used to capture the authorized budget of projects for the month of reporting in order to support CPS reporting.</p>
<p>Enter T-code CJI8 in SAP:</p>
<p><img src="media/image107.png" /><img src="media/image108.png" style="width:5.53403in;height:2.13333in" /></p>
<p>Input Controlling Area and click on greet tick <img src="media/image88.png" style="width:0.45833in;height:0.32292in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image109.png" style="width:5.52083in;height:2.93542in" /></p>
<p>Select Standard selection 00000000001 (structure) to update in Database profile Tab in the below screen:</p>
<p><img src="media/image110.png" style="width:4.21171in;height:1.70709in" /></p>
<p>At parameter, select Dynamic Selection (Shift+F4).</p>
<p>In “Master Data definition”, click on applicant no. selection icon (Set Area in SE10). Choose applicant number if we want to extract set area. Don’t fill the applicant number to extract all set area. In below screen we will choose applicant number as we are taking example to extract set area e.g. Sample for R&amp;D: 205.</p>
<p><img src="media/image111.png" style="width:5.49762in;height:4.67446in" /></p>
<p>In “Org. units definition”, click on Company Code selection icon.</p>
<p><img src="media/image112.png" style="width:5.54676in;height:4.61376in" /></p>
<p>At Parameter page input:</p>
<p>1) E* in Project tab below</p>
<p>2) Fiscal year</p>
<p>3) Tick on Overall Values</p>
<p>4) Choose Layout “/SWEOP AUTH1”</p>
<p>Then select Further selection criteria. Enter Document date and fill the required date of reporting, from start of the month until end of the month. Save and click on Tick and then execute report:</p>
<p><img src="media/image113.png" style="width:5.86858in;height:4.77924in" /></p>
<p>Select “Further selection criteria” and then click on “Documents / Objects”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image114.png" style="width:5.21316in;height:3.46049in" /></p>
<p>Click on “Document Date” and enter the date from 1<sup>st</sup> of the month till the end of the month.</p>
<p><img src="media/image115.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:1.976in" /></p>
<p>Click “Save” icon <img src="media/image116.png" style="width:0.28125in;height:0.28125in" /> to save the details.</p>
<p>Below report will appear on the screen. Now select List &gt; export &gt; spreadsheet in the below screen to get report in excel:</p>
<p><img src="media/image117.png" style="width:6.20139in;height:3.13194in" /></p>
<p>Now select list, export and then spreadsheet in below screen to get report in excel:</p>
<p>Extracted excel report will appear as below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image118.png" style="width:5.61395in;height:2.47549in" /></p>
<p>This report will be used for monthly Authorised Budget in CPS reporting by set area.</p>
<p><img src="media/image119.png" style="width:5.85143in;height:1.76407in" /></p>
<p>Final report summary.</p>
<p><img src="media/image120.png" style="width:5.21486in;height:2.4909in" /></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td><strong>8.4.2.2.9</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="review-month-end-reports">Review month-end reports</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets)</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5"><p>Review related month-end reports prepared by GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets) to support month-end reconciliation for fixed assets including open projects reconciliation, variance analysis vs budget.</p>
<p>Please ensure to perform control CPX003 as per the FCAS framework for respective unit.</p>
<p><strong><u>Review month-end report</u></strong></p>
<p>Review provided capital projects month-end report focussing on following checks (list is not exhaustive):</p>
<ul>
<li><p>Values are matching across G/L Accounts balances (FI) and Asset balances (AA).</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image121.png" style="width:6.53958in;height:3.68056in" /></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Comparison of actual expenses (Value) against budget amounts (Plan).</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image122.png" style="width:6.2924in;height:2.91066in" /></p>
<ul>
<li><p>Monthly Authorised Budget vs Actual Spend by Set Area (CPS Unit)</p></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="media/image123.png" style="width:4.44799in;height:2.78544in" /></p>
<p>After reviewing the month-end report Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office decides if budget revision is required:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>If a revision is required <strong>proceed to 8.4.1.3 Review and approve capital projects</strong> process map</p></li>
<li><p>If no revision is required, then the process ends here</p></li>
</ul></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

# RESPONSIBILITIES

## Roles and Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Role / Team Name | Description |
| Business | Refers to the respective Project Managers that would run the project on a day-to-day basis and would monitor and collect project transactions |
| Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office | Refers to the Embedded Finance and / or GFS Middle Office that would review expenses posted to the project |
| GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets) | Refers to the GFS Back Office R2R (Fixed Assets) team that would perform monthly capital project settlement and prepare month-end report |

# GLOSSARY

The table below contains the definition of all terms, acronyms and abbreviations required to properly interpret this document:

| **Terms** | **Definition**                                      |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| AICC      | Asset in the Course of Construction                 |
| AR02      | SAP T-code to retrieve Asset Master List            |
| AUC       | Asset Under Construction / Construction in Progress |
| AZ        | AstraZeneca                                         |
| CAPEX     | Capital Expenditure                                 |
| CAS       | Capital approval system                             |
| CATS      | System to capture time-based charges                |
| CJ88      | SAP T-code for individual WBS settlement            |
| CJ8G      | SAP T-code for month end settlement                 |

| **Terms** | **Definition** |
|----|----|
| CJI8 | SAP T-code is to capture the authorize budget of projects |
| CJ31 | SAP T-code to display an original budget |
| CJI3 | SAP T-code to display WBSE actual costs by line item |
| CN41N | SAP T-code to check budgets |
| CPS | Capital Planning System |
| ERP | Enterprise Resource Management |
| F.01 | SAP T-code to display Financial Statement |
| FA | Fixed Asset |
| FBL3N | SAP T-code to display G/L Account Line Items |
| FCAS | Financial Controls and Assurance System |
| FCF | Financial Control Framework |
| GFS | Global Finance Services |
| GL | General Ledger |
| N/A | Not applicable |
| PO | Purchase order |
| PRID | Personal ID |
| R&D | Research and Development |
| R2R | Record to report |
| S_ALR_87011964 | SAP T-code to retrieve Asset Balances |
| S_ALR_87012277 | SAP T-code to retrieve G/L Account Balances |
| S_ALR_87012058 | SAP T-code to identify the list of origins of Asset Charges |
| SAP | Finance enterprise software used by AZ to record transactions for internal and external reporting |
| SMX | SAP T-code to display own jobs (background jobs running in the system) |
| SOX | Sarbanes-Oxley Act |
| T&E | Travel and Expenses |
| WBSE | Work Breakdown Structure Element |
| WD | Working Day |

- Note: The control objective defines the risk that needs to be addressed by the control. For the definition and for detailed information on the control operated for your unit, please refer to FCAS for your unit.
- Business has the responsibility to monitor and collect project transactions such as goods / service receipt, salary expenses, material movements, time expenses and T&E expenses.
- Goods / services procured: Please proceed to the process 4.3.3.4 Perform Indirect Materials Purchase (i-Buy) and then to 4.3.3.6 Perform goods or service receipt
- Salary expenses: Please proceed to the process 8.3.2.10 Post payroll
- Material movements: Please proceed to step 4.7.2: 8.4.2.2.2 Post material movements
- Time expenses: Please proceed to step 4.7.3: 8.4.2.2.3 Post time expenses
- T&E expenses: Please proceed to step 4.7.4: 8.4.2.2.4 Post T&E expenses
- Clinical trial accruals: Please proceed to the process 8.6.1.23 Prepare and post clinical trial accruals
- Direct materials used for project related activities must be monitored and recorded to the specific project. For example, for R&D projects, materials could be issued as part of R&D work.
- T&E expenses linked to projects must be recorded to underlying project.
- (Note: T&E expenses come via concur and can be posted as long as the postings come with the WBSE code)
- T&E report is validated and analysed to determine completeness, accuracy and propriety of expenses
- Request a capital project via CAS, please proceed to 8.4.1.3 Review and approve capital projects for details.
- Upon invoice on purchase of Fixed Asset posted, a journal entry will need to be passed in Hubs book. Please proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.2.6 Prepare manual adjustments.
- Subsequent to settlement, Middle Office Finance will need to send in Notice of Project Closure Template (NPC) to capitalise the Fixed Asset in UK or Sweden Hubs book. Please proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.4 Close and capitalise projects for details.
- In case adjustment is required, then proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.2.2.6 Prepare manual adjustments
- WBSE is not statistical, then proceed to Step 4.7.7: 8.4.2.2.7 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC)
- WBSE is statistical, then go proceed Step 4.7.8: 8.4.2.2.8 Prepare month-end reports
- Please proceed to 8.3.2.2 Process Manual Journal Entries for further details on how the journal entry is submitted, approved and posted.
- Once the adjustment review is complete, please proceed to step 4.7.7:8.4.2.2.7 Perform monthly settlement clearing (WBSE to AUC) for a non-statistical WBSE. For a statistical WBSE, please proceed to step 4.7.8:8.4.2.2.8 Prepare month-end reports.

1. PURPOSE
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for the capital project
approval process.
Capital Projects are reviewed and approved through the CAS system. As an output of the process,
if a capital project is approved, Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office team will submit a request
to GFS Back Office DMT to create a project account code. In other cases, the project could be
deferred until following year or terminated if it is no longer required.

2. AUDIENCE
This SOP applies to Business, Capital Approval Board (CAB), Embedded Finance, GFS Middle
Office and GFS Back Office DMT.
3. SCOPE
The table indicates a summary of Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document
relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded:

Description

4.7 Process Detail
The following step by step instructions explain how to perform the work involved in the process:
Task # TASK NAME
8.4.1.3.1 4.7.1 Draft / Amend proposal forms (Pre-Investment Proposal /
Engineering Proposal)
Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed
Business Business N/A N/A
The Business completes / amends the proposal forms for their capital project. There is Excel
based standardised forms for investment and engineering proposals.

Task # TASK NAME
8.4.1.3.2 4.7.2 Complete Business Case. Explain benefits, costs, savings, external
vendors, terms, length of contract, etc. and check budget available
Responsible Accountable Consulted Informed
Business Business N/A N/A
After completing the project proposal forms, Business completes a more detailed analysis for
each capital project in Excel. This may include:
- Cost benefit analysis
- Possible future savings as a result of carrying out the project
- Length and terms of any contract, and
- External vendors who may be involved
In case the project value is above the threshold requiring approval from the Capital Approval
Board (CAB), as per the Capital and Fixed Asset Standard (refer Section 7 References for link),
email the business cases to the CAB representative Susan Booth,
Susan.Booth@astrazeneca.com for annual budget review and approval which happens at year-
end. In this case, proceed to Step 4.7.3: 8.4.1.3.3 Review Capital project proposal.

The CAB collects all the capital project proposals and business cases. Based on the information
received, the CAB will decide on the overall budget for the year.
Possible outcomes:
- If the application is rejected for consideration in a future year, proceed to Step 4.7.4:
8.4.1.3.4 Request deferred until next year.
- If any adjustments are required, proceed to Step 4.7.5: 8.4.1.3.5 Amend capital
project proposal.
- If the rejection is permanent, then the process ends.
- If the application is approved, proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.4.1.3.6 Create / amend new
capital project record.

           A.1) Update tab “Project Maintenance Form”

Populate the fields in “Project Maintenance Form” tab in the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form
using below guidance:
- Maintenance Type – “New”
- Region – “APAC/MEA/INDIA”
- Country – Select the Country of the entity
- Company code – Input the company code
- Requestor’s email – Mention email address of the requestor
- Reason for maintenance request – Note containing the general narrative “To create
WBSE for the project” and the project description (for example, “To create WBS for the
project “Introduce 4 incubators for QC and SHIDC”)
- Project coding mask - E. XXXXXX. XX. XX. XX. XX. XX
- Project Category – will always be “AZ Capital Project- E”
- Object Class – “Investment” (No Input required from user, please ignore these fields)
- Planning Level – “1” (No Input required from user, please ignore these fields)
- Planning Element – “Yes” (No Input required from user, please ignore these fields)
- CAS Request Number – Please input 6 digits of the CAS request number (i.e. 123456 for
R-123456). If CAS request Number is having “0” as beginning digit, please input sign
before “0”. (i.e. R-012345, please input ‘012345)
- ISO Country Code – Will populate as per selected country
- Project Definition – will populate as per CAS request number
- Controlling Area – will populate as per country selected
- Project Type – Either select “E2 - IT capital” for IT projects and “E1 - Engineering Capital”
or “E3- Revenue Settlement” in other cases
- Project Description – Title of the project
- Scale of Investment Objects – need to select one option out of these, “Minor-Capital
Investments (< 1M USD)/Middle-Sized Capital Investments (1M-5M USD)/Major-Scaled
Capital Investments (> 5M USD)”
- Reason for Investment – “S0-Miscellaneous”, “S1-Risk Compliance”, “S2-Risk
Replacement”, “S3- Value”, “S4-Capacity”, “S5-Strategic”, “S6-Central”
- System Status – “REL Released”
- Project Status (User Status) – “E_ID – Execute”
- Person Responsible – Provide the name of the person responsible
- Applicant Number – Provide the details as per the CAS request
- Plant – Plant code based on “Project Location” and “Function” from CAS request
- Business Area – Input the “Business Area” of the cost center from the CAS request
- Profit Center – Input the “Profit center”
- Responsible Cost Center – “Cost Center” from CAS request
- Requesting Cost Center – “Cost Center” from CAS request
- Start Date – Date of receiving the CAS request
- Finish date – Estimated date of the project completion based on “Project Timeline” from
CAS request
- Long Text – optional field (would be specified in the request)

A.2) Update tab “WBSE Creation Form”

Liaise with the Project Manager to determine the most appropriate individual elements (WBSEs)
for this project. The WBSEs should be set at the lowest level possible (up to 6 levels but at least
at level 3). Refer to “WBSE Creation Form” tab in the E Code WBSE Maintenance Form for the
fixed asset global capital project structure. Please refer to Section 7 References for guidelines
on how to update a Capital Project WBSE structure. This document has guidelines on inclusions
and exclusions at a level 4 detail.

The WBSE Creation Form tab lists all L3 WBSEs for AZ. To complete this tab, select all
applicable L3 elements for the project by typing the “X” character in column A (Select with “X”
WBS Elements needed) for each applicable row. This will highlight the required fields in the
respective rows. Populate the highlighted fields as per the “Project Maintenance Form” tab:

- “Project Description”- This field is ONLY applicable for UK, please input for the rows
marked with 'X' in Column A with the necessary description of the level of project if any.

- “Project Status” – “E_ID – Execute”

in the request
- “Investment Profile” - Investment Profile: This field is ONLY applicable for SWEDEN
country to determine if asset is tangible or intangible, select from dropdown list for the
rows marked with 'X' in Column A.

#

# PURPOSE

This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) sets out the mandatory activities for tracking Physical Fixed Assets. Briefly, Physical Fixed Assets require regular tracking to ensure that the assets recorded in the system are consistent with the physical assets on site.

This process covers the tracking of fixed assets, including performing physical inventory checks. The process is linked with processing retirements and impairments. For example, following completion of asset verification, Business will determine if there are asset retirements and impairments that must be performed.

# AUDIENCE

This SOP applies to Business, Embedded Finance, GFS Back Office R2R, GFS Middle Office and GFS Back Office DMT.

Note: For NAM, LATAM, MEA and India, Sweden and UK Hubs, activities indicated for GFS Back Office DMT are currently performed by GFS Back Office R2R, until the transition to GFS Back Office DMT is completed (estimated Q2 2020).

- This transition is a GFS led transition jointly done by AZ and Genpact managed by [**Lukasz**](mailto:lukasz.lobocki@astrazeneca.com) **Lobocki (Luke)** centrally, with support from **Amit Matta** (Back Office) at Genpact

- The Documentation Team will be performing the updates on receipt of information

# SCOPE

The table indicates the scope of the Systems, Regions, Countries and Business Areas that this document relates to. Anything not explicitly included is excluded:

|  |  |
|----|----|
| Business Process | Description |
| Global | This process is applicable to all AZ entities except for those entities that have an approved exception by GPO R2R |

The control for fixed asset verification should be performed annually and all fixed assets (as per the Capital and Fixed Asset Standard) should be verified once in three years.

<td colspan="5" style="text-align: left;"><p>According to AZ Global and Fixed Asset Standard, all entities need to perform a physical verification of all assets with an NBV above a locally defined threshold at least once every three years.</p>
<p>The “Asset History Sheet” (displaying Fixed Asset Listing Report) is generated for each business unit at the Cost Centre level. The report shows the Asset Balances, the acquisition value, the accumulated depreciation of the asset, finally providing a Net Book Value of the Fixed Asset.</p>
<p>For the Hubs, on a yearly basis after June month end close, GFS Back Office R2R team will trigger the Physical Inventory Verification activity for Tangible Assets. For other markets this will be initiated in the beginning of September, starting 2020.</p>
<p>Frequency of Physical Inventory Verification process varies by the region and the markets.</p>
<p><strong>For APAC</strong> – Starting month and frequency of Physical Inventory Verification is defined By Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office. <li><p><strong>Company Code</strong>: Please select the applicable company code</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Report date</strong>: Please select the report date when you trigger the Fixed Asset Verification Exercise (FAVE). For e.g., in the Hubs, the report date is as of 30th June</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Depreciation Area</strong>: Depreciation area is set up differently for different regions. Select as per the region for group book or local book, as appropriate.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Asset Class</strong>: Exclude AUC and Intangible asset classes according to your company code</p></li>

</ol>

<p>Make sure you have entered the complete details.Once the details are entered, press F8 or Execute <img src="media/image3.png" style="width:0.22917in;height:0.19792in" /> to proceed.</p>
<p><strong>Please note:</strong> The location is maintained in different fields in the different SAP instances. Select the sort variant which can display the location accordingly. Screenshot below is an example of NAM report with location maintained at Evaluation Group “Ev 2”.</p>

</ol>
<p>Submit the report to the relevant points of contact by attaching the generated fixed asset listing report. Based on the respective country’s control description, work on the raw data file to allocate the asset listing according to location, cost centre and the responsible person. Subsequently email the data with the list of Tangible assets which are in scope for the year. For e.g.:</p>
<p>UK and Sweden – All assets held on the fixed asset register that represent at least 85% of the total net book value of tangible fixed assets, plus any items manually recorded in SAP, must be verified on an annual basis.</p>
<p>NAM - The three-year plan may be based on dollar values or other methods as desired by the Capex Process Owner on changing business needs and circumstances. Scope by NBV Values is given below:</p>
<p>Year 1 Scope = $50K and Greater</p>
<p>Year 2 Scope = $25K up to $50K</p>
<p>Year 3 Scope = Less than $25K</p>

<td colspan="5"><p>GFS Back Office DMT team maintains and updates ownership of any incorrect fixed asset master data.</p>
<p>Currently in LATAM, NAM, Europe, MEA and India, Asset Master Data maintenance is being done by GFS Back Office R2R team. This activity will move to the DMT team in Q2 2020 as part of a transition.</p>
<p><strong>Maintain Asset Master Data</strong></p>
<p>Log on to T-code: AS02 and press enter. This T-code is used for Master Data maintenance.</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.67708in" /></p>

<p>Click the save icon <img src="media/image15.png" style="width:0.27083in;height:0.27083in" /> to save the changes made. Once saved, send the confirmation to the requestor regarding changes made.</p>
<p>Sample email given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:5.99136in;height:2.23674in" /></p>
<p><strong>Note</strong>- for LATAM, Europe and APAC, the confirmation of completion will be sent through the appropriate workflow request.</p></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>

<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>

<td colspan="2">Business</td>

<tr>
<td colspan="5" style="text-align: left;"><p>Once the list is received, the business will compare with the physical assets and determine if there are any missing assets or changes to existing assets are required (e.g. Impairments or Retirements). Business will also follow up with cost centre owners to ensure responses. Respective Cost Centre owners will need to ensure the existence of the tangible assets provided in the list. Upon completion, the asset owners will need to response to GFS Back Office R2R team by providing the asset list with the confirmation of existence and the actions needed if assets need to be retired or impaired.</p>
<ol type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Execute manual validation</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>The Business performs manual validation on physical assets.</p>
<ol start="2" type="A">
<li><p><strong><u>Summarise findings</u></strong></p></li>
</ol>
<p>Perform manual validation of physical assets based on the fixed assets listing received from GFS Back Office R2R and assess the fixed assets value.</p>
<p>If there are missing assets, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.5: 8.3.3.8.5 Investigate missing assets.</strong></p>
<p>If there are no missing assets, determine if there are any changes required to the assets.</p>
<p>If no changes are required, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.8.6 Provide verification results along with required documentation.</strong></p></td>
</tr>

<td colspan="5" style="text-align: left;"><p>The Business needs to investigate if there are any missing assets to determine next steps.</p>
<p><strong>Perform checks and identify cause of missing assets</strong></p>
<p>Determine the whereabouts of the missing fixed assets. For example, the asset could have been sold, scrapped, or transferred.</p>
<p>Once the cause of the missing asset has been identified, determine if there are any changes required to the cost centre owner of the asset.</p>
<p>If the reason of missing asset has not been identified then, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.6: 8.3.3.8.6 Provide verification results along with required documentation.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="4">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.8.6</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="provide-verification-results-along-with-required-documentation">Provide verification results along with required documentation</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="2">Business</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="5" style="text-align: left;"><p>Once confirmed that no further changes are required, the Business compiles verification results along with all supporting documentation.</p>
<p>Sample of email replied by business is given below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image17.png" style="width:5.90595in;height:3.25821in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image18.png" style="width:5.89467in;height:2.63207in" /></p>
<p><strong>Compile verification results</strong></p>
<p>Gather and compile the results and all relevant supporting documentation during the verification exercise.</p>
<p>From the results, determine if the verification process is completed.</p>
<p>If completed, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.8: 8.3.3.8.8 Review and consolidate verification confirmation.</strong></p>
<p>If process is not completed, <strong>proceed to Step 4.7.7: 8.3.3.8.7 Follow up with Point(s) of contact and escalate as required.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 12%" />
<col style="width: 0%" />
<col style="width: 10%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 25%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Task #</th>
<th colspan="4">TASK NAME</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td colspan="2"><strong>8.3.3.8.7</strong></td>
<td colspan="4"><h3 id="follow-up-with-points-of-contact-and-escalate-as-required">Follow-up with Point(s) of contact and escalate as required</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Embedded Finance / GFS Middle Office</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="6"><p>If Business verification is incomplete, the Business must follow-up with the respective point(s) of contact and escalate if required.</p>
<p><strong>Follow up with owners on any outstanding issues</strong></p>
<p>Follow up with owners for any outstanding verification on assets, and then <strong>proceed to</strong> <strong>Step 4.7.4: 8.3.3.8.4 Perform manual verification of assets.</strong></p>
<p>If escalation is required for the outstanding response, GFS Back Office R2R team will need to send the email to the cost centre owner and copy Compliance Team. Compliance Team will help to chase for a confirmation.</p>
<p>Sample email is shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image19.png" style="width:6.27083in;height:3.51181in" /></p>
<p><strong>Note</strong>: - If verification results are not received within 30 days for all assets from the list of fixed assets this will be escalated by GFS Back Office R2R to the lead / manager.</p>
<p>If a response is not received on a query within 15 days, this will be escalated by GFS Back Office R2R to Site Lead / SET area lead as applicable in order to clarify all remaining assets.</p>
<p>Final point of escalation will be to CFO (for commercial / enabling units) or SET area head for other units.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Task #</td>
<td colspan="5">TASK NAME</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>8.3.3.8.8</strong></td>
<td colspan="5"><h3 id="review-and-consolidate-verification-confirmation">Review and consolidate verification confirmation</h3></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">Responsible</td>
<td>Accountable</td>
<td>Consulted</td>
<td>Informed</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="3">GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Business</td>
<td>N/A</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td colspan="6"><p>GFS Back Office R2R receives and reviews the confirmation of the completion of the process wherein they perform final review on the Fixed Asset tracking.</p>
<p>If the asset has been transferred or scrapped but not yet retired in the system, an asset retirement will be required, hence <strong>proceed to Process 8.3.3.10: Process and Record fixed asset retirements.</strong></p>
<p>If an asset impairment is required, <strong>proceed to Process 8.3.3.4: Process and Record fixed asset impairments.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Review and perform final checks</strong></p>
<p>Consolidate and review reports and supporting documentation as attached by Business. If final check is acceptable, the process ends. Please perform control CPX010 as per the FCAS framework for the respective unit.</p>
<p>If a change in cost centre is required, Business will proceed to send this request to GFS Back Office DMT. GFS Back Office DMT to <strong>proceed with Step 4.7.9: 8.3.3.8.9 Maintain Asset Master Data.</strong></p></td>
</tr>

</table>

<td colspan="5" style="text-align: left;"><p>GFS Back Office DMT team will update fixed asset master data if any change in cost centre is required.</p>
<p>Note: For Europe, NAM, LATAM, MEA and India, Sweden and UK Hubs , the role of GFS Back Office DMT for asset master maintenance is performed by the GFS Back Office R2R teams, until the transition to GFS Back Office DMT is completed (estimated Q2 2020).</p>
<p><strong>Maintain Asset Master Data</strong></p>
<p>Log on to T-code: AS02 and press enter.</p>
<p><img src="media/image12.png" style="width:1.9375in;height:0.67708in" /></p>
<p>Input Asset number and company code according to Asset Master Data Maintenance Template and click “Enter”.</p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:1.34585in;height:0.14692in" /><img src="media/image20.png" style="width:6.54306in;height:2.70833in" /></p>
<p>At the next page, double check that the description of the asset number provided in the template is match as requested template. In case of any variances, query back to Business to confirm. Amend the values in accordance with the template sent by Business and click save <img src="media/image21.png" style="width:0.21153in;height:0.18333in" /> to save the changes.</p>
<p><img src="media/image22.png" style="width:4.48681in;height:0.36528in" /></p>
<p><img src="media/image13.png" style="width:1.2235in;height:0.13357in" /><img src="media/image23.png" style="width:1.76181in;height:0.19167in" /><img src="media/image24.png" style="width:6.54306in;height:2.44653in" /></p>
<p>Message will show as below showing change in asset master.</p>
<p><img src="media/image25.png" style="width:4.79167in;height:3.1875in" /></p>
<p>Note: Changes of cost centre in NAM SAP (ARP) will trigger a posting with no financial impact to reflect in Asset transaction with below message.</p>
<p><img src="media/image26.png" style="width:5.28262in;height:3.2087in" /></p>
<p>Now input FB03 in SAP.</p>
<p><img src="media/image27.png" style="width:5.26969in;height:1.7856in" /></p>
<p>Enter the document number which is generated above and click Enter:</p>
<p><img src="media/image28.png" style="width:6.54306in;height:2.90278in" /></p>
<p>Will display the details of the transaction as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image29.png" style="width:6.40265in;height:1.98729in" /></p>
<p>Upon completion, send the confirmation in an email as shown below:</p>
<p><img src="media/image16.png" style="width:5.99136in;height:2.23674in" /></p>
<p><strong>Note</strong>- for LATAM, Europe, APAC, confirmation of completion will be sent through the appropriate workflow request.</p></td>

## Roles and Teams

The table below contains a summary of the Roles and Teams that are relevant to the related Process Map:

<table>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%" />
<col style="width: 74%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Role / Team Name</td>
<td>Description</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><blockquote>
<p>FCCG</p>
</blockquote></td>
<td>Refers to the Financial Controls and Compliance Group who are responsible for defining, owning &amp; measuring performance against AZ’s Financial Integrity &amp; Assurance Framework. This team decides on the scope and timing of SOX reviews of Fixed Assets</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>GFS Back Office DMT</td>
<td>Refers to the Central Master Data team who are responsible for managing requests received by the Business and maintain data as per guidance from Business</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>GFS Back Office R2R</td>
<td>Refers to GFS Back Office R2R Fixed Assets team who are responsible for generating list of Fixed Assets and sending this list to Embedded Finance / Middle Office / Business via email. They are also responsible for completeness and sign-off on CPX010 control</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Business</td>
<td>Refers to the relevant Business contacts who are responsible to perform physical asset verification and subsequent investigation of any missing assets</td>
</tr>

</table>
